briefing.en: Meet Yannick Ram at his safehouse on Volturn. He has a plan to save the Sindrian Diktat from itself.
briefing.zh: 在 Volturn 的安全屋会见 Yannick Ram。他有一个让辛达强权免于自我毁灭的计划。

briefing.en: Find and intercept a Sindrian Diktat patrol fleet led by the 'treasonous' officer. It can be found in the Askonia system.
briefing.zh: 找到并拦截由"叛国"军官领导的辛达强权巡逻舰队。它就在 Askonia 星系中。

briefing.en: Use the 'treasonous' officer as leverage to gain access to Deputy Star Marshal Hyder. She can be found in command of the Askonia System Defense Armada, a large warfleet patrolling the Askonia star system.
briefing.zh: 利用"叛国"军官作为突破口，接近副星际元帅 Hyder。她指挥着 Askonia 星系防御无敌舰队，这是一支在 Askonia 星系内巡逻的大型舰队。

briefing.en: Report back to Macario about your conversation with Hyder.
briefing.zh: 把你跟 Hyder 的谈话汇报给 Macario。

briefing.en: Extract a known double-agent who, while working for Horacio Caden, has betrayed the Sindrian Diktat.
briefing.zh: 解救一名为 Horacio Caden 效力、同时背叛了辛达强权的双面特工。

briefing.en: Speak with Guard High Deputy Executor Caden. He can be found in command of the Lion's Guard Grand Armada, a large warfleet patrolling the Askonia star system.
briefing.zh: 利用"叛国"特工作为突破口，接近卫队最高副首长 Caden。他指挥着狮心卫队大无敌舰队，这是一支在 Askonia 星系内巡逻的大型舰队。

briefing.en: Report back to Macario about your conversation with Caden.
briefing.zh: 把你跟 Caden 的谈话汇报给 Macario。

briefing.en: Intercept and assist or capture Macario's agent at the Fringe Jump-point of Askonia.
briefing.zh: 前往 Askonia 的边缘跳跃点拦截并抓捕或协助 Macario 的特工。

briefing.en: Report back to Macario with news of his agent's demise.
briefing.zh: 向 Macario 汇报他的特工已经身亡。

texts.en: Your comms officer calls for your attention, "Captain, we have incoming from... um, an official channel. No ID provided." They forward the link to your personal interface.
texts.zh: 你的通讯军官呼叫你的注意，"舰长，我们收到了一个来自... 呃，官方频道，的来电。没提供 ID。" 他把那个链接转到了你的私人界面上。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: A Sindrian Diktat officer appears. You first recognize the uniform of the internal security ministry; the secret police. Then you recognize his face.
texts.zh: 一名 辛达强权 的官员出现在屏幕上。你先是辨认出了内部安全部的制服；秘密警察。随后，你认出了那张脸。

texts.en:
You were at a spacer bar, not too long ago. This officer led a raid, and his security troops beat some jumpy spacers near to death, and arrested others.

What game is he playing by contacting you like this? Does he even remember you?

He must.
texts.zh:
那是不久前的事情了，你当时在一家太空佬酒吧里。这位军官开展了一次袭击，让他手下的卫兵把几个发神经的船员揍了个半死，还逮捕了其他人。

他现在这样跑来联系你是要耍什么花样？难道他还记得你不成？

他绝对记得。

texts.en: You were at a spacer bar, not too long ago. This officer led a raid, and his security troops beat some jumpy spacers near to death, and arrested others. You told him what you thought of his actions, and for that he had you beaten.
texts.zh: 那是不久前的事情了，你当时在一家太空佬酒吧里。这位军官开展了一次袭击，让他手下的卫兵把几个发神经的船员揍了个半死，还逮捕了其他人。你直言对他行事手段的看法，结果换来一顿好打。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Greetings Captain $playerName," says $Rank Ram with detached authority. "I've been following your career for some time. You are, mm, quite ideally placed."

"I need you to help me save the Sindrian Diktat." He produces a painful-looking smile at this, and looks like he expects you to return it.
texts.zh:
"幸会，$playerName 舰长。" $Rank Ram 带着超然的权威说道，"我关注你的职业生涯有段时间了。你，嗯，处在一个绝妙的位置。"

"我需要你帮我拯救 辛达强权。" 他说着露出了一个痛苦的笑容，而且看来他希望得到你的回应。

options.en: As bearer of a Sindrian Diktat commission, it is my duty to help.
options.zh: 作为一名 辛达强权 的在职雇佣兵，这是我的职责。

options.en: What could you possibly want from me?
options.zh: 那你究竟想要让我做些什么呢？

options.en: Do you remember me? I remember you.
options.zh: 你还记得我吗？我可还记得你呢。

options.en: You had your thugs beat me. Now you want my help?
options.zh: 你手下给了我一顿好打，现在你又来找我帮忙？

options.en: I hate the Sindrian Diktat. I don't want to save it.
options.zh: 我憎恨 辛达强权，更不会想着去拯救它。

options.en: I'm in. Where do we start?
options.zh: 算我一个，从哪里开始动手？

texts.en:
"Yes, yes," Ram leans in, an odd gleam to his eyes now apparent.

"You see clearly that Philip Andrada's vision has been corrupted from the glorious early days. The ministries have fallen to infighting and corruption; our fleets are bloated with incompetents, our factories run by degenerate plunderers. The martial virtues which defined our once-glorious Diktat have been lost - we must reclaim them."

"The Supreme Executor is not himself, and may already be dead. We see holos, but who can say if they are true? Corrupt advisors are exploiting the situation for their own benefit, so it is up to us - the front-line officers loyal to the Movement, who know blood and sweat - to save the Diktat!"
texts.zh:
"是的，是的。" Ram 倾身靠了过来，眼中有什么奇怪的神情逐渐浮现。

"你很清楚，Philip Andrada 的愿景已经失去了往日的辉煌，完全腐朽殆尽。各部委都沉沦在内斗和腐败之中。我们的舰队里挤满了无才的渎职者，我们的工厂都掌控在堕落的贪污犯手里。曾让我们成就强权霸业的优良军事作风，现在也已经不复存在了 —— 我们必须夺回这一切。"

"最高元首已经不再是他本人了，说不定都已经去世了。我们都在看全息影像，但谁又能明白那些是真是假？营私舞弊的参谋们现在正忙着乘机谋取私利，因此重担就落在了我们这些铭记了鲜血和汗水，忠于伟大运动的前线军官身上了。我们要挺身而出，拯救强权！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He takes a deep breath with closed eyes, then looks on you with renewed vigor. "And you. You are an outsider, you are the perfect wedge for my plan to alter the course of history."

He holds a hand up to stop your reply.

"No, not yet. We must speak in the flesh," he taps something, and your comm-link receives coordinates - an address on Volturn. "There is a safehouse under my personal authority. OpSec will be assured."

$Rank Ram gives a quick nod and signs off.
texts.zh:
他闭上眼睛深吸了一口气，然后带着全新的活力看向你。"而你，你是个外人，你就是我改变历史进程的计划中最完美的楔子。"

他举起一只手打断了你的回复。

"不，还不到时候。我们必须面对面谈。" 他按了什么，接着你的通讯链接收到了一个坐标 —— Volturn 上的一个地点。"那儿有我私人管理的一个安全屋。可以保证行动安全。"

$Rank Ram 快速地点了一下头，然后断开了通讯。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He wants to set up some kind of secret meeting. It could not be a more perfect opportunity for revenge.

Your mind races with possibilities- a hidden weapon to cover the kinetic element, a secret holorec rig to record whatever treason or blackmail or scheme he has planned. It would not be so difficult to have a small squad of your most elite marines ready to move at an invisible signal.
texts.zh:
他想弄一个什么秘密会议。再也没有比这更完美的复仇机会了。

你的脑海里快速运转，考虑着各种可能 —— 一把将动能部分隐藏起来的暗器，一个用来录制他在计划的什么叛国勒索密谋的隐藏全息录像装置。带一小队你最精锐的陆战士兵也不太难，他们只要一个隐形的信号就能出动。

texts.en:
He wants to set up some kind of secret meeting. It is unclear whether his actions are legal within the Diktat, and unclear what power-play between competing ministries this might represent.

You would do well to have a hidden weapon, and a holorec rig to record whatever treason, blackmail, or other scheme Ram might be planning. It would not even be difficult to have a squad of elite marines ready to move at an invisible signal.
texts.zh:
他想弄一个什么秘密会议。也不知道他的行为在 辛达强权 内是否合法，或者这又代表了各部门之间权力斗争的哪部分。

你最好带一把隐秘的武器，一个用来录制 Ram 计划中的不管是什么叛国、勒索还是其他阴谋的全息录像装置。甚至带一小队你最精锐的陆战士兵也不太难，他们只要一个隐形的信号就能出动。

texts.en: You consider your options for this encounter.
texts.zh: 你考虑着这件事上能做的准备。

texts.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat has strayed from its course," says Ram, leaning in, an odd gleam to his eyes now apparent.

"The Supreme Executor is no longer at the helm of the ship of state; holos appear with his image, yes, but they can be faked. It is obvious that the ministries have fallen to in-fighting and self-serving corruption, our warfleets given to profit-driven bloat."

"Without the true vision of the Supreme Executor, the center cannot hold. Corrupt advisors rule now, and are influenced by shadowy forces funded by our enemies. Something must be done!"
texts.zh:
"辛达强权 偏离了它的航线。" Ram 倾身靠了过来，眼中有什么奇怪的神情逐渐浮现。

"最高元首已经不再是这座舰船的掌舵人；他的全息影像还会出现，没错，但那是能伪造的。显然各部委都沉沦在内斗和腐败之中，我们的舰队被贪求利益、鼻孔朝天的人掌控。"

"没了最高首长真正的指引，一切都会四分五裂。现在掌权的顾问不但腐败，他们还被藏在暗地里由我们的敌人资助的势力指使。必须要做点什么！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I knew who you were before entering that bar, yes," Ram says with a self-satisfied smirk.

"I am not merely a uniform. I follow orders, yes, but I have been watching the way of things for a long time. I have been speaking with like-minded officers loyal to the Andradan Movement, who know the blood and sweat of our struggle."

Ram leans in, an odd gleam to his eyes now apparent. "It is obvious that the Sindrian Diktat has fallen to rot. Do you imagine Andrada is truly in command? With the ministries fallen to self-serving infighting? He would never allow it. Things have changed since the old days. He would sooner die than let his vision come to this... this degeneracy! Something must be done!"
texts.zh:
"我早在踏入那个酒吧前就知道你是谁了，没错。" Ram 说着露出了一个自鸣得意的笑容。

"我不止是个普通军人。我确实遵从命令，但我观察事态发展也有段时间了。我一直在和想法相同、忠于 Andrada 伟大运动的军官交谈，他们知道我们争斗付出的血与汗。"

Ram 倾身靠了过来，眼中有什么奇怪的神情逐渐浮现。"显然 辛达强权 已经堕落腐烂。你以为 Andrada 真的还在掌权吗？他绝对不会允许各部委都沉沦在内斗之中。情况已经变得和往日不同了。他宁可死也不会让他的理想发展成这种...决疣溃痈的样子！必须得做点什么！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You survived," Ram says, with the barest hint of ruthless delight. "You are a survivor, yes? Stronger now for overcoming. In the words of the Supreme Executor, 'Pain's gift is clarity.'"

"You see, I was merely acting my part in the grand tower of authority necessary to maintain order. If it were not me in the uniform that day, it would have been another." Ram leans in, an odd gleam to his eyes now apparent. "Don't you see? It is bigger than me or you. Hold your animal instinct in check, and listen."

"The Sindrian Diktat is drifting, leaderless. Do you imagine Andrada is really in command? With the ministries fallen to infighting and self-serving corruption? He would never allow it. He would sooner die than let his vision come to this! Something must be done!"
texts.zh:
"你活下来了。" Ram 说道，带着一丝残忍的快感，"你是个幸存者，嗯？现在为了战胜困难变得更强了。用最高元首的话来说：'苦痛的礼物是明晰'。"

"要知道，我只是在做权力的高塔中维持秩序的必要的一部分而已。如果那天穿着制服的不是我，也会是另一个人。" Ram 倾身靠了过来，眼中有什么奇怪的神情逐渐浮现，"你还不明白吗？这是大于你我的事。控制住你的动物本能，好好听着。"

"辛达强权 此刻漂泊不定、群龙无首。你以为 Andrada 真的还在掌权吗？他绝对不会允许各部委都沉沦在内斗之中。他宁可死也不会让他的理想发展成这种样子！必须得做点什么！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Precisely," Ram leans in, an odd gleam to his eyes now apparent.

"It has become a hateful thing, hasn't it? It is nothing like the early days, when strong men pure of spirit knew what needed to be done. The course of state has strayed! It is obvious that Supreme Executor Andrada is no longer at the helm, that he no longer truly leads us. It is tragic, isn't it? A great man reduced to this by declining health and bad advisors. It is obvious but unsaid that the ministries have fallen to in-fighting and self-serving corruption."

"The great tower of authority, that great man which once gave order to the world... it is all crumbling. Something must be done!"
texts.zh:
"正是如此。" Ram 倾身靠了过来，眼中有什么奇怪的神情逐渐浮现。

"辛达强权 已经变成了一个让人厌恶的玩意，不是吗？已经和往日完全不同了，那时灵魂纯净强大的人知道该做什么。这个国家已经偏离轨道了！显然最高元首 Andrada 已经不再是掌舵人，不再真正的带领着我们。真是悲剧，不是吗？一个伟大的人堕落于此，全赖每况愈下的身体还有糟糕的顾问。显然各部委都沉沦在内斗和腐败之中，只是没人说出来而已。"

"权力的巨塔，那位曾经给世界带来秩序的大人...都在崩塌。必须要做点什么！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: And you swore that revenge would be yours. Now might be your chance, if you play this right. But what's his game here, why is he approaching you?
texts.zh: 而你发过誓要报这一箭之仇。搞不好现在正是个好机会，就看你能不能把握住了。但他这是在玩什么花样？他为什么要主动接近你？

texts.en:
And you understood that he was simply exercising the power he had, as he must from his position. Now he's back. What game is he playing? Does he even remember you?

He must.
texts.zh:
而你也理解他只是单纯地行使了他的权威，做他在职位上必须去做的事情而已。但现在他又来了。他这是要玩什么花样？难道他还记得你不成？

他绝对记得。

texts.en:
You returned to your ship where some fine med-tech did its work. Now he's back. What game is he playing? Does he even remember you?

He must.
texts.zh:
你当时回到了你的船上，让那些优秀医疗技术人员派上了用场。现在他回来了。但现在他又来了。他这是要玩什么花样？难道他还记得你不成？

他绝对记得。

options.en: Prepare a shuttle to Yannick Ram's safehouse
options.zh: 准备一架去 Yannick Ram 的安全屋的穿梭机

texts.en: You inspect the shuttle that will take you to the surface of Volturn. Your tech officer, armorer, personal guards, and pilot attend.
texts.zh: 你检查着带你去 Volturn 地表的穿梭机。你的技术军官，军械员，私人守卫，还有驾驶员也在场。

options.en: Board the shuttle and fly to Ram's Safehouse
options.zh: 登上穿梭机驶往 Ram 的安全屋

options.en: Prepare a concealable weapon
options.zh: 准备一把可以隐藏的武器

options.en: Equip a secret holorecorder rig
options.zh: 带一个隐秘的全息录像装置

options.en: Bring a squad of marines as backup
options.zh: 带一队陆战队员后援

options.en: On second thought, cancel the flight for now
options.zh: 转念想想，暂时先取消航程

texts.en: With a flash of the Sindrian Diktat's crest, the shuttle receives navigation instructions from orbital traffic control. The whorls of storms and rivers of clouds hang before you, over the shining Volturnian sea. Closer, you begin to make out the lights of floating habitats, sprawling farm envelopes, and transient mining platforms.
texts.zh: 随着 辛达强权 的徽标一闪而过，穿梭机收到了轨道交通管制中心的导航指令。风暴的漩涡与江河般流动的云层漂浮在你眼前，覆盖于闪亮的 Volturn 海面上。靠近些，你开始能分辨出浮动栖所，杂乱延伸着的农业舱和临时采矿平台。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The shuttle hits atmo with a barely perceptible change in the craft's harmonics.

As the surface grows closer, the glittering lights and reflections of artificial structures resolve into a sprinkling of garbage; plumes of smoke from processing plants, oil-slicks from extraction platforms, a spew of jetsam trailing from the overcrowded habs.

The current regime has allowed the industrial conglomerates to self-regulate provided they are politically reliable.
texts.zh:
穿梭机进入大气层时，其谐振频率产生了一点微不可查的变化。

随着地表越来越近，闪烁的灯光和人造结构的倒影融解为一片散落的垃圾堆：来自加工厂的滚滚浓烟、开采平台上的油污、拥挤不堪的栖息地后面抛洒的各种废弃物。

现政权已经允许工业巨头进行自我监管，只要它们在政治立场上足够可靠。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Ram's safehouse is in a logistics and warehousing complex attached to the spur of one such industrial cluster.

The air is thick with the sweet stench of petrochem.
texts.zh:
Ram 的藏身处毗邻某个工业园区的分支，处在一个物流和仓储区里。

空气中弥漫着石化产品那甜甜的油气味。

texts.en: Your disguised marine squad fans out, passing plausibly for workers on a shift-break snacking on nutrition bars and igniting narcosticks.
texts.zh: 你那支伪装起来的陆战队员小队呈扇状散开，装成在班间休息时吃点营养棒或者抽麻醉烟的工人。

texts.en: A quick glance at your datapad shows your perspective in perfect miniature; the holorec unit is working perfectly.
texts.zh: 你快速瞥了一眼数据平板，上面完美显示着你的影像；全息录像正常运行。

options.en: Step inside the safehouse
options.zh: 走进安全屋

texts.en:
A plainclothes INTSEC goon - obvious from their demeanor - opens the door, looks you over disapprovingly, and relieves you of your holstered sidearm before leading you down metal stairs to a dark inner room below the street level.

Yannick Ram sits at a cheap conference table, dismissing the goon with a wave. The door thuds shut behind you, its weight suggesting armor or shielding.

"Captain, captain. I am so pleased that you have joined me. We have much to discuss, much to do," Ram stands with a chilly smile.
texts.zh:
一个便衣的 INTSEC 人员 —— 从他的行为举止可以明显察觉 —— 打开了门，不以为然地审视着你。解下你的随身武器后，他接着带领你沿着金属楼梯通往街区之下的一个漆黑的套间。

Yannick Ram 坐在一张廉价的会议桌后，轻轻挥手打发走那个便衣人员。在你身后，门重重地关上了，发出一声闷响。这扇门重到不寻常，说不定用到了装甲板，再或者是加了防护层。

"舰长啊舰长。我很高兴你加入了我。我们还有很多事情需要讨论，很多事情要去做，" Ram 站起身来，脸上挂着冷冷的微笑。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Simply put, the plan - and my fellow patriots are in agreement - is to test and provoke the leaders of the Sindrian Diktat's three arms of power. They will either prove their loyalty to the vision of the Supreme Executor, Lion of Sindria, Philip Andrada, or they will show themselves to be corrupt cowards and traitors who must be executed to ensure the purity of the Great Cause."

"First, the navy. While the Grand Star Marshal is nominally in charge, he lies half-conscious in a clinic on Sindria. The Supreme Executor should have replaced him a cycle ago, but," Ram pauses significantly, "has not."

"In his place, Deputy Star Marshal Oxana Hyder commands the Askonia System Defense Armada. She is... unimaginative, and I suspect she regrets leaving the Hegemony behind during the Battle of Salus."
texts.zh:
"简而言之，计划 —— 我的爱国者同伴们一致同意了的 —— 是测试与煽动辛达强权三大派系的领导人。他们要么证明自己忠于最高元首，辛达瑞亚之狮 Philip Andrada 的伟大愿景，要么揭露自己是必须被处决的腐败懦夫与叛徒，以此确保伟业的纯粹性。"

"首先，是海军。尽管星际元帅名义上还是负责人，但他现在正半昏迷地躺在辛达瑞亚的诊所里。最高元首本应在一个星历年前就把他的职务移交出去，但是，" Ram 意味深长地停顿了一下，"并没有。"

"正坐在他位置上的，副星际元帅 Oxana Hyder 指挥着 Askonia 星系防御舰队。她这人...缺乏想象力，我怀疑她在 Salus 之战时就后悔离开了霸主。"

options.en: Play it cool for now; let him talk more
options.zh: 暂时不动声色；让他再说

options.en: Let him keep talking for a moment
options.zh: 让他继续说一会儿

options.en: Enough of this; prepare your weapon
options.zh: 够了；准备好你的武器

options.en: Let him talk; make sure the holorec is getting everything
options.zh: 让他说；确保你的全息录像记录一切

options.en: Prepare your weapon while he's distracted with himself
options.zh: 趁他分心时准备好你的武器

options.en: See if you can find a makeshift weapon while he's distracted
options.zh: 看你能否在他分心时找到把临时武器

options.en: See if you can find a makeshift weapon while he's distracted
options.zh: 看你能否在他分心时找到把临时武器

options.en: Call in the marine squad
options.zh: 呼叫陆战队

texts.en:
"Next, Guard High Deputy Executor Horacio Caden. By the decree of Diktat, he holds the second-in-command rank to the Supreme Executor, and leads the Lion's Guard which is sworn to protect the person of Philip Andrada and the integrity of his political and spiritual vision."

Ram clenches his jaw; anger now showing through. "Caden has clearly failed. He is a dogmatic simpleton, repeating the words of the Lion without feeling them, knowing them! They do not BURN in his heart as they do in ours!"

Captain Ram is almost shouting toward the ceiling. Perhaps addressing Caden and the other misguided followers of the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh:
"下一个，是卫队最高副首长 Horacio Caden。按照辛达的法规，他是 最高元首 之下第一人。而且，那宣誓保卫 Philip Andrada 人身安全，确保他那高远的政治精神愿景完美无缺的 狮心卫队，也在副队长的统领之下。"

Ram 咬牙切齿，怒火中烧。"Caden 很明显辜负了他的职责。他就是个照本宣科的白痴，只知道一遍遍重复雄狮的话语，却完全对它们无知无觉！雄狮的教导没有在他心中熊熊燃烧，而我们不同！"

海军上校 Ram 几乎是冲着天花板大喊大叫。也或许，这场演说是冲着 Caden 和 辛达强权 那些误入歧途的拥护者来的。

texts.en:
There's a muffled thump.

Ram's goon dropping something? But the weight of the door suggests it would take a great deal more force to make a sound which could be heard in this room.

"... Which brings me to Chief High Inspector-General Dolos Macario," Ram continues, almost spitting, "Head of the internal security services of which I am of course a part. Never was there a more..."

Ram pauses in his tirade, lifting a hand to his ear. He turns to you with a confused look.
texts.zh:
你听到了很模糊的咚咚声。

难不成是 Ram 的手下扔下了什么东西？但，既然藏身所的门这么厚重，如果有什么事情产生的声音能隔着这扇门听到，那...肯定要比扔东西用力来得猛得多。

 "...接下来，我就得讲讲最高检察长 Dolos Macario 了。" Ram 继续讲着，口水飞溅，简直像是在咒骂着，"他是内安部的首领，自然，和我是一个部门的。这世上，就没有过比他更..."

Ram 的长篇大论突然停下了。他抬起一只手，放在耳边，然后转身面向你，满脸疑惑。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The door flies open in a flash, the thud of a shockwave buffets you back a half-step, ears ringing.

Blurred shadows burst in, targeting lasers flickering, firearms covering you and Ram. Through the settling cloud of dust steps a man in a long black coat over a perfect black uniform.

Ram gapes, hands raised; now, mercifully, at a loss for words.
texts.zh:
随着一道剧烈的闪光，门在一瞬间被炸飞了。砰然而至的冲击波好好地赏了你一耳光，打得你双耳嗡嗡作响，不由得退了半步。

一群不速之客的模糊身影突入了房间，数不清的激光瞄准器闪烁着，表明你和 Ram 全身上下已经被一堆武器给瞄了个遍。踏过逐渐落定的尘埃，一位身着全黑制服，披着纯黑外套的男人走进了房间。

Ram 举起了自己的双手，被吓得目瞪口呆。谢天谢地，这家伙终于闭上他那张臭嘴了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The pistol in the man's hand barks once.

Yannick Ram falls to the ground, dead.
texts.zh:
男人手里的枪发出一声爆鸣。

Yannick Ram 倒在地上，死去了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName," says Dolos Macario, head of the Sindrian Diktat internal security ministry, in-person.

The Spider of Sindria, they call him, who lurks in the Lion's shadow and strings up his enemies, extracts their secrets, and makes them suffer before they are 'disappeared'.

Macario's weapon is aimed at you, now.

"What an awkward first meeting." He glances down, then looks back up, smiling like a corpse. "My humblest apologies."
texts.zh:
"$playerName 舰长。" Dolos Macario，辛达强权内部安全部总指挥，其本人在你面前开口说道。

辛达瑞亚之蛛，人们颤抖着如此称呼。他潜伏在雄狮的阴影中，束缚每一个落入他手中的敌人，榨取殆尽每一分秘密，让他们在 "销声匿迹" 之前受尽折磨。

Macario 的武器正指着你。

"多么尴尬的初次会面。" 他低头瞥了一眼，然后抬起头来，脸上的微笑宛若尸骸，"我致以诚挚的歉意。"

options.en: He earned this.
options.zh: 这是他咎由自取。

options.en: He was mine to kill. For justice.
options.zh: 本来我为了伸张正义，也要杀了他的。

options.en: He was mine to kill. For revenge.
options.zh: 本来我为了报仇雪恨，也要杀了他的。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Macario looks at you reasonably, "In that we are agreed."
texts.zh: Macario 看向你，做出一副通情达理的样子，"我们在这方面看法倒是一致。"

texts.en:
"But first," he dips his pistol once toward the floor. "Would you be so good?"

As you hesitate, he says "The grenades. All of them. Six, I believe."
texts.zh:
"但首先，" 他把手枪朝地面虚点了一下，"你能帮我个小忙吗？"

当你还没反应过来时，他说："手榴弹，全交出来，我相信你有六枚。"

texts.en:
"But first," he dips his pistol once toward the floor. "Would you be so good?"

As you hesitate, he says "Your clever little pistol. Drop it."
texts.zh:
"但首先，" 他把手枪朝地面虚点了一下，"你能帮我个小忙吗？"

当你还没反应过来时，他说："放下你那聪明的小手枪。"

texts.en:
"But first," he dips his pistol once toward the floor. "Would you be so good?"

As you hesitate, he says, enunciating sharply, "The knife."
texts.zh:
"但首先，" 他把手枪朝地面虚点了一下，"你能帮我个小忙吗？"

当你还没反应过来时，他说道，语音清晰而又尖锐，"刀。"

texts.en:
"But first," he dips his pistol once toward the floor. "Would you be so good?"

As you hesitate, he says "The spray capsules in your cuffs. All of them. Keep them pointed toward the ground."
texts.zh:
"但首先，" 他把手枪朝地面虚点了一下，"你能帮我个小忙吗？"

当你还没反应过来时，他说："你袖口里的喷雾胶囊，把它们全都对着地板。"

texts.en:
"But first," he dips his pistol once toward the floor. "Would you be so good?"

As you hesitate, he says "The monomolecular wire. I admire your verve, but let us be civilized about this."
texts.zh:
"但首先，" 他把手枪朝地面虚点了一下，"你能帮我个小忙吗？"

你正犹豫时，他说道："你的单分子线，我敬佩你的活力，但还是让我们做一回文明人吧。"

texts.en:
"But first," he dips his pistol once toward your scabbard, "Your clasp is loose."

As you hesitate, he says "The sword of an officer must be kept secure, yes? Mustn't have an accident, nor draw such a blade in haste."
texts.zh:
"但首先，" 他把手枪朝你的剑鞘虚点了一下，"你的扣环松了。"

你正犹豫时，他说道："军官的剑一定要保管好，对吧？不应该发生意外，也不应该仓促拔出这样的剑。"

texts.en: "I would expect you would know this, considering your misadventure on Eventide," he says with mock-concern. "But let us not open old wounds."
texts.zh: "考虑到你在 Eventide 上的不幸遭遇，我还以为你早该明白了，" 他一边说着，一边强装出一副关心你的样子，哪怕嘲讽之情早已溢于言表，"可是，我们还是别揭那块伤疤了吧。"

texts.en: Macario's eyes flick to lead yours to Ram's corpse on the floor. The blood is pooling.
texts.zh: Macario 眼睛一瞥，引得你也看向了地上 Ram 的尸体。血液在地上越积越多。

texts.en: "We need not repeat your little adventure on Eventide here, yes? You will find that we have a much more modern attitudes in Askonia."
texts.zh: "不用你再重复 Eventide 上的那场小冒险了，知道吗？想再来的话，你就能知道在 Askonia 我们的反应手段可要现代得多了。"

options.en: Call your marine squad with the subvocal keyphrase
options.zh: 说出暗号，召来你的陆战队员

options.en: Drop your weapons
options.zh: 放下所有武器

options.en: Drop your weapon
options.zh: 放下武器

options.en: Secure your scabbard's clasp
options.zh: 确保你的剑鞘扣好

texts.en:
You whisper the codeword under your breath.

Nothing.

Macario sighs expressively, pistol steady on your center of mass. "Your squad is detained. Some of them, anyway. Now, shall we have a civilized discussion?"
texts.zh:
你低声念出暗号。

没有回应。

Macario 意味深长地叹了口气，手枪依然稳稳地瞄准着你的正中心。"你的小队被拘留了。至少是他们中的一部分人。回到正题，我们现在可以开始文明地交流了吗？"

texts.en:
He holsters his pistol and, stepping over Ram's cooling body, draws a chair from the table.

"Let us sit for a moment. All this excitement... I would very much like to have a chat with you."
texts.zh: 他把枪插回枪套，随后径直走向桌边，踏过 Ram 尚有余温的尸体，从桌边又抽走了一把椅子。"我们坐一会吧。刚经历了这种刺激的事...我可很想和你聊聊。"

texts.en: The squad's targeting lasers hold steady on you.
texts.zh: 对方整个小队纹丝不动，所有人的瞄准激光都稳稳的锁在你身上。

texts.en: "Justice?" Macario raises his eyebrows, "How interesting."
texts.zh: "正义？" Macario 扬起了他的眉毛，"真有趣。"

texts.zh: Macario 眼睛一瞥，引得你也看向了地上 Ram 的尸体。血液在地上越积越多。

texts.en: "We need not repeat your little adventure on Eventide here, yes? You will find that we have a much more modern attitudes in Askonia."
texts.zh: "不用你再重复 Eventide 上的那场小冒险了，知道吗？想再来的话，你就能知道在 Askonia 我们的反应手段可要现代得多了。"

texts.en: With a light touch you feel the comforting mass of your weapon of choice. Ram sees nothing, distracted by his own monologue.
texts.zh: 你轻轻一碰自己选择的武器，它的质量让人安心。Ram 什么也没看见，继续专注在他自己的长篇大论中。

texts.en: You slip one of the grenades into your hand and hold it in place with your thumb.
texts.zh: 你将一枚手榴弹滑入手中，并用拇指将其固定到位。

texts.en: You slip the tiny pistol out of its hiding place by pretending to stretch your shoulders. You have it in your lap now, covered by your crossed hand.
texts.zh: 你假装伸了伸肩膀，把小手枪从它的藏处偷偷拿了出来。现在它在你的大腿上，被你交叉的双手盖着。

texts.en: You slip the vibroknife out of its hiding place by pretending to stretch. Now it is hidden in the cuff of your uniform, read to draw and activate.
texts.zh: 你假装伸了个懒腰，把震动刀从它的藏处偷偷拿了出来。它现在藏在你的制服的袖口里，随时可以拔出激活。

texts.en: You pull the cuffs of your uniform straighter, ensuring the deadly spray will hit your intended target, and flex your wrist in anticipation of deployment.
texts.zh: 你把自己制服的袖口拉直了点，确保致命的喷雾能击中你想要的目标，同时活动了一下手腕，做好了释放喷雾的预备动作。

texts.en: You rub your hands together, twisting the false fingertip just so. It is ready to deploy the deadly monomolecular wire with a flick of your hand.
texts.zh: 你搓了搓双手，微微扭了下假指尖。只要你一挥手它就能甩出致命的单分子金属丝。

texts.en: You brush the leg of your uniform as if clearing it of imagined dust, loosing the protective clasp that keeps the sword from drifting out of its scabbard. You tense your muscles, ready to draw steel in a single motion.
texts.zh: 你就像是在清理不存在的灰尘一样捋了捋自己制服的下摆，松开了套着剑不让它滑出剑鞘的保护扣。你绷紧了肌肉，准备好了一下拔出武器。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
With Ram distracted by pacing and ranting, you take a peek at your datapad. The holorec rig reads all-green, but the signal seems to be rapidly degrading. There must be some kind of interference- an automated counter-signal unit in the safehouse?

Will Ram be alerted if you keep transmitting?
texts.zh:
在 Ram 怒吼着踱步分心时，你偷看了一眼自己的数据平板。全息录像装置的指标一切正常，但信号正在快速衰减。这安全屋里肯定是有什么干扰 —— 一个自动信号反制装置？

你继续传输的话 Ram 会不会发现？

options.en: Keep transmitting; more blackmail material means more leverage
options.zh: 继续传输；更多的黑料代表更多筹码

options.en: Turn off transmission; record to hard memory to not set off an alert
options.zh: 关闭传输；记录在硬盘内存上防止惊动对方

texts.en:
Your eyes dart around, looking for something useful. The table itself is light metal and plastic, as are the folding chairs. Their mass is insufficient for a bludgeon.

The lighting is provided by a few rapidly degrading peel-off glowstrips; useless. In the shadows of the room your eyes catch on some liquid storage barrels - water? - and  a few hand-cargo containers. Padded, with rounded corners for zero-G safety.

Ram has a sidearm on his belt. It would take him but a moment to draw it. Or if he came closer to you...
texts.zh:
你的眼睛快速地四处张望，寻找着能利用的东西。桌子本身是轻金属和塑料材质，折叠椅也是如此。它们的质量作为重器砸人有些不够看。

光照是由几条正在快速变暗的撕拉式荧光带提供的；毫无用处。你瞥到房间的阴影里有几桶液体 —— 淡水吗？—— 还有几个手提货物箱。它们都被软垫覆盖了，还是圆边角，确保了零重力环境下的安全。

Ram 的腰带上有把随身武器，他是不用废什么功夫就能轻松抽出来。但如果他靠你更近一些的话...

texts.en:
You whisper the codeword under your breath as Ram rants.

Nothing. You tap your earpiece, making as if you are scratching your ear, and it gives the tiny buzz denoting signal disconnection.

There must be some kind of active interference. This secure comms rig is outrageously overrated for even moderately fortified military defenses. Ram must be running a highly sophisticated automated counter-signal unit. Would it alert him to your attempt at comms?

His disposition, though agitated, seems unchanged.
texts.zh:
趁着 Ram 咆哮时，你低声说出暗号。

没有回应。你装作挠耳朵的样子轻敲了一下耳机，它发出了轻微的蜂鸣声，指示信号已断开。

一定是某种主动干扰。这套安全通讯装置厉害到能突破一般程度的军事强化防御措施。Ram 肯定启动了什么尖端的自动信号反制装置。它会因为你试图进行通讯而警告他吗？

他的神情依然暴躁，似乎没有变化。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Your armorer has a set of immaculate metal cases brought to the hangar for your inspection. Each is opened in turn, displaying an impressive variety of hand weapons. Matte black predominates; there are tiny plastic bombs, a spectrum of pistols, ceramic knives with powered or unpowered blades, a series of chemical sprays in hidden capsules, and even a false fingertip containing a monomolecular cutting filament.

What would Ram never expect?
texts.zh:
你的军械员把一整套整洁利落的各式金属箱带到了机库供你检查。每个箱子依次打开，展示出里面种类繁多的各式手持武器。大部分的武器都是哑光黑色的，其中有一些小型塑胶炸弹，大小不同的各式手枪，几把陶瓷制成的小刀和动力刃，一系列用隐蔽容器携带的化学喷剂，甚至还有个装了单分子切割丝的假指头。

还有哪些能让 Ram 大吃一惊的呢？

options.en: A clutch of small plastic grenades
options.zh: 一串塑料小手榴弹

options.en: A matte-black polycarbonate pistol
options.zh: 一把哑光黑的聚碳酸酯手枪

options.en: A vicious ceramic vibroknife
options.zh: 一把陶瓷超震动刀

options.en: A tiny capsule of spray-poison
options.zh: 一小罐毒喷雾

options.en: The monomolecular wire
options.zh: 单分子金属丝

options.en: No weapon; you don't need one
options.zh: 不带武器；你不需要

options.en: The sword of an officer, like you used on Eventide
options.zh: 军官佩剑，和你在 Eventide 决斗时用的那把一样

options.en: The sword of an officer, like you used on Eventide
options.zh: 军官佩剑，和你在 Eventide 决斗时用的那把一样

texts.en:
Your armorer walks you through the process of activating as well as deactivating the grenades, and familiarizes you with their timing and throw-weight. You conceal a half-dozen of them about your uniform.

The infernal little things pack a devilish punch.
texts.zh:
你的军械员一步步讲解了激活和解除手榴弹的过程，且让你熟悉其引信时长和投掷重量。你在你的制服上藏了六个这样的东西。

这些可恶的小东西充满了邪恶的力量。

texts.en:
Your armorer ensures the pistol is unloaded, then hands it and two cellmags to you. It's a little shadow of a thing, and darker still, the armorer explains, on most personal scanners.

You load the pistol, ensure its status is green and safety is locked, then conceal it on your person. It weighs barely anything, but can punch a fist-sized hole through flesh without breaching standard bulkheads.
texts.zh:
你的军械员确保手枪已经退膛净空，然后将它和两个能量弹匣一起交给了你。军械员解释说，在大多数的个人扫描仪上，它看起来会像是某件杂物的小黑影，不过要更暗点。

你给手枪充能上膛，检查其状态良好之后锁上了保险，将其藏在自己身上。它几乎没什么分量，但可以在不破坏标准舱壁的前提下，将肉体打出一个拳头大小的洞。

texts.en:
Your armorer demonstrates activating the knife; the blade blurs slightly and you hear the keening of a small insect at the edge of your hearing. This knife, when active, could slice a new opening into your shuttle.

Your armorer deactivates it, then expertly flips the knife around to offer you the handle. You conceal it on your person.
texts.zh:
你的军械员演示了如何激活这把刀。刀刃变得略微模糊，你似乎听到有只小虫子在你听力的上限附近发出了尖啸。这把刀启动之后能轻易地帮你在穿梭机上开个新出口。

你的军械员将其关闭，然后熟练地翻转刀子，将刀柄递给你。你把它贴身藏好。

texts.en:
Your armorer affixes the sprays inside your uniform cuffs - they would pass for subtle fabric-stiffening clips - and, with safeties on, demonstrates the motion required to activate the spray.

With a mere flick of the hand and a demon's exhalation you could ensure the rapid loss of consciousness or death of a small cluster of adult humans within a range of a few meters. The poisons would then react with self-contained nanotech pseudo-proteins to dissolve into a wisp of molecules which could be plausibly found on any imperfectly maintained spacefaring vessel.
texts.zh:
你的军械员在制服袖口里贴上了喷雾器，就像些用来让衣物保持笔挺的小饰物一样不起眼。然后在保险工作的情况下，展示了激活喷雾器所需的动作。

只需轻轻一挥手，恶魔的吐息就会喷涌而出，你就保证能让几米范围内的一小群成年人迅速失去意识或死亡。随后，毒性物质会和一套纳米技术伪蛋白质发生反应，降解成随便在哪个有点小毛病的远航星舰上都可以见到的一些常见物质分子，能够以假乱真。

texts.en:
"Ah," your armorer can't help but smile, "A classic."

They affix the false-fingertip to your hand, allowing it a moment to match the color and texture of your finger, then demonstrate how to unspool the weighted tip into a deadly filament which you can use like an molecule-width cutting garrote, or swing in a severing arc.
texts.zh:
"啊。" 你的军械员情不自禁地笑了，"经典之选。"

他们将假指尖贴在你的手上，让它和你手指的颜色和纹路相匹配，然后演示了如何用加重的尖端甩出一条致命的丝线。你可以用这只有几个分子宽的丝线绞断脖颈，或挥出一道能撕裂一切的弧线。

texts.en: Your ops chief lifts an eyebrow but manages to hide their smile. Your armorer merely nods compliance, then begins securing the miniature arsenal.
texts.zh: 你的行动长官挑了挑眉毛，但还是掩饰住了笑容。你的军械员只是点头称是，然后开始确保小型军火库的安全。

texts.en:
Your armorer lifts an eyebrow then gives a quiet order via hand-comms. Within the minute, a crewmember brings your sword, handing it off to your armorer who then offers the flat to you using two hands, as is correct.

You secure the scabbard to your belt in the style of the conservative elements of the Hegemony officer corps. The weight of hand-forged steel is reassuring.
texts.zh:
你的军械员眉头轻挑，用手势发出了一个无声的指令。不到一分钟的功夫，一位船员就找来你的佩剑把它转交给你的军械员。随后军械员双手平托着将佩剑呈给你，像是按照什么规定好的一样。

你遵照 霸主 军官团的传统风格将剑鞘系在腰间。手工锻造的钢铁之重，令你倍感安心。

texts.en:
Your technology officer proudly offers you a small case.

The holorec unit is a whisper of transmitter wire visible only when it catches the light, fine as a hair, and a couple small dermal patches to be placed around your face and head. Even without the passive-camo system active, it is difficult to see the individual components of the rec unit without knowing what to look for.
texts.zh:
你的技术军官自豪地递给你一个小盒子。

这个全息录像装置是一套传输线组成的弱信号传播报告器，只能在光照下被看到，其精细程度与头发丝无异。另有几片小的皮肤贴片，粘在了你的面部与头部周围。即使不去激活被动伪装系统，如果没有明确搜查的目标，也很难发现录像装置的各个组件。

texts.en:
You order a half-dozen of your most experienced marines to don stealth-op gear.

Their outer suits shimmer and rustle, and six sleek black marines in light armor transform before you into a group of civilian technicians wearing vague impressions of vac-safety gear and overalls.

You have to but whisper the code-phrase and they will perform a rapid assault - through airlock and bulkhead if necessary - to secure your position.
texts.zh:
你叫来六名经验最丰富的陆战队员并给他们穿上潜行装备。

在他们的外层战斗服一阵闪烁作响后，六名身着漆黑轻甲的陆战队员在你面前变化成了一群大众化到难有印象的，穿着真空防护装备的平民技工。

只需轻声说出暗语，他们就会迅速执行突击行动 —— 必要时突破气闸和舱壁 —— 以确保你所处位置的安全。

texts.en:
"Captain Ram was a traitor and has met the end which all traitors deserve," Macario leans back in the cheap folding chair, looking thoughtful.

"I am embarrassed to admit that he was also - in the broad strokes - correct in his assessment of the current state of our dear Sindrian Diktat. And his plan is a reasonable one."

"I have decided to enact it, with your cooperation."
texts.zh:
"Ram 上校是个叛徒，他的下场纯属罪有应得。" Macario 靠在那把便宜货折叠椅上，看起来若有所思。

 "但，说来尴尬，他那番发言不仅相当平实，对我们敬爱的 辛达强权 评价也是鞭辟入里。他的计划也甚是合理。"

 "我决定，要执行他的计划，还要你来与我合作，舰长。"

options.en: I get it. What do you want done? Hypothetically.
options.zh: 明白了，那按照你的设想，我要做什么呢？

options.en: What do you wish done? Tell me how I may serve the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 您有何吩咐？请告诉我，该怎样为辛达强权效劳。

options.en: What's in it for me?
options.zh: 我参与这件事，有什么好处吗？

options.en: Why would you put such trust in me?
options.zh: 为什么，你就偏偏对我这么信任呢？

options.en: Why would I ever want to help you?
options.zh: 你怎么觉得，我会想要帮助你呢？

options.en: What plan? Ram spoke of treason.
options.zh: 什么计划？Ram 说的可是叛国的歪理。

options.en: What plan? He was rambling.
options.zh: 具体是什么计划？他说得乱七八糟的。

options.en: What plan? That unhinged ranting?
options.zh: 什么计划？就刚刚那人精神错乱的胡乱指责吗？

options.en: What do you mean by 'turn its gaze outward'?
options.zh: '放眼星系之外' 是什么意思？

options.en: Does Andrada know about this plan?
options.zh: Andrada 知道这个计划吗？

options.en: Does the Supreme Executor know about this plan?
options.zh: 最高元首知道这个计划吗？

options.en: Doesn't this conspiracy make you the traitor?
options.zh: 你这么密谋不就也变成叛徒了吗？

options.en: Are you a man with... ambition?
options.zh: 你是个...有野心的人？

options.en: The answer is 'no'.
options.zh: 答案是 '不'。

options.en: Of course. I live to serve the Sindrian Diktat. (lie)
options.zh: 当然了。我为侍奉辛达强权而活。 (说谎)

options.en: Of course. I live to serve the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 当然了。我为侍奉辛达强权而活。

texts.en:
"You begin to understand," says Macario. "Good."

"I shall provide you with a file. It concerns an officer under Deputy Star Marshal Hyder's command who she has ordered to meet with a smuggler to purchase armaments. This is, of course, treason."

"Hyder believes she must circumvent the bureaucracy to maintain the condition of the Defense Armada. She is correct; the Lion's Guard takes the lion's share," he makes a strange, suppressed noise at his own joke, "-of the military procurement budget. This provides us an opening; leverage."
texts.zh:
"你总算开始理解了。" Macario 说，"好啊。"

"我会发给你一份文件，内容关于 Hyder 副星际元帅手下某名军官。受 Hyder 所托，这位军官会私下面见某位走私贩子，从他那里购买武器。自然，这种行为算是叛国。"

"Hyder 相信，她必须绕开官方购买武器，才能保证星系防御舰队状态齐整。她倒是没错：狮心卫队确实经常狮子大开口。" Macario 一边自顾自的开着玩笑，一边发出某种沉郁的怪声 —— 或许是笑声，"准确的说，是在军备购入订单中，经常狮子大开口。总之，既然有她的把柄在手，你要与她对话就有切入口了，也就有杠杆可用了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Confront this officer. Arrest them. Or kill them if they resist, even destroy the fleet and keep the smuggled weapons, I don't care. I shall ensure after the fact that you are seen as, at worst, performing an accidental service to the Diktat."

"The purpose of this is to draw out Hyder. I shall ensure that she knows you were behind the interception. She will want to confront and eliminate you herself due to the sensitive nature of the matter."

Macario is having fun; you can tell. He lives for this.
texts.zh:
"去面见这位军官，逮捕这个家伙，胆敢反抗的话就干掉，哪怕你顺便把这人属下的舰队全灭，把这货的军火私吞也随便，我不计较。我能保证，哪怕情况最糟，我也能让大家认为你是临时起意要为辛达强权锄奸。"

"做这一套，就是为了引出 Hyder。我会让她知道，她的军官是被你私下里截了。这么一来，再考虑下这件事的敏感程度，她八成就要面见你，干掉你，让你噤声。"

你能感觉出来，Macario 说的很开心。毕竟，他可是干这种事为生的。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"This is your opening. Explain yourself as acting upon my orders for the Diktat, or representing a weapon supplier seeking to replace her previous contact. I'm sure you'll come up with something good. The point is, you'll have her attention, and you'll have her compromised."

"Find out her intentions; if she is willing to engage in open treason, or if pushed, will she side with myself: the legitimate authority in the upcoming struggle. Her rivalry with Caden and the Lion's Guard is well known, so that may be a good axis upon which to turn her."
texts.zh:
"这么一来，就到你了。要么跟她挑明你在按照我的指令，为辛达强权效力，要么就谎称你是新来的武器贩子，想要顶掉她之前联系的那一位，不管怎么说，我相信你能想好到时候该怎么讲。重点是，你会吸引到她的注意，同时还要让她受制。"

"探明她的想法：如果她想要公然进行叛乱，或是被人逼着要叛乱的话，她会在混乱中站在我，站在法定的权威派别这边吗？毕竟她与 Caden，与狮心卫队素有不和，所以说这个问题很适合拿来拉拢她。"

options.en: I serve the Sindrian Diktat!
options.zh: 我为辛达强权效劳！

options.en: I'll... see what I can do.
options.zh: 我就... 尽力而为吧。

options.en: Why don't I just talk to her?
options.zh: 为什么我就不能直接和她谈谈呢？

options.en: Why don't you just talk to her about all of this?
options.zh: 为什么你不直接和她谈谈这一切？

options.en: If she is engaging in treason, technically, why not eliminate her now?
options.zh: 严格来讲，如果说她真的涉嫌叛国的话，为什么不直接干掉她？

options.en: How would killing her subordinate possibly make Hyder trust me?
options.zh: 杀了 Hyder 的下属，怎么可能再让 Hyder 信任我呢？

options.en: I don't want to do this.
options.zh: 我不想这样做。

texts.en: There's a strange gleam in Macario's eyes at your words, but he seems to approve.
texts.zh: 听了你这话，Macario 眼里掠过一丝异样的光，不过看样子是赞许的。

texts.en:
"Ah," Macario raises a finger. "Just one thing, captain."

"You've been very, very bad," he wags his finger, scolding you. "I'll arrange matters to allow you to operate in Diktat space. But you must promise to behave. You'll behave?"

He doesn't wait for an answer, "Good."
texts.zh:
"啊，" Macario 用手势示意你噤声。"只是还有一件事，舰长。"

"你干过不少坏事，真是坏到极致了。" 他摇晃着食指数落你，"我会安排好你在辛达强权疆域内行动的相关事宜。但是你必须保证会守规矩。你能做到吗？"

他并没有等你给出确切回复，"很好。"

texts.en:
Stepping back onto what passes for a street, you look up at one of the ubiquitous flickering holos of Philip Andrada, Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat. You try to imagine the Lion of Sindria drooling and mindless, deep in some bunker-clinic, surrounded by increasingly panicked doctors.

Macario seems like a man who turns his capable subordinates into tools and his ambitious subordinates into corpses. But if you play along, for now, he readily provides generous rewards - and access to the heart of the Sindrian Diktat's upcoming power struggle.
texts.zh:
在从无名小路走回街道的途中，辛达强权 最高元首 Philip Andrada 的全息投影依然无处不在地闪耀着。你仰望起了其中一座，试着想象了一下着这位昔日的辛达瑞亚之狮，如今却嘴角流涎神志不清，不得不躺在地下深处的某个医疗地堡里，簇拥在旁的只剩下一群愈发惶恐的医生。

Macario 看来城府颇深，他习惯把安分称职的部下驯为能榨取价值的工具，也不介意把包藏野心的同僚化为用来垫脚爬权的尸骨。但是 —— 至少现在 —— 只要你配合，他就能给你备好厚赏，还能让你触及 辛达强权 接下来争权夺势的风暴眼。

texts.en: An idle thought prompts you to check the holorec's memory. It's been remote hacked; your feed has been replaced by an old Andrada propaganda experience. Macario's little joke, you suppose.
texts.zh: 你突然想起什么，检查了全息录像机的储存内容：有人远程骇入了你的全息录像机，把你拍摄的内容都替换成了某份古旧的 Andrada 宣传全息体验卡带内容。你猜，这可能是那位 Macario 开的小小玩笑。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "You're welcome to try," Macario says smugly. "Without an opening, however, you will get nothing. I know how she works."
texts.zh: "你大可一试。" Macario 说着，满脸得意。"可是，不找个切入口的话，你和她什么都谈不成的，我可了解她的行事风格。"

texts.en:
Macario looses a breathy laugh.

"A fine and obvious suggestion, dear captain, but she hates me. That stubborn old woman won't have her mind changed by me, much less open her heart."
texts.zh:
Macario 长出了一口气，顺便笑了笑。

"亲爱的舰长，你的建议确实挺好，挺明白，但她可是恨着我呢。我不可能轻易让那个固执己见的老太太改变想法，让她敞开心扉的话更是别提。"

texts.en:
"And throw the Sindrian Diktat into civil war? With her in command of the System Defense Armada?" Macario rolls his eyes, "Listen to yourself."

"Timing," he hisses, "The time must be correct."
texts.zh:
"把 辛达强权 推向内战？还是在她负责星系防御舰队指挥权的时候？" Macario 翻了个白眼："瞧你说的。"

"时机。" 他嘘声说道，"时机必须正确无误。"

texts.en:
"You don't know her like I do, captain. She is a capable admiral, a brilliant logistician, and a dreadful politician. She loathes contradiction, inefficiency, and above all lies. When she must participate in such squalid affairs, she will be put off-balance and seek stability. Provide it."

Macario looks pleased with himself. "It is trivial to manipulate her. I trust, with my help, you are capable of it."
texts.zh:
"舰长，你可不如我懂她。她是一位能干的将军、出色的后勤专家，却也是个糟糕的政客。她讨厌纷争、低效，最令她讨厌的则是谎言。如果说她必须参与叛国这种肮脏事的话，她的心境一定相当不平和，这种时候她就会想要寻求平衡，你给她平衡就好了。"

Macario 看起来相当得意："要操纵她可不需什么力气。我相信，只要有我帮忙，连你也能操纵她。"

texts.en:
Macario produces a rictus of a smile.

"Play your part, captain. You will find the rewards incalculable."
texts.zh:
Macario 做了个咧嘴一笑的样子。

"完成你的职责，舰长。你会发现回报远超预期。"

texts.en:
"Influence, credits, advanced spacecraft hulls, experimental weapons..."

Macario spreads his hands wide, a river of generosity, then takes a moment to whisper into his cuff.

"That is a taste to ensure that I have your attention for the remainder of our conversation."

Within seconds, your personal comms ping a surprised response from your quartermaster.
texts.zh:
"影响力，星币，高级星舰船体，实验性武器..."

Macario 摊开手掌，仿佛比划着一条财宝聚成的河流。然后他花了点时间对着袖口低语。

"给你尝点甜头，这样接下来我们要谈的你就会认真听了。"

只是几秒内，你的私人通讯就传来了一条你的军需官诧异的回复。

texts.en: "An interesting question, captain."
texts.zh: "有趣的问题，舰长。"

texts.en:
"As the bearer of a commission of the Sindrian Diktat, you are already pledged to the grand vision of the Supreme Executor!"

"Hyder and Caden are more apt to trust you," Macario says, his tongue flicking around his teeth, "-and believe you; that they share whatever motives sleep in their hearts. Which we will discover."
texts.zh:
"作为 辛达强权 雇佣协议的签订者，你已经向 最高元首 的伟大宏远献身。"

"Hyder 和 Caden 会更倾向于信任你。" Macario 说着砸了咂舌，"—— 而且会听信你所言；这足以把他们内心沉睡的动机抖露出来。而我们要翻出来的就是这些动机。"

texts.en:
"You are viewed as a friend of the Sindrian Diktat, particularly among those of any consequence: the officers, the officials, and of course the party."

"Hyder and Caden are more apt to trust you," Macario says, his tongue flicking around his teeth, "-and believe you; that they share whatever motives sleep in their hearts. Which we will discover."
texts.zh:
"你已经被视为 辛达强权 的朋友，尤其是对于那些重要人士：军官，要员，当然还有党派。"

"Hyder 和 Caden 会更倾向于信任你。" Macario 说着，他的舌头在齿间轻弹，"—— 而且会听信你所言；这足以把他们内心沉睡的动机抖露出来。而我们要翻出来的就是这些动机。"

texts.en:
"You are considered suspect among those of consequence in the Sindrian Diktat; the officers, the bureaucrats, the party members."

"As an outsider, a provocateur, you are expected to hold outrageous political opinions which provides you with credibility to those of traitorous intent."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权 的重要人士：军官，官僚，党派成员都怀疑你。"

"但你看到了吗？作为一个局外人，一个挑衅者，你被期待有令人愤慨的政治观点，这让那些有叛国意图的人相信你。"

texts.en:
"You are hated among those of consequence in the Sindrian Diktat! You are to be shot on sight. Why, I should turn you in myself," Macario grins with genuine humor.

"But don't you see? As an outsider, a comrade of terrorists and traitors, you are my perfect friend: you will be trusted by internal enemies with traitorous intent."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权 的要员都对你恨之入骨！你应该被就地枪决。哦，我真该亲自送你上路的..." Macario 开怀大笑，带着几分诚挚的幽默。

"但你还没明白吗？作为一个局外人、一个恐怖分子和叛徒同党的你，是我完美的伙伴：你会被那些意图谋反的内敌分子所信任。"

texts.en:
"It was your work with the Galatia Academy, for Provost Baird, that first drew my interest." Macario seems delighted to tell you about this.

"Baird found in you an excellent..." he hesitates, searching for a different word, "-partner. An excellent and capable partner working toward great things for the Sector."

"Ah, that I might pry Baird's secrets away from the Hegemony," he adds quietly. "One day, one day."
texts.zh:
"你在 Galatia 学院为 Baird 院长工作的事情引起了我的关注，" 在 Macario 告诉你这些时，他似乎很高兴。

"Baird 发现你是一个卓越的..." 他犹豫了一下，斟酌着一个不同的词，"—— 合作伙伴。一个卓越而富有才能的合作伙伴，致力于为星域做出伟大的贡献。"

"啊，我多么希望能从 霸主 那儿发现 Baird 的秘密，" 他轻声补充道，"总有一天，总有一天。"

texts.en:
"You are a rising independent power. Such shifts, even small, have a way of upsetting the balance kept so carefully these past cycles."

"Do you understand how you instill fear into strategic planners? Your motives are... erratic. You could do anything. It's perfect."
texts.zh:
"你是一股正在崛起的独立势力。此类影响，哪怕微小，也可能打破过去几个星历年里，各方小心翼翼保持着的那种平衡。"

"你明白你给战略规划师们带来了怎样的恐惧吗？你的动机... 毫无规律。你什么事都做得出来。这简直完美。"

texts.en:
"It was your appearance of devotion to that quaint religion that drew my attention. You, of all people, becoming a pilgrim?"

Macario nearly giggles at the thought. "It's a splendid ruse. So absurd that I could not even believe it until I had it confirmed. No one will suspect you! They'll think you're a mush-headed Luddic out to balance the scales on your imagined soul!"
texts.zh:
"你对于那别样宗教表现出的虔诚，令我很在意。世间那么多人，而偏偏你成了一名朝圣者？"

Macario 想着想着，差点就笑了出来。"真是妙计！你表现出的虔诚深到荒谬，即便是我，也只有亲自确认之后才能相信你并非真心。没人能怀疑到你！别人都只会觉得你是个卢德蠢蛋，要以你那所谓的 '灵魂' 去度量一切呢。"

texts.en:
"It was your appearance of devotion to that quaint religion that drew my attention. You, of all people, a mere Luddic?"

Macario nearly giggles at the thought. "It's a splendid ruse. Simply splendid, captain. So absurd that I could not even believe it until I had it confirmed. No one will suspect you! They'll think you're a mush-headed Luddic out to balance the scales on your imagined soul!"
texts.zh:
"你对于那别样宗教表现出的虔诚令我很在意。世间万物如此纷繁，你却甘做一介卢德教徒？"

Macario 想着想着，差点就笑了出来。"真是妙计，太妙了，舰长！你表现出的虔诚深到荒谬，即便是我，也只有亲自确认之后才能相信你并非真心。没人能怀疑到你！别人都只会觉得你是个卢德蠢蛋，要以你那所谓的 '灵魂' 去度量一切呢。"

texts.en:
"Why, it is because you work for the enemy, the Hegemony!"

"The Diktat has always been a knife to their throat. Small, yes, but with a keen edge, a ruthlessness that the best of the officer corps could recognize, and those too craven to commit to Philip's vision look upon with jealousy. The children of Eventide wish they could dispense with the cloying ideology of the Domain and exercise a power truer and purer."

"And among us, there are now cowards who cringe from heroic destiny. You will sniff them out because you look like the possibility of defection."
texts.zh:
"你觉得呢，因为你为我们的敌人 霸主 效力！"

"辛达强权 一直是一柄架在 霸主 喉边的尖刀。没错，我们势力微弱，但即便是我们这把小刀，也有其锋芒。我们无情的战术，只有 霸主 最优秀的军官团识得，而其他那些无法为 Philip 之愿景尽力的懦夫，只能带着嫉妒仰视我们。Eventide 上的孩子们早就想要抛却 人之领 那陈腐到令人腻歪的意识形态，运用更加纯粹、更加真切的力量了。"

"现如今，我们中却也出了软脚虾，不愿为我们的英雄使命效力了。之所以你能够找到那帮叛徒，正是因为你简直和那帮叛徒一样软弱。"

texts.en:
"The answer is sheer power. You have an impressive independent fleet and no tremendously strong connection to any significant faction."

"Do you understand how that makes strategic planners fearful? Your motives are... erratic. You could do anything. It's perfect."
texts.zh:
"答案纯粹是力量使然。你手下有一支战力令人印象深刻的独立舰队，还与其他主要势力无甚瓜葛。"

"你明白这会给战略规划师们带来怎样的恐惧吗？你的动机... 毫无规律。你什么事都做得出来。这简直完美。"

texts.en:
Macario smiles thinly.

"The plan is simple enough. In light of the Supreme Executor's upcoming... transition, we must root out treason and corruption at the highest level - by which I mean, of course, those arms of the state which project violent force: the navy, in the person of Oxana Hyder, and the Lion's Guard, in the person of Horacio Caden."

"I, of course, see to the reliability of my own ministry," his eyes flick to indicate Ram's corpse.

"Once the means of force are purged of traitors, they shall burn out the rot that has taken root in this Great Project: the so-called Volturnian resistance and the double-blight of Nortia and Umbra in rebellion. Once our power-base in Askonia is consolidated, the Diktat may turn its gaze outward."
texts.zh:
Macario 浅浅地笑了笑。

"计划够简单了。鉴于最高元首将要发生...过渡，我们必须要拔除最高层之中的叛国者，腐败者。当然，所谓最高层，指的就是那几个负责行使暴力的国家部门：Oxana Hyder 负责的海军部队，还有 Horacio Caden 负责的狮心卫队。"

"至于我自己的部门，那当然就要我亲自负责了，" 他眼睛略微眨了眨，示意看看 Ram 的尸体。

"一旦暴力机器中不再有叛徒，它们就该马力全开，碾碎辛达瑞亚伟大愿景之上扎根的几块脓疮：不仅是所谓的 Volturn 反抗军，还有 Nortia 与 Umbra 这两个祸害。只要强权在 Askonia 的根基稳固下来，我们就可以放眼星系之外了。"

texts.en:
"You didn't get to your position without knowing the meaning of ambition, captain." Macario pins you with ice-cold eyes, "You of all people know full well that ambitions will be attacked on all sides by lesser men, whether from brutish ignorance or degenerate ideologies."

"The Sector is in turmoil. Imagine if its might and resources were focused by the vision of a man with... ambition."
texts.zh:
"舰长，能混到你这个地步，你肯定不至于说不知道 '野心' 为何物。" Macario 眼神冰凉，死死盯着你，"世上那么多人里，唯独你肯定深入了解过，那些野蛮蠢货，那些意识形态走狗，那些堕落小人们会怎样对怀有野心的人群起而攻之。"

"整个星域尽是纷纷扰扰。想象一下，如果全星域的武力，全星域的资源集中起来，只为服务那一人的...野心，又会怎样。"

texts.en:
"That question is no longer relevant," Macario's look hardens. "The question now is of who is prepared to carry on in his name."

You can only conclude that there is a power vacuum in the space Andrada should be. There's been no public announcement of death or illness, but the Sindrian Diktat keeps very tight control on its information sphere - and never shows signs of weakness.
texts.zh:
"那个问题已经没关系了。" Macario 的目光坚毅了起来。"现在的问题是谁准备好了以他的名誉继续向前。"

你也只能归结于，现在 Andrada 该在的位置有了一个权力真空。明面上没有过死亡或者病痛的通知，但 辛达强权 牢牢掌控着它的消息圈 —— 而且从不示弱。

texts.en:
"Of course not," Macario says, almost annoyed at the idea.

"Authority flows from power," he explains. "After I secure the future of the Diktat, the only traitors will be those who oppose me."
texts.zh:
"当然不是。" Macario 说道，都有点被这种想法惹恼了。

"权力源自于力量。" 他解释道。"在我确保了强权的未来后，叛徒就只有那些反对我的人了。"

texts.en:
Macario, unblinking, looks just a little bit delighted at your question.

"Someone must be. Philip knew this, in his time."
texts.zh:
Macario 眼睛也没眨，看起来对你提出的问题只是略微有些愉悦。

"总得有人有野心。Philip 在他的年代也明白这一点。"

texts.en:
"Do my ears deceive, dear captain?" Macario says with mock disappointment.

"I beg of you, let us finish our nice conversation. Then we may think things over, mm?"
texts.zh:
"是我耳朵不好使了吗，亲爱的舰长？" Macario 话语中带着嘲讽性的失望。

"算我求求你，我们先把这段愉快的交谈说完，然后你再考虑考虑，嗯？"

texts.en: "Liar," Macario says gleefully. "And utterly perfect! You demonstrate precisely the bold duplicity I require."
texts.zh: "骗子。" Macario 快意道，"这真是太完美了！你展现出了正是我需要的那种大胆的奸诈。"

texts.en:
"Fascinating," Macario says, perhaps to himself.

"But would you die to serve the Diktat? No, no, don't speak. It is far too personal a question."

"Besides," he adds, "I require that you live. Which is why you do." He produces a ghastly smile.
texts.zh:
"真有意思。" Macario 大概是在自言自语，"那你会为侍奉强权而死吗？不，不，别说了。这是个过于私人的问题了。"

"再说了。" 他补充道，"我需要你活着。这也是为什么你会活着。" 他露出了一个毛骨悚然的笑容。

texts.en: This fleet is transmitting the transponder code provided by Macario. It is commanded by the 'traitor' you must arrest or kill.
texts.zh: 这支舰队的应答器信号符合 Macario 提供的消息，这支舰队的指挥官，一定就是你得逮捕 —— 再或者杀掉 —— 的那个 '叛国者'。

texts.en:
"You." $HisOrHer eyes narrow, already suspicious.

"I would not expect to see you again after making such outrageous and, dare I say, illegal claims. I could order your arrest already on suspicion of terrorist activities."
texts.zh:
"是你。" $HisOrHer眯起双眼，看来已经在怀疑你了。

"你说过那种惹人不快，而且 —— 我就这么说了 —— 违反法律的话之后，我真没想到还能看到你再跳出来。我早就该按疑似恐怖分子的标准，当场把你拿下的。"

texts.en:
This time $heOrShe is ready.

"You return! I hereby declare you a criminal and traitor for the crimes of falsifying official documents, threatening an officer, and attempting to undermine the authority of the Supreme Executor."

"A death in space is better than you deserve, terrorist scum." $HeOrShe looks over $hisOrHer shoulder and gives a wave. The comms cut out and the opposing fleet maneuvers to an attack posture.
texts.zh:
这回，$heOrShe准备充分。

"你还敢回来！我在此宣布，你是罪犯，是叛国者，你的罪名包括：伪造官方文件、威胁官员、试图损害最高元首权威！"

"你这恐怖分子，你这人渣！就这么死在太空都便宜你了！" $HeOrShe回头挥了挥手。通讯中断了，对方舰队开始机动，进入战斗阵型。

options.en: You are under arrest by order of Chief High Inspector Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 根据最高检察长 Dolos Macario 的命令，你被逮捕了。

options.en: Bad news. You've been sold out by Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 坏消息。你们被 Dolos Macario 出卖了。

options.en: I'm here - again - to arrest order from Chief High Inspector Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 我重复一遍，我是来逮捕犯人的，逮捕命令来自最高检察长 Dolos Macario。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: "Absurd!" $HeOrShe shouts, annoyed. "I should have you arrested for claiming false authority and making a mockery of the Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh: "简直荒谬！" $HeOrShe愤怒大喊，"我早就该逮捕你的，不仅因为你冒充权威，还因为你愚弄整个 辛达强权！"

options.en: Transmit the arrest warrant provided by Macario
options.zh: 发送 Macario 提供的逮捕令

options.en: Do the right thing and surrender yourself without a fight.
options.zh: 乖乖投降，别再负隅顽抗，错上加错。

options.en: Surrender now, or I will attack.
options.zh: 立刻投降，否则我就下令攻击了。

options.en: Convince $hisOrHer crew to turn $himOrHer over without a fight
options.zh: 说服$hisOrHer的船员，让他们不要反抗，交出$himOrHer

options.en: I can help you out of this... for a price.
options.zh: 我倒是能帮你脱身...就是得加点钱。

options.en: Oops, wrong comms-ID. I need to go now.
options.zh: 哎呀，拨错通讯 ID 了。我现在要离开了。

texts.en:
Now you see true fear fall across $hisOrHer face. Macario's reputation doing its work.

"This... this could be faked. It must be a fake," the Diktat $rank's eyes dart around, looking for some escape. "Why would he send you?"
texts.zh:
这下子，你能从$hisOrHer的表情里看出来，$hisOrHer真的怕起来了。Macario 的恶名怕是把$hisOrHer吓得不轻。

"这...这东西可以造假的！这东西肯定是假的！" 这位 辛达强权 的 $rank 一边说着，一边到处乱瞟，怕是在找个脱身的法子。"他为什么要派你来？"

texts.en:
A series of emotions flood across $hisOrHer face. Despair, betrayal, sadness. Anger, then rage.

"No," $heOrShe growls, then cuts the comms.

The opposing fleet assumes an aggressive posture.
texts.zh:
$hisOrHer脸上闪过一连串表情：先是绝望、背叛、悲伤，然后是愤怒，最后则成了暴怒。

"不行！" $heOrShe吼道，随后便切断了通讯链接。

对方舰队进入攻击阵型。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe laughs cruelly. "You would make such a demand, from that puny $shipOrFleet?"

"It is I who will see your fleet burn! I hereby declare you a criminal and traitor for the crimes of falsifying official documents, threatening an officer, and attempting to undermine the authority of the Supreme Executor."

"A death in space is better than you deserve, terrorist scum." $HeOrShe looks over $hisOrHer should and gives a wave. The comms cut out and the opposing fleet maneuvers to an attack posture.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe大笑起来，面露凶光："就凭你这弱小的$shipOrFleet，你怎么敢向我做出如此要求？"

"你打不赢的，我会看着你的$shipOrFleet燃烧殆尽！我在此宣布，你是罪犯，是叛国者，你的罪名包括：伪造官方文件、威胁官员、试图损害最高元首权威！"

"你这恐怖分子，你这人渣！就这么死在太空都便宜你了！" $HeOrShe回头挥了挥手。通讯中断了，对方舰队开始机动，进入战斗阵型。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en:
You have your comms officer transmit your appeal on all channels: $PersonRank $PersonName is a traitor in the eyes of the Supreme Executor as per the warrant provided to you by his Chief High Inspector, Dolos Macario.

Anyone who assists this arrest will be doing their duty to the Sindrian Diktat. Anyone who interferes will be branded a traitor and abettor of terrorism to be dealt with as INTSEC sees fit.

With each word, you can watch $PersonRank $PersonName on a muted comm feed growing more enraged - and more unsure. In perfect silence, you see $himOrHer looking around wildly, shouting words you cannot hear, then arms from out-of-scene grab $himOrHer.

The comm-feed cuts out for a moment.
texts.zh:
你命令通讯军官用所有的频道发送了你的这段声明：在最高元首的眼中，$PersonRank $PersonName 是一名彻头彻尾的叛徒，你手中有最高检察长 Dolos Macario 开出的逮捕令为证。

任何协助逮捕的人员都将被视为对 辛达强权 效忠有功。而任何干预此次逮捕的人员，都将被打上叛徒和恐怖主义同情者的烙印，交由 INTSEC 全权处置。

随着声明逐字逐句地传达，你通过静音的通讯信道欣赏着 $PersonRank $PersonName 逐渐愈发愤怒但又愈发不安的全过程。犹如一出完美的默剧，你看着$himOrHer发了疯似的望向四周，高声叫喊着传不到你这边的话语，随后就被从画面之外伸进去的无数双手臂给拽了出去。

随后，通讯断开了有一阵子。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"This is the second-in-command now assuming control of this fleet in light of the previous commander's treason," they almost manage to hide their smirk at the usurpation of their superior officer.

"We shall now transfer the traitor to your authority to return to INTSEC for questioning, trial, and execution. Glory to the Lion of Sindria! Death to traitors!"

They salute.
texts.zh:
"本人为本舰队前副指挥官，鉴于前指挥官的叛国行径，现接管本舰队。" 此人脸上的笑容难以抑制，看来能夺上级的位子使其很是兴奋。

"本舰队将立刻把该叛国者移交至你方，由你方带回 INTSEC，接受审判和处决。荣耀尽归辛达瑞亚之狮！叛徒死无葬身之处！"

此人说着，敬了个礼。

options.en: I'm sure loyalty won't go unnoticed, lieutenant.
options.zh: 我必定不会让你的一片忠心被埋没的，上尉。

options.en: Uh, death to traitors to you, too.
options.zh: 呃，也祝你能让那叛徒死无葬身之处。

texts.en:
The second-in-command is good to their word, and their former commanding officer is handed over to you, not in chains, but held by a set of thick plastic restraints, stripped of uniform insignia, and dulled by sedatives.

You have them secured in the brig.

Now to have a difficult conversation with Deputy Star Marshal Hyder.
texts.zh:
那个副指挥官确实说话算话，把原本的舰队指挥官交给了你。这位前指挥官倒不是被铁链拴着送来的，而是被一套厚厚的塑料束缚具捆着送来的。那人制服上的各种徽章被撕了个精光，还用了些镇静剂，已经不甚清醒了。

你把这人关进了禁闭室，保护起来。

现在，该和副星际元帅 Hyder 来一场高难度会谈了。

options.en: Nav, get us out of here.
options.zh: 领航员，带我们离开这里。

texts.en:
$PersonRank $PersonName hears out your offer, and reluctantly agrees. Better a life on the run than a death in one of Macario's INTSEC torture sites.

In short order, a credits transfer comes in, and an officer-class escape pod is launched from the opposing flagship toward your $shipOrFleet.

Your comms officer interrupts as you oversee the 'rescue' operation.

"Captain. We have incoming priority comms from the Sindrian Diktat fleet."
texts.zh:
$PersonRank $PersonName 听着你开出的价码，虽然略有不甘，最终还是接受了。无论如何，总好过死在 Macario 手下的 INTSEC 黑牢里。

你立马收到了一笔星币转账，对方旗舰上，一个指挥官-级逃生舱腾空而起，直奔你的$shipOrFleet。

正当你饶有兴致，观摩这场 "救援" 行动时，你的通讯军官打断了你。

"舰长，我们接到一份高优先度通讯请求，来源是 辛达强权 舰队。"

options.en: Open the comm-link
options.zh: 打开通讯链接

texts.en:
Just what you needed, another Diktat officer.

"Rogue fleet," the upjumped lieutenant barks - a poor sign for your chances of coming to an understanding.

"You have picked up the escape pod of a traitor who has abandoned their post, an act of treason against the will of the Supreme Executor. Surrender the traitor now or prepare to be boarded!"

Your tactical officer pings you, alerting you to the fact that the Diktat patrol's disposition appears to be in disarray.
texts.zh:
又一位 辛达强权 军官，真就挑要紧的时候来。

"流浪舰队！" 趾高气扬的军官刚一接起通讯，便大喊了起来。看来，你很难从他这里寻得谅解。

"你捞起过一个装着渎职叛徒的逃生舱，那可是对抗最高元首意志的叛国罪行。现在，要么交出那个叛徒，要么就准备被登舰吧！"

你的战术军官向你发出了一条信息，提醒你 辛达强权 巡逻队的阵型似乎十分散乱。

options.en: It is you who is the traitor, and I have documents to prove it!
options.zh: 你才是叛徒，我有证据可以证明！

options.en: Lieutenant, is it? You're welcome for the promotion.
options.zh: 你还是上尉，是吧？你可以等着追授新官职了，不用谢我。

options.en: Cut the comm link.
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: The comm link is cut from the other end. It seems like they're not in the mood to talk.
texts.zh: 通讯链接从另一端被切断。看来对方没有心情对话。

texts.en:
The former CO of the Sindrian Diktat fleet seems to have jumped ship without unlocking executive override. It'll take them a while to reassert control; Andrada learned from his own lessons when it came to mutinies.

Disengaging would be trivial.

After all, if this reaction is anything to go by, you're going to have a pressing engagement with Deputy Star Marshal Hyder.
texts.zh:
看来这位 辛达强权 的前指挥官跳船的时候没有解锁舰船的首长特级权限。其他船员恐怕得过一阵子才能重新控制舰船。看来 Andrada 的确从自己当年发动兵变的经历里总结了不少经验教训。

得益于此，脱离对方舰队易如反掌。

不管怎么样，如果要问这个反应让你有了什么想法的话，你只能说估计自己很快就不得不和副星际元帅 Hyder 会上一面了。

options.en: Nav, get us out of here.
options.zh: 领航员，带我们离开这里。

texts.en: The comm link is cut from the other end. It seems like they're not in the mood to talk.
texts.zh: 通讯链接从另一端被切断。看来对方没有心情对话。

texts.en:
You watch the blood drain from $hisOrHer face. $HeOrShe knows that $heOrShe might have a very big problem.

"What is the meaning of this? You speak outrageous mockery and claim false authority! I should have you arrested for that alone."
texts.zh:
你看着$hisOrHer的脸逐渐变得面无血色，看来$heOrShe知道自己搞不好已经惹上大麻烦了。

"你这话是什么意思？你不仅戏耍我们，害我们生气，还敢冒充权威！光是后面这一条，我就该当场逮捕你的。"

texts.en:
"You." $HisOrHer eyes narrow, already suspicious.

"I would not expect to see you again after making such outrageous and, dare I say, illegal claims. I could order your arrest already on suspicion of terrorist activities."
texts.zh:
"是你。" $HisOrHer眯起双眼，看来已经在怀疑你了。

"你说过那种惹人不快，而且 —— 我就这么说了 —— 违反法律的话之后，我真没想到还能看到你再跳出来。我早就该按疑似恐怖分子的标准，当场把你拿下的。"

texts.en:
This time $heOrShe is ready.

"You return! I hereby declare you a criminal and traitor for the crimes of falsifying official documents, threatening an officer, and attempting to undermine the authority of the Supreme Executor."

"A death in space is better than you deserve, terrorist scum." $HeOrShe looks over $hisOrHer shoulder and gives a wave. The comms cut out and the opposing fleet maneuvers to an attack posture.
texts.zh:
这回，$heOrShe准备充分。

"你还敢回来！我在此宣布，你是罪犯，是叛国者，你的罪名包括：伪造官方文件、威胁官员、试图损害最高元首权威！"

"你这恐怖分子，你这人渣！就这么死在太空都便宜你了！" $HeOrShe回头挥了挥手。通讯中断了，对方舰队开始机动，进入战斗阵型。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: Release the Sindrian Diktat officer you promised to help escape
options.zh: 释放你曾经发誓过会提供帮助的 辛达强权 官员

texts.en:
The former Sindrian Diktat fleet commander looks miserable and unsteady in a borrowed jumpsuit. They mumble some words of thanks and disappear into the human jetsam of the Persean Sector.

Whether they end up dead by the hand of a Diktat reprisal-assassin, crewing a pirate vessel, or joined up with some odd sect of Luddics, you have fulfilled a promise.
texts.zh:
辛达强权 前舰队指挥官穿上了一件借来的连体太空服，看起来既凄凉，又无助。那人低声谢过了不杀之恩，然后就汇入了 英仙座星域  被弃于船外的滚滚人流之中。

无论这个家伙以后究竟会怎么样 —— 是死在 辛达强权 派来报复的刺客手里，或是跑到某艘海盗船只上当船员，还是加入卢德某个奇怪教派，你都已经算是信守承诺了。

texts.en:
After a short wait, Macario's image appears.

"Oh captain, so thoughtful of you to stop by on a social call," he says icily. "You do already have the file on the traitor, and the transponder code of their little flotilla. You have my full confidence in pulling this one off."

"Until then?" He says this like it's a question, but it isn't, because he's already killed the link.
texts.zh:
短暂等待之后，Macario 的形象出现在了通讯界面上。

"哦，是舰长啊，你路过我这里还能跟我聊几句，也算是有心了。" 说是这么说，他说这话的时候却没什么感情，"你肯定拿到叛徒本人的档案了，你也拿到那人小小舰队的应答器号码了，你更是有我助力，我可满怀自信，相信你能做成这件事呢。"

"到时候见咯？" 听起来他在问你，但其实他自己已有定论，因为刚说完他就关掉了通讯链接。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
Your sensors officer reports an officer-class escape pod floating in a spray of debris. A quick jaunt by a salvage crew confirms that the escape pod holds Macario's "traitor". You order them secured in the brig.

There is also an intact cargo pod containing an advanced weapon system - part of the shipment being smuggled under Hyder's orders.
texts.zh:
你的传感器技官报告，在一片残骸中漂浮着一个指挥官等级的逃生舱。打捞员们轻轻松松就探明了，逃生舱内就有 Macario 要的 "叛徒"。你命令船员把那人关进禁闭室里。

残骸中也发现了一个完好无损的货舱，其中装载着一款先进武器系统 —— 由 Hyder 授意走私货品的一部分。

texts.en: Oxana Hyder appears on the comms, already seething.
texts.zh: Oxana Hyder 出现在通讯器画面里，早已火冒三丈。

texts.en: "You have kidnapped an officer of the Sindrian Diktat, an officer under my command. I offer you this one chance to stand down and surrender honorably before your fleet is destroyed."
texts.zh: "你绑架了 辛达强权 手下的一名军官，还是我手下的一名军官。我只给你一次机会，关闭武器，体面地投降，否则我就要摧毁你的舰队。"

texts.en: "How far the Hegemony has fallen, if the Auxiliary has come to this," she adds under her breath.
texts.zh: "要是说连 霸主 辅助军都敢光天化日做这种勾当，那 霸主 得堕落成什么样子了呢。" 她小声嘟哝了一句。

texts.en: "You attacked a flotilla of the Sindrian Diktat navy and kidnapped the commanding officer - an officer acting under my direct orders. I offer you this one chance to stand down and surrender honorably before your fleet is destroyed."
texts.zh: "你攻击了 辛达强权 手下的一支舰队，掳走了该舰队的指挥官，还是直接听命于我的一名指挥官。我只给你一次机会，关闭武器，体面地投降，否则我就要毁灭你的舰队。"

options.en: That fleet was smuggling weapons. Macario calls it treason.
options.zh: 那支舰队当时在走私武器，Macario 说这是叛国行为。

options.en: That officer was smuggling weapons. Macario calls it 'treason'.
options.zh: 那名军官当时在走私武器，用 Macario 的话来讲，那叫 '叛国'。

options.en: The truth is that this is Macario's scheme to test your loyalty.
options.zh: 其实，这是 Macario 的计谋，他想测测你是否忠诚。

options.en: If it helps, it was Macario's idea. At least after he shot the man who thought it up first.
options.zh: 这件事都是 Macario 的主意，至少在他射杀原本想出这个点子的人之后是他的了，不知这么说你能不能好受点。

options.en: If it helps, they abandoned their command to flee Macario.
options.zh: 那人为了躲开 Macario 甚至渎职了，不知这么说你能不能好受点。

options.en: The crew mutinied and handed the officer over without a fight.
options.zh: 那支舰队的船员哗变了，一枪未发就把他们的军官送给我了。

texts.en:
"Following orders," Hyder grits her teeth, "even secret orders, from the highest authority of the navy to ensure the effective operation of military assets is not treason."

Disgust fully enters her voice now, "No matter how Macario tries to twist the truth."

"Half of the so-called 'intelligence operations' performed under his authority could well be called treason, but I don't make it my business to meddle as he does."
texts.zh:
"这是服从命令。" Hyder 咬着牙，说，"哪怕他服从的是海军最高层下达的密令，那也是为了保证军用设备高效周转，算不得叛国。" 说到此处，她的厌恶之情溢于言表，"这件事不能算叛国，无论 Macario 那宵小之辈如何极力扭曲真相。"

"他授意下进行的那些所谓的 '情报行动'，得有个一半都能算作叛国，但我和他不一样，我可不靠这 '叛国' 的勾当过活。"

options.en: So you don't approve of Macario's methods.
options.zh: 所以你不同意 Macario 的方法。

options.en: He might interpret your own words as treason.
options.zh: 他可能会把你的话理解为叛国。

options.en: I approve of his goals, if not his methods.
options.zh: 我赞同他的目标，如果不是用他那套的话。

texts.en:
"He conducts himself without a shred of honor while wrapped in the banner of the Supreme Executor. He twists the words of Philip Andrada to serve his own degenerate desires."

She pauses, seething.
texts.zh: "他在打着 最高元首 旗号行事之时毫无一丝荣耀。他恶意扭曲 Philip Andrada 的话语来满足自身腐败堕落的渴望。" 她停顿了一下，怒火中烧。

texts.en: "Macario says what is useful to himself. Observe the results of his actions: paranoia, inefficiency, and lawlessness."
texts.zh: 她继续说着："Macario 只讲自己用得上的话。看看他的行为都造成了什么：偏执、低效、目无法纪。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Speaking of the law." Hyder crosses her arms. "You have an officer subordinate to my command. I will take them into custody to deal with per naval court-martial."
texts.zh: "说到法律。" Hyder 交叉双臂说道，"你手下有一名我麾下的军官。我将把那人带上军事法庭接受审判。"

options.en: I will transfer them to your custody immediately.
options.zh: 我马上就将那家伙交给你。

options.en: Macario issued the arrest warrant. I will take the officer to him.
options.zh: Macario 发布了这则逮捕令。我会把这位军官交给他。

options.en: I promised to release this officer on an independent world.
options.zh: 我承诺过要把这个军官带到一个独立世界去。

options.en: I promised to release them on an independent world, and I did.
options.zh: 我承诺过要把这个军官带到一个独立世界去，而我也这么做了。

options.en: Unfortunately, they were killed in battle. (lie)
options.zh: 很遗憾，那人在战斗中被击杀了。 (说谎)

texts.en: "Good," Hyder says, then gives orders to a subordinate to begin the process of prisoner transfer.
texts.zh: "好。" Hyder 说道，然后她命令下属开始转移囚犯的程序。

texts.en:
You had made a deal to set the officer free on the first independent world you visited. They will view you poorly for this breach of trust, but then, they are simply one rogue Sindrian Diktat officer with very few friends.

If it is any consolation, Hyder's court-martial is likely to be a less cruel fate than whatever Macario had in mind.
texts.zh:
你和那名军官商定将会把他释放到一个你去过的独立世界上。由于你的失信，这名军官将会看不起你，不过说到底，那名军官只不过是一个在英仙座星域没啥朋友的 辛达强权 流浪军官。

如果说有什么可以称得上安慰的话，Hyder 手下的军事法庭比起 Macario 脑子里的各种折磨点子，论残酷程度要轻上不少。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Now then, I believe our business is concluded for the present," she says.

"Tell Macario," she spits his name out like a rotten piece of food, "that my loyalty to the Supreme Executor is unquestionable. And that I shall be making a report of his waste of naval resources to my superior."
texts.zh:
"然后现在，我想我们的交易到此为止了。" 她说。

"告诉 Macario。" 她吐出他的名字，就像吐出已经腐烂的食物，"我对最高元首的忠诚是毋庸置疑的。我将向我的上司报告他挥霍海军资源的情况。"

options.en: There's just one more thing...
options.zh: 还有一件事...

texts.en:
She pauses as she reaches toward the comms shut-off.

"What is it, captain."

Macario was right about one thing, at least: Hyder is not difficult to read.
texts.zh:
她正在伸手关闭通讯，听到你的话，一下子停了下来："什么事，舰长？"

Macario 至少在一件事上说对了：Hyder 的心思并不难猜。

texts.en: It feels like she trusts you. Or, at least, she respects the impression you have made so far and would like someone to trust.
texts.zh: 看起来她很相信你。最起码，她尊重你到目前为止给她留下的印象，并希望有个能信任的人。

texts.en: You've made a mixed impression; it feels like she doesn't quite trust you, but she is operating in a nest of vipers and wants to trust someone, somehow.
texts.zh: 你给她留下的印象非常复杂：好像她不太信任你，但是她现在身处毒蛇的巢穴之中，她希望，无论如何，能有人可以信任。

texts.en: She doesn't trust you. And she would like nothing more than to have an ally who she trusts and respects after operating alone in the regimented chaos of the Sindrian Diktat bureaucracy. You have only the briefest opening here.
texts.zh: 她并不相信你。在独自经历 辛达强权 官僚的死板式混乱后，她现在无比希望能有一个值得信赖与尊重的盟友。在拉拢她这件事上，你只打出了最小的切入口。

texts.en: She doesn't trust you. She doesn't like you. She thinks you're working for Macario, or at least working to be on his level. At least your position is clear.
texts.zh: 她不相信你，她也不喜欢你。她觉得你正在为 Macario 所工作，最起码也至少是为了达到他的水平而努力。最起码你的立场是明确的。

texts.en: "I have little patience for this," she says. "Choose your words carefully."
texts.zh: "我对这件事没什么耐心。" 她说道，"注意你的措辞。"

texts.en:
"Enough," she says. "Make your report back to Macario. And consider your words carefully."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"够了，" 她说道，"向 Macario 汇报。并仔细考虑你的话。"

通讯中断了。

texts.en: "I have little patience for this," she says. "Choose your words carefully."
texts.zh: "我对这件事没什么耐心。" 她说道，"注意你的措辞。"

texts.en:
"Enough," she says. "Make your report back to Macario. And consider your words carefully."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"够了，" 她说道，"向 Macario 汇报。并仔细考虑你的话。"

通讯中断了。

options.en: Would you return to the Hegemony? I could talk to someone...
options.zh: 你想回到 霸主 吗 ？我可以和某人谈谈...

options.en: Who should lead the Sindrian Diktat when Andrada is dead? You?
options.zh: 谁该在 Andrada 死后领导 辛达强权？你吗？

options.en: Shouldn't you be Grand Star Marshal if the current one is incapacitated?
options.zh: 如果现任 星际元帅 无法履职，你不应该顶替他的位置吗？

options.en: And when is the last time you met with Andrada?
options.zh: 然后你最后一次碰见 Andrada 是什么时候？

options.en: 'Under Andrada.' So Andrada is incapacitated?
options.zh: '若是 Andrada 尚有余心'？就是说，Andrada 已经没有行动能力了？

options.en: You 'would'? And when is the last time you met with Andrada?
options.zh: 你 '会'？那你最后一次碰见 Andrada 是什么时候？

options.en: With Philip Andrada as good as gone, what are you loyal to now?
options.zh: Philip Andrada 已经名存实亡，那现在你忠于什么？

options.en: Your superior is incapacitated in a clinic on Sindria, so... who do you report to?
options.zh: 你的上司正在 Sindria 的医疗禁区里卧病在床，这样的话...你该负责向谁汇报工作呢？

options.en: "Why does the Deputy Star Marshal of the Sindrian Diktat need to smuggle weapons?
options.zh: "堂堂 辛达强权 副星际元帅，为什么会需要走私武器呢？

options.en: Glory to the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 荣耀归于辛达强权。

options.en: Until we meet again.
options.zh: 下次再见。

texts.en: "Silence yourself!" she almost snarls. "Speak no more treason to me."
texts.zh: "给我安静！" 她几乎是在咆哮，"别再跟我说叛国的歪理了！"

texts.en:
She looks at you for a long, long moment.

"I am, to them, a traitor. Do you know the justice a traitor-in-combat is served? Execution, by will of the commanding officer."

She pauses, watching you. "There is good reason this is so."

Which, you note, does not answer your question.
texts.zh:
她盯着你看了很久很久。

"在 霸主 他们看来，我已经是个叛徒了。你知道战场上对叛国罪的处罚是什么呢？死刑，由指挥官亲手执行。" 她顿了一下，看着你。"他们这么处理，可是有理由的。"

你注意到，她其实在答非所问。

texts.en:
She lets out a joyless, cynical laugh.

"No, not me. I am not a great man like Philip Andrada. Give me a fleet, my orders, and my cause. That is all I need to do my duty."

She looks up and away, "He is... he was different. He had vision, and a surety of purpose that moved history by will alone."
texts.zh:
她发出愤世嫉俗的大笑。

"不，不会是我。我不是像 Philip Andrada 那样的伟人。给我一支舰队，我的命令和我的事业。这就是我履行职责所需的全部。"

她抬起头，然后移开视线，"他是...曾经是与众不同的。他有远见，他的目标坚定到仅靠意志就能推动历史。"

options.en: How about the Lion's Guard? Could Caden lead?
options.zh: 那狮心卫队怎么样？Caden 能当领袖吗？

options.en: Sometimes the best leaders are those who don't want the position. Consider it.
options.zh: 有时，不想当领袖的人反倒最适合当领袖，你再考虑考虑吧。

options.en: How about me?
options.zh: 那我来当领袖，如何？

options.en: Let us talk of other things.
options.zh: 我们再谈谈别的吧。

texts.en:
"Provided the navy did not stand in his way, provided the Supreme Executor was... dead. Then he would be the next in line."

"Could he lead?" She scoffs. "The Lion's Guard is his personal empire, his church, his cult, sucking up resources for a parade-navy. We could have made the Sindrian Diktat strong, even great, but Caden had to start a religion."

She looks away.

"Andrada enjoyed the... the worship. He favored Caden, and it blinded him, impaired his judgment. Caden would martyr us all to the idol he's built of Andrada. I doubt even Macario could really control him. I'm sure he thinks he can."
texts.zh:
"如果我们海军不去阻挡他的话，等到最高元首真的...真的逝去之时，他就是下一位元首了。"

"Caden 他能当领袖吗？" 她讥讽道，"依我看，狮心卫队早已变成只对他本人效忠的帝国、只信仰他本人的教会、只崇拜他本人的宗教啦！不过一支 '仪仗队'，却吸走了那么多资源！我们的海军本可以让 辛达强权 更强更伟大，可 Caden 偏要拿部队搞宗教崇拜！"

她看向别处，"Andrada 喜欢得到这种...崇拜。他对 Caden 很是青睐，青睐到昏了头，青睐到失去判断力！让 Caden 上位的话，怕是他会为了把 Andrada 打造成宗教偶像，让我们全部变成殉道者的。我甚至怀疑 Macario 是否真的有让他乖乖听话的手段，不过 Macario 肯定觉得自己能控制得住他吧。"

texts.en:
She just looks at you for a long moment, unspeaking.

The comms cut to a holding pattern.
texts.zh:
她盯着你看了很久，没有说话。

通讯断开，回到了等候界面。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
She just looks at you for a long moment, unspeaking.

The comms cut to a holding pattern.
texts.zh:
她盯着你看了很久，没有说话。

通讯断开，回到了等候界面。

texts.en: "Yes," she says emphatically, with the weight of a stalled career and impossible position.
texts.zh: "是的。" 她语气同情，语调中满是事业停滞与身处极难境地带来的压力。

texts.en:
"That would be correct. Not, of course, to presume."

She looks conflicted.

"It would be... it is the responsibility of the Supreme Executor himself to assign that rank and office."
texts.zh:
"是的，理应如此。只是，我也无权擅自决定。" 她显得有些矛盾。

"安排官阶，指派官员，本该是... 这一事务是只能由最高元首本人亲自进行的。"

texts.en: "A meeting of the high ministers could theoretically agree to invoke the Articles of Succession, but Macario wants to ensure that it is he who dictates the result of that meeting. And he'll drain the lifeblood of the Sindrian Diktat for as long as it takes."
texts.zh: "理论上，只要高层开个会，就能定下来要启用继承条款，但 Macario 想要确保他自己能够独断高层会议的结果。这个人要将 辛达强权 的生命力攫取殆尽，无论会花上多长时间。"

options.en: But he won't. Or can't.
options.zh: 但是他不会，或者说他不能。

options.en: So why hasn't he? How long has it been?
options.zh: 所以他怎么还没传给你呢？这都多久了？

texts.en: The speed at which Hyder smashes the privacy field activation switch is impressive for a woman of her years.
texts.zh: Hyder 猛地按下隐私场激活的开关。她这个年纪的女人还有这种手速，令人印象深刻。

texts.en:
After a long moment, she sighs.

"Whatever Macario told you, whatever you believe and think you know, the future of the Sindrian Diktat... will be determined without your meddling."

She sounds more tired than ever before.
texts.zh:
许久之后，她叹了口气。

"无论 Macario 告诉你什么，无论你相信和认为你知道什么，辛达强权 的未来...将会在没有你干预的情况下决定。"

她听起来比之前更疲惫了。

texts.en:
She looks suddenly more tired than ever before.

"If the Supreme Executor was dead, we wouldn't be having this conversation. Macario would like to line his pieces up just right. And you're as good as one of them."
texts.zh:
她突然看起来比之前更疲惫了。

"如果最高元首已死，我们连这次对话的机会都不会有。Macario 会把他的棋子们排列得恰到好处。而你也不过只是其中之一罢了。"

texts.en:
"So Macario told you that much," she says, and sighs, looking more tired than ever before. She seems to think something over, and comes to a decision.

"The Supreme Executor isn't dead," she says, "not yet." She almost breathes the next word, "barely."

"I fear when he dies we shall be thrown into the crisis manufactured by Macario. It could undo everything we fought for." She rubs her face with her hands, "Would that the good ones who followed Admiral Andrada all those years ago were not taken from us. Would that the worst did not rise to the top."
texts.zh:
"这样啊，Macario 告诉了你那么多。" 她说完便叹了口气，看起来前所未有的疲惫。她看起来在仔细考虑什么事，并终于下定了决心。

"最高元首还没死呢。" 她说，"至少现在还没。" 说着说着，她的声音也越来越轻，说到最后近乎耳语，"但也不过是苟延残喘。"

"我怕，我怕他去世之后我们就要落入 Macario 亲手编织的危机之中。" 说着说着，她双手使劲揉了一下脸，"怎奈长久以来追随 Andrada 将军的善人们大都已离我们而去，怎奈奸邪之徒乘此机会擢得高位。"

texts.en:
Her eyes fix on you. She doesn't like this question, not one bit.

"That is no business of yours."
texts.zh:
她的眼睛盯着你。她不喜欢这个问题，一点也不。

"这不关你事。"

texts.en:
Her eyes fix on you. She doesn't like the question.

"Too long," she says evenly.
texts.zh:
她的眼睛盯着你。她不喜欢这个问题。

"太长时间了。" 她语气平静。

options.en: He is not well, is he.
options.zh: 他身体不太好，是吗？

texts.en: Her face twitches, eyes fixed intensely on you for a moment.
texts.zh: 她的脸抽搐了一下，眼睛紧盯着你看了一会儿。

texts.en: Hyder smoothly hits the privacy field activation switch, blinks, then faces you.
texts.zh: Hyder 从容地按下了隐私场的按钮，眼神闪烁了几下，然后才看向你。

texts.en:
"Who told you that?" she demands, "Macario?"

Settling her composure, she continues. "Regardless, the Supreme Executor sits above the senior ministry-level officers of the Sindrian Diktat. I report to him, of course."
texts.zh:
"谁跟你说的？" 她质问道，"Macario？"

在冷静下来之后，她继续道："无论如何，最高元首的地位比任何 辛达强权 高级部门军官都要高。我当然会向他负责。"

texts.en:
"I expect Macario told you that," she says, eyes seemingly fixed on yours through the comms. "Testing my resolve from every angle."

She looks aside for a moment, "It is no wonder the so-called Resistance has lasted this long with the Chief High Inspector-General so committed to doing anything other than his duty."

Settling her composure, she continues. "Regardless, the Supreme Executor sits above the Grand Star Marshal and all ministry-level offices of the Sindrian Diktat. I would report to him, of course."
texts.zh:
"我就知道 Macario 告诉过你这件事。" 她讲着话，双眼紧紧盯在你身上，"这是在从各个角度考验我的决心。"

她向一旁看了一会儿，"难怪所谓的抵抗组织如此难以根除，原来是因为最高检察长身居高位却玩忽职守。"

她镇定下来，继续开口。"不管怎样，最高元首的地位比 星际元帅 和任何 辛达强权高级部门军官都要高。我当然会向他负责。"

texts.en:
"I expect Macario told you that," she says, eyes fixed somewhere above the comms. "Testing my 'loyalty' from every angle, I am sure."

"But it is a problem. To maintain proper hierarchy of authority, the Supreme Executor should have assigned me that rank and the accompanying powers. Then I would be able to simply dictate around the supply deficit Macario and Caden conspired to create."

Still looking elsewhere, "But then, under Andrada, they wouldn't have dared..."
texts.zh:
"我就知道 Macario 告诉过你这件事。" 她讲着话，双眼却直愣愣的看向通讯面板上方某处，"想方设法从一切角度考验我的忠诚度，肯定是那样。"

"但这就是个问题了。若要保持权力阶层秩序森然，最高元首本就该把他的军衔，连带着他的权力，都移交给我的。若是这样，我就可以直接下令，绕开 Macario 与 Caden 两人同谋创造的补给不足问题了。"

她仍然看着别处，补充道："但，再说了，若是 Andrada 尚有余心，他们几个都不会敢这么..."

texts.en: Hyder smoothly hits the privacy field switch, blinks, then faces you.
texts.zh: Hyder 平静地按下隐私场的开关，眨了下眼，之后看向你。

texts.en: "The details of military arms procurement by the Sindrian Diktat navy is a matter of polity security," Hyder says with flat yet somehow seething affect. "It is not the business of an outsider. Or of meddlesome worms like Macario."
texts.zh: "辛达强权 海军军火订单的信息关乎国家安全。" Hyder 语调平静，却掩不住语气中的暗潮涌动，"这种信息，外人无权得知，更别说 Macario 那条爱管闲事的蛆虫。"

texts.en:
"Captain. Though not without some character befitting an officer, you are an outsider and cannot be expected to understand."

"The Diktat has enemies within and without; if it is fighting with itself, it will never survive. I must do what I must to maintain our strength even if I am put into," her lip curls, "an intolerable position."
texts.zh:
"舰长，虽然你身上也有些我们军官的特质，但你终归还是个外人，正因此，有些事我也不指望你能懂。"

"辛达强权 内外受敌，若是 辛达强权 内部还要内斗的话，它可没法生存下去。我必须采取一切必需手段保持我们国家的军力强盛 —— 哪怕会让我置身于..." 她唇角略微上扬，"哪怕会让我置身于无法忍受的情况下。"

texts.en:
"Captain. I shall be forthright out of respect for a fellow officer."

"It is," her lip curls in a sneer, "Intolerable. I have not been given due authority, yet I have responsibility for the System Defense Armada."

"Macario, through Caden, seeks to starve my fleets and make me look incompetent. Philip Andrada would never have stood for it, if he was capable. If he wasn't beguiled by flatterers and liars. If he was the Philip Andrada I pledged myself to during the Battle of Salus!"
texts.zh:
"舰长，出于对同僚的尊重，我将直言不讳。"

"怎么说呢，" 她冷笑着噘起嘴唇，"迄今为止我明明要负责管理行星防御舰队，但却完全没有得到应有的权力，这是完全不可接受的。"

"Macario，他想通过 Caden 让我的舰队挨饿，让我显得无能。如果 Philip Andrada 仍然大权在握，如果他没有被阿谀奉承者和说谎者所欺骗，如果他还是我在 Salus 之战所效忠的 Philip Andrada 的话，他绝不会容忍这一点。"

texts.en:
She just looks at you. Like staring down the barrel of a coilgun.

The comms cut to a holding pattern.
texts.zh:
她看着你，神情更像是望向某一支线圈炮的炮管深处。

通讯断开，回到了等候界面。

texts.en:
She just nods, distracted perhaps by the implications of your conversation.

The comms cut to a holding pattern.
texts.zh:
她没说什么，就点了点头，或许还在思考你们两人对话的含义。

通讯断开，回到了等候界面。

texts.en:
"I see," Hyder says flatly.
