"I offer this: your objection will be recorded, then you will transfer the prisoner. I shall assume responsibility for the question of jurisdiction. This will fulfill your obligation and leave the matter to the law of the Sindrian Diktat."
texts.zh:
"我明白了。" Hyder 平静地说。

"我的提议是：你的反对会被记录下来，然后你再转移犯人。我将承担关于管辖权问题的责任。这样你就履行了你的义务，把这件事交给 辛达强权 的法律去处理吧。"

options.en: I accept. I'll have the prisoner sent to you immediately.
options.zh: 我接受，我马上就把犯人交给你。

options.en: I must insist. This is Macario's prisoner.
options.zh: 你说得对，但是这是 Macario 的犯人。

texts.en:
"So you are a creature of Macario," says Hyder, her anger suppressed neatly under an officious demeanor. "I will take this matter all the way to the office of the Supreme Executor, if I must."

She takes a deep breath.
texts.zh:
"所以你是 Macario 手下的喽啰。" Hyder 说到，她的愤怒被一种戏谑的心态完全压住了，"如果有必要的话，我会把这件事一直闹到最高元首的办公室去。"

她深深地吸了一口气。

texts.en:
"I see," Hyder says flatly. "I appreciate that, as an officer, you are bound to keep your word. However the law of the ruling polity of a volume overrides your personal promise."

"I offer this: your objection will be recorded, then you will transfer the prisoner. This will fulfill your honorable obligation as well as uphold the law."
texts.zh:
"我明白了。" Hyder 平静地说。"我很欣赏这一点，作为一个军官，你必须遵守诺言。不过无论如何，任何一卷统治国家的法律都凌驾于你个人的承诺之上。"

"我的提议是：你的反对会被记录下来，然后你再转移犯人。这样在你履行了你荣耀的承诺的同时法律也得到了维护。"

options.en: Then, with objection, I shall transfer the prisoner to your custody.
options.zh: 这样的话，即便我反对，我也会将囚犯交到你手上。

options.en: I must insist. If my words mean nothing, then I am nothing.
options.zh: 我必须坚持自己的判断。如果我说过的话都毫无分量，说改就改的话，那我这个人也一样毫无分量了。

options.en: I must insist. If my words mean nothing, then I am nothing. (lie)
options.zh: 我必须坚持自己的判断。如果我说过的话都毫无分量，说改就改的话，那我这个人也一样毫无分量了。 (说谎)

texts.en:
Hyder looks thoughtful. "Then we find ourselves at an impasse, captain, with each sworn to uphold their highest duty and loyalty."

A pause, then she continues, "Your conviction is undeniable, captain. Let us table the matter."

It sounds like she's going to let you get away with the prisoner, without admitting it. Interesting. Best play along.
texts.zh:
Hyder 看起来正在思考。"然后我们将会发现我们现在陷入死局了，舰长，每个人都发誓要坚守自己的最高职责与忠诚。"

一阵停顿，然后她继续说道："你的看法无可辩驳，舰长。让我们把这件事暂时搁置起来。"

听起来她会对你带着犯人逃走这件事睁一只眼闭一只眼。真是有趣，最好配合一下她。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Hyder's expression hardens. "Does your oath of commission to the Sindrian Diktat mean nothing? You gave your word then."
texts.zh: Hyder 的表情凝固了。"难道对 辛达强权 发下的就职宣誓对你来说毫无意义？你立下过誓言。"

texts.en: Hyder's expression hardens. "Does your oath of commission to the Sindrian Diktat mean nothing? You gave your word then. What of now?"
texts.zh: Hyder 的表情凝固了。"难道对 辛达强权 发下的就职宣誓对你来说毫无意义？你立下过誓言。那它们现在又算什么？"

options.en: You are right, that loyalty is higher. I will order the transfer.
options.zh: 你说得对，忠诚更重要。我会下令转交囚犯的。

options.en: I would be a coward and a liar if I did not follow my judgment. I accept all consequences.
options.zh: 若是我无法坚守自己立下的判断的话，那我就是懦夫、骗子了。我还是坚持我的判断，并且愿意承担一切责任。

options.en: You are right, the oath I swore is more important. I will make the report.
options.zh: 你是对的，我曾发过的誓更加重要。我将会做一份报告。

options.en: I would be a coward if I did not follow my judgment. I accept all consequences.
options.zh: 如果我连自己内心的正义都不遵从的话，那我只不过是一个懦夫，我自愿接受一切后果。

texts.en:
"Interesting." She looks away for a moment, thinking another thought, but quickly returns focus to you.

"Your conviction is undeniable, captain, and that is worth something. Let us table the matter."

It sounds like she's going to let you get away with the prisoner, without admitting it. Interesting. Best play along.
texts.zh:
"有意思。"她的目光游离了一会，想了想别的什么事，但很快她的注意力又回到你身上。

"你的信念毋庸置疑，舰长，这种信念终究有所值。让我们先搁置这件事。"

听起来她会对你带着犯人逃走这件事睁一只眼闭一只眼。真是有趣，最好配合一下她。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You order your comms officer to write a brief report fulfilling the letter of Hyder's demands, and it is quickly sent off.

"I deem this sufficient," Hyder says after giving her datapad a quick glance.
texts.zh:
你命令你的通讯军官按照 Hyder 信中的需求去写一篇简短的报告，并迅速发出。

"我觉得这样就够了。" Hyder 在瞥了自己的数据平板一眼后说到。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: She looks at you, calculating something that doesn't please her.
texts.zh: 她看着你，盘算着一些让她不高兴的事情。

texts.en:
Hyder looks displeased. "Then we find ourselves at an impasse, captain, with each sworn to uphold what each believes to be their duty."

A pause, then she continues, "Your conviction is as undeniable as it is misplaced, captain. Let us table the matter."

It sounds like she's going to let you get away with it without admitting it. Interesting. Best play along.
texts.zh:
Hyder 看起来非常不快。"然后我们将会发现我们现在陷入死局了，舰长，每个人都发誓要坚守自己认定的职责。"

一阵停顿，然后她继续说道："你的看法无可辩驳，舰长。让我们把这件事暂时搁置起来。"

听起来她会对你带着犯人逃走这件事睁一只眼闭一只眼。真是有趣，最好配合一下她。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I see," Hyder says flatly. "I appreciate that, as an officer, you were bound to keep your word. However the law of the ruling polity of a volume overrides your personal promise."

She closes her eyes for a moment, sighs, then says "Provide me with a report of your last sighting of the officer in question. I shall consider this the least acceptable diligence in upholding our law."
texts.zh:
"我明白了。" Hyder 平静地说。"我很欣赏这一点，作为一个军官，你必须遵守诺言。不过无论如何，任何一卷统治国家的法律都凌驾于你个人的承诺之上。"

她闭上眼睛，思考一阵，轻叹了一口气，然后说道："给我一份你上次目击那名军官的报告，在我看来，若是还要维护法律权威，这已经是可接受范围内你最基础的职责了。"

options.en: I shall do so.
options.zh: 我会的。

options.en: I must insist on not doing so. If my word means nothing, then I am nothing.
options.zh: 我必须坚持自己的判断。如果我说过的话都毫无分量，说改就改的话，那我这个人也一样毫无分量了。

options.en: I must insist on not doing so. If my word means nothing, then I am nothing. (lie)
options.zh: 我必须坚持自己的判断。如果我说过的话都毫无分量，说改就改的话，那我这个人也一样毫无分量了。 (说谎)

texts.en:
You order your comms officer to write a brief report fulfilling the letter of Hyder's demands, and it is quickly sent off.

"I deem this sufficient," Hyder says after giving her datapad a quick glance.
texts.zh:
你命令你的通讯军官按照 Hyder 信中的需求去写一篇简短的报告，并迅速发出。

"我觉得这样就够了。" Hyder 在瞥了自己的数据平板一眼后说到。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "I see," Hyder says flatly.
texts.zh: "我知道了。" Hyder 平静地说。

texts.en:
"I find difficulty in accepting your word in this matter, as you did not fight a battle with our patrol fleet while this officer was in command."

"I would be terribly disappointed if I discovered you were lying."
texts.zh:
"我发现在这件事上我很难接受你的说辞，因为你并没有在这名军官参与指挥的情况下与我们的巡逻队作战。"

"如果我发现你在撒谎，我将会非常非常地失望。"

texts.en: "Although dissatisfying, I shall accept your word as an officer that this is the truth."
texts.zh: "尽管我对此非常不满，但我作为一名军官仍接受你的说辞，那的确是对的。"

options.en: I stand by my word. As an officer.
options.zh: 作为一名军官，我信守诺言。

options.en: With apologies, I promised to release this officer on an independent world.
options.zh: 抱歉，我承诺将这位军官释放到一个独立世界上。

options.en: With apologies, Macario also told me to lie about this to gauge your reaction. (lie)
options.zh: 抱歉，Macario 还让我在这件事上撒谎，以衡量你的反应。 (说谎)

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Indeed," says Hyder.

You can see on her face that she believes you are lying and is choosing not to call you out on it in this moment. Macario was right- she would not make a good politician.
texts.zh:
"确实如此。" Hyder 说。

你可以从她的脸上看出她认为你在撒谎且选择不在此刻揭穿你。Macario 是对的 —— 她成不了一名优秀的政治家。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I see," Hyder says flatly. "I appreciate that, as an officer, you are bound to keep your word. However the law of the ruling polity of a volume overrides the necessity to uphold your word."

"I offer this: your objection will be recorded, then you will transfer the prisoner. This will fulfill your honorable obligation as well as uphold the law."
texts.zh:
"我明白了。" Hyder 平静地说。"我很欣赏这一点，作为一个军官，你必须遵守诺言。不过无论如何，任何一卷统治国家的法律都凌驾于你的说辞之上。

"我的提议是：你的反对会被记录下来，然后你再转移犯人。这样在法律被维护的同时，你荣耀的承诺也得到了履行。"

options.en: I shall transfer the prisoner to your custody.
options.zh: 我将会把犯人交到你手上。

options.en: Macario issued the arrest warrant. I will take the officer to him.
options.zh: Macario 发出了逮捕令。我将会将这名军官交给他。

texts.en:
Hyder closes her eyes and rubs the bridge of her nose; it seems that she does not enjoy the prospect of lie and counter-lie.

"Typical Macario," she says finally, her anger now - mostly - directed away from yourself. "No more games! Transfer the prisoner to my custody so that a proper court-martial may proceed."

She fixes you with her glare. "Do this by the proper order of things, each in its place. This is the way of the Sindrian Diktat."
texts.zh:
Hyder 闭上了她的眼睛并擦了擦她的鼻梁；看来她不喜欢和你陷入谎言和反谎言的无尽泥潭中。

"这太 Macario 了。" 她最终说道，现在她的愤怒 —— 绝大部分 —— 都从你那里转移了，"游戏到此为止！现在立马把犯人给我交过来！只有这样才能进行正规的军事法庭审判。"

她对你怒目而视。"凡事都要按次序办，每个人都各司其职。这就是 辛达强权 的行事风格。"

texts.en:
Hyder closes her eyes and rubs the bridge of her nose; it seems that she does not enjoy the prospect of lie and counter-lie.

"Typical Macario," she says finally, her anger now - mostly - directed away from yourself.

"Tell Macario," she spits his name out like a morsel of rotten food, "that my loyalty to the Supreme Executor is unquestionable. And that I shall be making a report of his waste of naval resources to my superior."
texts.zh:
Hyder 闭上眼睛，揉着鼻梁；看来她并不喜欢这种谎言与真相交织的场面。

"这就是 Macario。" 她最后说。她的怒火，现在，大部分已从你的身上移开。

"告诉 Macario。" 她吐出他的名字，就像吐出已经腐烂的食物，"我对最高元首的忠诚是毋庸置疑的。我将向我的上司报告他挥霍海军资源的情况。"

options.en: I will transfer them to your custody immediately.
options.zh: 我马上就将那人交给你。

options.en: Macario issued the arrest warrant. I will take the prisoner to him.
options.zh: Macario 发布了这则逮捕令。我会把这位军官交给他。

options.en: There's just one more thing...
options.zh: 还有一件事...

texts.en: "He would in an instant," she spits, "if it served his next degenerate scheme."
texts.zh: "他立刻就会把我的话打成叛国。" 她唾骂道，"只要抹黑我能够推进他的阴谋，他立刻就会这么做的。"

texts.en: "Then I would demand you re-evaluate your perception of his goals," Hyder says haughtily.
texts.zh: "然后我需要你重新评估一下你对他目标的看法了。" Hyder 傲慢地说。

texts.en:
Hyder looks at you for a moment, her opinion perhaps shifting.

"I appreciate your honesty. It is more than I would expect from one of Macario's creatures."
texts.zh:
Hyder 盯着你看了一会，似乎她对你的看法发生了某种转变。

"我欣赏你的诚实，能从 Macario 手下的喽啰口中听到这种话，真是出乎意料。"

texts.en:
Hyder looks at you for a moment, her opinion perhaps shifting.

"I appreciate your honesty. It is the least I would expect from a bearer of a Hegemony commission. I can't say I understand why you are playing at being one of Macario's creatures."
texts.zh:
Hyder 盯着你看了一会，似乎她对你的看法发生了某种转变。

"我欣赏你的诚实，能接受 霸主 雇佣的人，好歹也该有这种品格。话虽如此，我不太理解你为什么这么胡搞，偏要去 Macario 手下当喽啰。"

texts.en:
She frowns. Then, instead of denying your claim, says "Typical of Macario. He mistakes cruelty for discipline and fear for obedience. He's a sad prototype of the Diktat's 'new man'."

Hyder looks at you for a moment, her opinion perhaps shifting. It's easy to see that she hates Macario, and easy to re-align her anger away from yourself.

"You are correct to conduct yourself honestly, despite the appearance of the circumstances," she says.
texts.zh:
她皱眉，但却没有反驳你的说法。"确实是 Macario 那家伙一贯的作风。他这个人错把残忍当做纪律，误将恐惧当成服从。辛达强权 治下 '新国民' 的模范竟然是他这副模样，真是令人悲哀。"

Hyder 盯着你看了一会，似乎她对你的看法发生了某种转变。显而易见，她不仅憎恨 Macario，也很容易就能转变愤怒的对象。

"虽然你闹出了这种事，但最终你还是悬崖勒马，老实坦白了，做得对。" 她说道。

texts.en:
"A commander should never abandon their command," Hyder states this like cold fact. "Never."

"Dereliction of duty is treason enough. Better to face Macario's machinations with an honorable death than let his lies and subterfuge corrupt our sacred duty."
texts.zh:
"舰队指挥官永远不可渎职。" Hyder 冰冷地抛出了既定事实，"那绝无可能。"

"渎职足以称为叛国。对叛国者来说，哪怕直面 Macario 阴谋，最终光荣赴死，也好过任由 Macario 的谎话连篇，Macario 的百般欺诈，继续腐蚀我们的光荣使命。"

options.en: Look, I just did the job. Your laws and your ethics are your business.
options.zh: 你看，所以我就出手了，你那 '法律'，'道德' 就是你自己的事了。

options.en: That seems harsh. It is Macario who manufactured the dilemma.
options.zh: 你的处置有点太严苛了，Macario 才是让那人身处两难局面的罪魁祸首。

options.en: You're right, a true officer would stand by their position, even unto death.
options.zh: 你说得对，真正的指挥官就该恪守岗位，哪怕面对死亡威胁也不该渎职。

options.en: You're right, a true officer would stand by their position, even unto death. (lie)
options.zh: 你说得对，真正的指挥官就该恪守岗位，哪怕面对死亡威胁也不该渎职。 (说谎)

options.en: The crew merely intended to uphold the law; it is Macario who manufactured the dilemma.
options.zh: 船员们只是想要捍卫法律尊严而已。Macario 才是让他们身处两难局面的罪魁祸首。

options.en: You're right. Mutiny is absolutely unacceptable in a warfleet.
options.zh: 你说得对。军舰舰队中决不能容许有哗变。

options.en: You're right. Mutiny is absolutely unacceptable in a warfleet. (lie)
options.zh: 你说得对。军舰舰队中决不能容许有哗变。 (说谎)

texts.en: Her eyes narrow. "They are. And seeing as you are presently within the legal and ethical volume of the Sindrian Diktat, you must respect our laws."
texts.zh: 她眯起双眼："那名军官确实犯了叛国罪。而且，既然你现在身处 辛达强权 法律道德范围之内，你就得尊重我们的法律。"

texts.en: "He did," she admits, and without hesitation continues: "Nonetheless, my officer failed their mission and their position. An officer who delivers defeat to their commander must face that fact honorably, not discard their uniform and duty to flee like a coward. To that point."
texts.zh: "Macario 确实难逃其咎。" 她先是承认，之后毫无迟疑的继续说了下去，"即便如此，的确还是我手下的那名军官最终未能完成任务，还犯下了渎职之罪。若有军官让自己的指挥者蒙受失败，他就该心怀荣耀，去面对自己行动的一切后果，而不是就这样脱掉制服甘当懦夫。言尽于此。"

texts.en: "Then we stand together on this matter of honor," she says with a nod.
texts.zh: "那么我们将在这个关乎荣誉的问题上站在一起。" 她点点头说。

texts.en:
"Your command-instinct to look to the wellbeing of the crew is admirable," she concedes.

Then her eyes narrow, "But beware over-indulgence in mercy; it will make you weak. As Andrada said, 'A true leader understands that victory is bought with casualties'."

"So: if the greatest good is to uphold the law, then this crew shall serve that cause by providing an example of its execution."
texts.zh:
"你很有指挥官的直觉，会关心船员的安危，值得钦佩。" 她承认道。

然后，她眯起双眼。"然而，小心你的宽容变为放纵，那样的话，你就会变得更加孱弱。Andrada 曾言道：'真正的领袖应当理解，胜利背后总要有牺牲。' "

"所以说，如果捍卫法律权威真是正道的话，这群船员也应当亲身证道，让大家看看，法律如何运作。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"A crew's duty is to follow the orders of a superior officer. That officer assumes moral responsibility for failure. Disobedience requires court-martial for the grave crime of mutiny."

"It is better to face Macario's machinations with an honorable death than allow his subterfuge to corrupt sacred duty."
texts.zh:
"船员的职责，就是听命于他们的指挥官。即便面临失败，全体船员的道德负担也应当由指挥官一人担负。哗变者应当交由军事法庭，以哗变重罪论处。"

"对于哗变者，哪怕直面 Macario 阴谋，最终光荣赴死，也好过任由 Macario 的百般欺诈继续腐蚀我们的光荣使命。"

texts.en:
After a short wait, Macario's image appears.

"Captain, captain, captain," he smirks. "I eagerly await the results of your discussion with Vice Star Mashal Hyder."

"Until then?" He says this like it's a question, but it isn't, because he's already killed the link.
texts.zh:
短暂等待之后，Macario 的形象出现在了通讯界面上。

"舰长，舰长，舰长哟。" 他满脸堆笑，"我可是很期待你和副星际元帅 Hyder 谈出结果呢。"

"到时候见咯？" 听起来他在问你，但其实他自己已有定论，因为刚说完他就关掉了通讯链接。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
After a short wait, Macario's image appears. He looks like he is anticipating a tasty meal.

"Captain, I am so pleased to have you join me once again. Deputy Star Marshal Hyder was not too upset? You didn't offend her sense of honor too deeply? But no, I should allow you to speak." He winks and taps a datapad.
texts.zh:
短暂等待之后，Macario 的形象出现了。他看起来像是在期待着一场盛宴。

"舰长，我又一次非常庆幸你是我这边的人了。副星际元帅 Hyder 没有太生气吧？你没有把她的荣誉感冒犯得太过头吧？哦对，我应该让你来说的。" 他向你抛了个眼色并点了下数据平板。

texts.en: He unfolds his hands in a show of magnanimity, "Do go on."
texts.zh: He unfolds his hands in a show of magnanimity, "Do go on."

texts.en: You have the Diktat patrol fleet officer in your brig for Macario. Best to address old business first.
texts.zh: 你的船上关着 Macario 指示的辛达强权巡逻队的指挥官。还是先处理好之前的事。

options.en: I have your traitorous officer ready to transfer.
options.zh: 我准备送回你的叛徒军官。

options.en: I promised to let the prisoner go free on an independent world.
options.zh: 我发誓过要把这个军官带到一个独立世界去。

options.en: I transferred the prisoner to Hyder's custody. (lie)
options.zh: 我已经把犯人交到 Hyder 的手上了。 (说谎)

options.en: Unfortunately the prisoner died between capture and the present. (lie)
options.zh: 很不幸，犯人已经在被捕后死亡了。 (说谎)

options.en: Don't mention the prisoner.
options.zh: 不提及囚犯的事。

texts.en:
"You do?" Macario releases a quick breath, looking to the side, annoyed. "Fine, fine, send them over and we'll have that loose end trimmed."

He taps each hand once on his desk, then brings them together and looks at you attentively. "Now tell me about Hyder."
texts.zh:
"在你手里？" Macario 快速地呼出一口气，向一旁望去，生气地说道，"好吧，好吧，把那家伙送过来，我们得滴水不漏，不能徒增枝节。"

他两只手分别在桌子上敲了一下，然后将双手合拢，专注地看着你。"现在告诉我 Hyder 的情况。"

options.en: Well, she hates you.
options.zh: 好吧，她恨你。

options.en: I offered to arrange for her defection back to the Hegemony.
options.zh: 我主动提出安排她叛逃回 霸主 的事宜。

options.en: She says you've conspired to hold back her promotion to Grand Star Marshal.
options.zh: 她说，你密谋阻止她晋升为星际元帅。

options.en: She doesn't believe Caden can successfully lead the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 她不相信 Caden 能够成功领导 辛达强权。

options.en: She doesn't want to lead the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 她并不想领导 辛达强权。

options.en: She blames you for the navy's supply problems.
options.zh: 她把舰队的补给问题归咎于你。

options.en: That's all I have to say.
options.zh: 我要说的就是这些。

options.en: Consider some lies to tell Macario
options.zh: 想一些谎言去骗过 Macario

texts.en: "Yes," Macario says, "I know that already."
texts.zh: "是。" Macario 说，"我早就知道了。"

options.en: She said you would fuel starships and feed crews with only lies, if you could.
options.zh: 她说，如果你能的话，你会拿你的谎言养活船员、驱动星舰。

options.en: She said you cannot comprehend the concepts of honor, duty, and discipline.
options.zh: 她说你无法理解荣誉、职责和纪律的理念。

options.en: She called you a meddlesome worm.
options.zh: 她把你称作一条爱管闲事的蛆虫。

options.en: She said you've allowed the Volturnian Resistance to continue because you're incompetent and distracted.
options.zh: 她说你允许 Volturn 反抗军继续存在，是因为你不仅无能，还玩忽职守。

options.en: She says that half of the operations you authorize are treasonous.
options.zh: 她说你授权的一半行动都是叛国行径。

options.en: I'm just being thorough.
options.zh: 我只是在尽职尽责。

texts.en: Macario nods, thoughtfully rubbing his chin.
texts.zh: Macario 点了点头，若有所思地摩挲下巴。

texts.en: "Hmm," he says, thinking. "Continue."
texts.zh: "嗯，" 他若有所思地说道，"继续。"

texts.en: Macario's eyebrows raise just a little, like he's just a tiny bit impressed by that one.
texts.zh: Macario 的眼眉轻挑，似乎对这个略微有点印象。

texts.en: "Interesting," he lies.
texts.zh: "有趣，" 他撒谎道。

texts.en: "Only half?" Macario feigns surprise. "How charitable."
texts.zh: "只有一半？" Macario 假装惊讶道，"那我可真仁慈！"

texts.en: "Of course. Well done." He drums his fingers impatiently.
texts.zh: "当然。干得好。" 他说着说着，手指不耐烦地四处敲打着。

texts.en: "Fascinating! And what did she say?" He leans forward, attention focused. "Did she accept?"
texts.zh: "好！然后她说什么了？" 他身子猛的往前一倾，注意力忽的集中起来，"她接受了吗？"

options.en: She didn't really answer. Just something about treason and execution.
options.zh: 她答非所问，就说了一堆叛国呀，死刑呀的胡话。

options.en: Yes. (lie)
options.zh: 对。 (说谎)

texts.en:
"Damnation!" Macario pounds a fist on the table, but he can't help but continue grinning. "Excellent work. I shall have to pursue this angle."

"It will be," he furiously rubs his hands together,"... fun."
texts.zh:
"这个遭天谴的！" Macario 出拳猛砸桌子，却又情不自禁地偷笑起来，"干得好，那我就得猛攻这个方向了。"

"这事会很..." 他猛搓双手，"...很有意思的。"

texts.en:
"No!" he exclaims, "And the Hegemony would have her?"

"This must be Daud's work." He starts rubbing his hands together furiously, "It fits, it fits. He possesses a low cunning honed during his criminal upbringing."

He looks up at you, his hands stopping their frenetic activity as if he just realized you could see it. "I admire Daud, of course. To accomplish so much, arisen from the parasite class to the top of command? It is truly incredible. He chose well in making Rao his attack-hound."

His hands start up again, his gaze wandering. "There is... much to do, much to think about..."
texts.zh:
"不！" 他大惊失色，喊道，"那她就要归 霸主 了？"

"肯定是 Daud 搞鬼！" 他说着说着，双手开始猛搓，"对上了，对上了！他可是罪犯养大的，正是在社会底层磨炼过，才会如此狡猾！"

他抬头看了看你，双手终于不再乱动，好像这会他才反应过来，你其实能看到他的一举一动，"自然，我很钦佩 Daud。他居然能做到这么多，从社会的寄生虫，一路做到整个 霸主 的总指挥？真是了不起。"

说着说着，他的双手又开始不自觉的摩挲起来，目光也开始四处游移，"有很多...很多事得想，很多事得做..."

texts.en: You've already lied once to Macario. It might test his patience to push further.
texts.zh: 你已经向 Macario 撒过一次谎。继续撒谎可能会考验他的耐心。

options.en: Consider some truths to tell Macario
options.zh: 向 Macario 坦白一些事实

options.en: If it comes to it, Hyder would back Caden's leadership. (lie)
options.zh: 如果有必要的话，Hyder 会支持 Caden 的领导。 (说谎)

options.en: Hyder will back you as leader, though she is reluctant. (lie)
options.zh: 尽管 Hyder 不情愿，但她会支持你作为领导者。 (说谎)

options.en: She thinks that no one could lead the Sindrian Diktat but herself. (lie)
options.zh: 她认为除了她自己，没人能够领导 辛达强权。 (说谎)

options.en: I believe that Hyder wants to defect to the Hegemony. (lie)
options.zh: 我认为 Hyder 更想叛逃去 霸主。 (说谎)

options.en: That's all I have to say.
options.zh: 我要说的就是这些。

texts.en:
"Fascinating," he leans forward.

"She always did admire Andrada's boldness and genius. And while Caden is no Andrada, he might serve as an acceptable... substitute. The alternative would be chaos. Hyder can see that, and perhaps she is capable of putting aside her personal feelings for the greater good... yes, that could be it."
texts.zh:
"这想法，真是令人着迷。" 他说着，身子稍微前倾。

"她可实打实的一直在敬仰着 Andrada，她敬仰他的果敢，敬仰他的才华。虽说 Caden 不是 Andrada，让 Caden 替代 Andrada，倒也勉强可以接受 —— 没 Caden 上位的话，就要乱了套了。Hyder 也能看出让 Caden 上台的必要性，说不定，她还能放下自己的个人情感，顾全大局，请他上位... 对，这种事也有可能。"

texts.en:
"Truly?" He leans back, rubbing his chin.

"This is an unexpected turn. As a trained military commander, perhaps Hyder recognizes - despite her personal feelings - that aligning herself with a powerful leader will lead to the best outcome..."
texts.zh:
"真的？" 他说着，身子猛的向后一靠，若有所思地摩挲下巴。

"这么一出可真是出人意料。或许，Hyder 这样训练精良的军官能认清现状，无论个人好恶如何，她都能意识到只有与强势领袖做盟友，才能达到皆大欢喜。"

texts.en:
"Hyder? Leading the Sindrian Diktat?" He blurts out a single laugh, but his eyes are not amused.

"Nonsense, of course. But if she believes there was not another choice that could fit within her peculiar sense of ethics and psychological need for order... placing herself in what she thinks is control... yes, the motive could fit."

He sighs, looking up. "Ah, but what this would cost! The question then is how much of the navy will back her - a not insignificant number of that, let us be realistic, rather plebeian force even looks up to her. She's 'strict but fair', they say."

He shakes his head, distracted; working out risk analyses for future schemes.
texts.zh:
"Hyder？让她领导 辛达强权？" 他说着说着，突然大笑一声，但他的眼神仍然严肃如一。

"当然，这种事肯定是异想天开。但，如果说，她相信要想践行她心中那种奇妙的道德观念，满足她心中对秩序的渴求，别无他法的话...就要登上她自认为的领袖之位...对，这个动机说得通。"

他叹了口气，抬头望去，"啊，但她若是想这么来，代价又得有多大！到时候就得问问，整个海军中支持她的又会有多少？说的实际点，她的支持者肯定少不了，不说海军，连那些平民都很尊重她呢。那些平民说，她虽然严苛，却很公正呢。"

他心不在焉的摇了摇头，估计正暗自评估着以后行动的风险。

texts.en:
"I must admit that you've underwhelmed me, captain."

Macario leans back, hands held together, eyes on you. "Perhaps, stars forgive my manners, but perhaps you have not been entirely forthright?"

"I would so hate for the potential of our little collaboration to, how to put it... there's a Luddic expression, 'die on the vine' I believe? Now there's an image." He smiles charmlessly.

"Speaking of, let me provide you another opportunity to demonstrate your worth." He pauses a moment, then adds in a not-quite-threatening tone, "I'm sure by the end you'll agree that I can be very forgiving."
texts.zh:
"我必须承认，你让我感到失望，舰长。" Macario 向后靠着，双手握在一起，注视着你，"或许 —— 请繁星原谅我的举止 —— 但或许，你并没有完全坦诚？"

"我非常讨厌我们之间这次小小合作的潜能...怎么说呢，用一个卢德的说法，'无果而终'，我相信是这样说的吧？这么说形象点。" 他毫不迷人地微笑着。

"说到这里，让我给你另一个展示你价值的机会。" 他停顿了一下，然后以一种不完全威胁的语气补充道，"我相信到最后你会留下这样一个印象，那就是我可以非常宽容。"

texts.en:
He pauses, and seems to notice his own hands grasping one another, like they're trying to strangle each other. He lets them fall to the desk in a deliberate motion.

"That was of mild interest. Confirming, I suppose, other sources," he leans back. "Ah, the rote work of intelligence gathering. It can't all end with a single, dramatic gunshot, eh?"

"Lucky for you, however, that's exactly what I've lined up with you in mind." He catches himself, amused, "No, no, not for you. One of Caden's agents on Umbra. I shall explain."
texts.zh:
他停顿了一下，似乎注意到自己的双手紧紧握在一起，力度大到就像它们想要勒死彼此一样。他故意将手砸到桌上。

"我有些感兴趣了。不如，我觉得，再确认一下其他信源？" 他向后靠着，"啊，情报收集的例行工作哟，并不是所有事情都会以一声戏剧性的枪响作结，对吧？"

"但你很幸运，我为你考虑的工作就是如此。" 他把自己给逗乐了，"不，不，不是说要射杀你，而是要你处理 Caden 在 Umbra 的一名特工。让我解释一下。"

texts.en:
"To tell the truth," Macario pauses to suppress a strange sound, like a hiccup, "you've been illuminating."

He leans back, hands grasping one another. "You could make a reasonable agent, were you more discreet."

He smiles hollowly. "Far more discreet."

"Happily, I have just the thing, just the thing. The level of discretion is up to you; you'll find that I supervise with a light hand, contrary to the lies told about me. If you need to raze a few habs from orbit to extract an agent, why, then I accept your professional judgment. But let me explain..."
texts.zh:
"说实话，" Macario 停顿了一下，压制住了一个奇怪的声音，像是打嗝，"你给我提供了很多启示。"

他向后靠着，双手握在一起。"如果你更加谨慎的话，你可以成为一个合格的特工。" 他茫然地笑了笑。"要更加谨慎才行。"

"幸运的是，我刚好有合适的情况，正好合适。自行裁量的等级取决于你；你会发现，与他们在我身上撒的谎相反，我的监督非常宽松。如果你需要搞轨道轰炸轰平几个定居点来营救一个特工，那么我接受你的专业判断。但是让我来解释一下..."

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Macario taps an unseen datapad.

"The Lion's Guard has its own intelligence section, of course. Wild about strong-jawed young men enforcing correct ideology and demonstrations of loyalty," he adopts a patiently patronizing tone. "Light on tradecraft."

"Sadly, one of Caden's agents on Umbra has been working for the insurrectionists from the beginning," he says. "Take the agent by force. Once Caden calms down, he will... approve of you cleaning up this embarrassment, you'll see. Just let him think he's in charge, that's all it takes."
texts.zh:
Macario 在个你看不到的数据平板上敲了几下。

"狮心卫队 当然有它们自己的情报部门。拘泥于让一脸正气的年轻人去端正意识形态，示范热血忠诚。" 他的语气像是个很有耐心的恩师一样，"却不重视间谍情报技术。"

"可惜了，Caden 在 Umbra 上的一名特工从一开始就一直在为叛乱分子效力。" 他说道，"强行带走那名特工。等到 Caden 冷静下来之后，他应该会...准许你处理这个尴尬的局面的，你就等着瞧吧。只需要让他觉得自己还是掌局者就够了。"

options.en: Confront Caden with his double-agent. Right.
options.zh: 让 Caden 面对他的双面特工。好的。

options.en: So this agent is working for the Resistance?
options.zh: 所以这名特工在为抵抗组织效力？

options.en: How long have you known about this?
options.zh: 你知道这件事多久了？

texts.en:
Macario smiles mirthlessly.

"You'll get along splendidly provided you can pretend your greatest aspiration is to lick Andrada's boots."
texts.zh: Macario 面带冷笑。"只要你能假装你最大的愿望是舔 Andrada 的靴子，你们会相处得很愉快的。"

options.en: End
options.zh: 结束

texts.en: "Off you go now." He stretches, straightens his uniform, then hits the comms cut-off without another word.
texts.zh: "你可以走了。" 他伸了个懒腰，整了整制服，然后直接切断了通讯链接。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"Indeed!" Macario says, wide-eyed.

"Imagine wasting years on such a hopeless cause! Then everything is undone because you were compromised by," he smiles with actual pleasure, dropping his voice into mock disappointment, "a friend."

"Oh, I shouldn't pay such attention to such small things. It is one of my few character flaws. But I do so enjoy the drama which plays between the lines of - and I'll be the first to admit - terribly dry intelligence reports. I do miss the old days, sometimes," he sighs.

"There was so much more time to conduct business... personally."
texts.zh:
"确实！" Macario 说道，双目圆睁。"想象一下你将多年的心血投入到这样一个毫无希望的泡影之上！然后一切都毁了，只因为你被别人陷害，" 他发自内心地微笑起来，以一种失望的口吻嘲讽道，"还是被一个朋友。"

"哦，我不应该对这样一件小事过于关注。这是我为数不多的性格缺陷当中的一个。但我实在是很享受这出在一摞摞 —— 我要第一个承认 —— 枯燥无味的情报报告中上演的好戏 。我的确怀念过去的那些美好时光，有时吧。" 他感叹道。

"那时有太多时间来开展一些...私人安排。"

texts.en:
Macario smiles mirthlessly.

"You're not without hope, captain."

"Now go nab that agent for the pompous clown. You'll get along splendidly with Caden provided you pretend that licking boots is your greatest aspiration."
texts.zh:
Macario 面带冷笑。"你并不是毫无希望，舰长。"

"现在将那个特工给抓住，并献给这个自大的小丑。只要你装作舔靴子是你最大的抱负，你会和 Caden 相处得很愉快的。"

texts.en: "Very good of her to notice," he says. "Pity there's nothing she can do about it."
texts.zh: "她能注意到这点真是太好了，" 他说道。"可惜她对此无能为力。"

texts.en:
"Hmm. Yes," Macario leans back, tapping his fingers together. "She is not wrong to see it. Ha! Caden. Imagine him in charge. Dress-up and parades while the worlds crumble."

"Not to worry," he says cheerfully, "Caden will perform quite adequately as figurehead provided he's given plenty of little distractions."
texts.zh:
"嗯，对。" Macario 向后靠着，几根手指随意敲着，"她的看法倒是没错。哈，Caden！想想他掌权是个什么样子：整个世界分崩离析之时，那货却还在纠结着穿着打扮，忙着组织阅兵！"

"不用担心。" 他愉快地说道，"只要给 Caden 足够多的小事，分散他的注意力，让他当个空架子领袖也挺合适。"

texts.en: "Good! You can't run a polity like a battleship!" Macario shakes his head, "Now if she'd simply recognize that the business of ruling should be handled by someone more capable."
texts.zh: "很好！操弄战舰与操弄政治终究是两码事！" Macario 摇了摇头，"就看她能不能认识到，统治这种事应该交给更有能力的人。"

texts.en:
"At least she put it together," Macario checks a fingernail for dirt.

"Hyder will just have to use what she's got more effectively - and source her contraband more stealthily. I've found that many subordinates can thrive under pressure," he adds helpfully.

"Hmm," he considers, "subject to circumstances, naturally."
texts.zh:
"至少她把事情搞清楚了。" Macario 检查了一下指甲上有没有脏东西。

"这下子，Hyder 就得更有效地利用她手上的资源，还得更隐秘地搞违禁品了。我发现，许多下属受到压力之后，反倒能茁壮成长。" 他又补上了一句，语气像是他在帮忙似的。

"嗯..." 他考虑着，"当然，茁壮成长与否，终究要取决于具体情况。"

texts.en: It may be to your advantage to tell Macario certain lies. He seems perceptive, so it is unlikely that you can get away with telling too many.
texts.zh: 向 Macario 讲一些谎言可能对你有利。但他似乎很敏感，所以你可能无法蒙混过关太多次。

texts.en:
"Really?" Macario looks amused, "How charming."

"Well, it doesn't hurt to give my operatives a bit of a challenge. Wouldn't want to let them go soft, eh?"

He taps each hand once on his desk, then brings them together and looks at you attentively. "Now tell me about Hyder."
texts.zh:
"真的吗？" Macario 好像被逗乐了，"那你可真友好呢。"

"嗯，给我的特工们一点挑战也无妨。可不能让他们太软弱，是吧？"

他两只手分别在桌子上敲了一下，然后将双手合拢，专注地看着你。"现在告诉我 Hyder 的情况。"

texts.en: "Oh?" Macario's eyebrow raises. "But you didn't."
texts.zh: "哦？" Macario 的眼眉轻挑。"但是你并没有。"

options.en: I assure you that I did.
options.zh: 我向你保证，我已经这么做了。

options.en: Can you be absolutely certain about what I did and didn't do?
options.zh: 你能完全确定我做了什么，又没做什么吗？

options.en: Fine. I'll transfer the prisoner.
options.zh: 好吧。我会移交囚犯的。

texts.en:
"Interesting," he says, then leans forward. "Don't disappoint me, captain. I think you're too smart to think I'm stupid."

He leans back again, and flicks his fingers. "Have the prisoner. I don't care. They'll end up dead one way or another. We like to tidy up loose ends around here. Now, about Hyder."
texts.zh:
"有趣。" 他说，然后向前倾身，"不要让我失望，舰长。我可觉得你那么聪明，不至于当我傻来着。"

他再次向后靠，轻轻挥动手指。"你就留着囚犯吧，我不在乎。无论如何，天有绝人之路，我们喜欢处理这种细枝末节。现在，说说 Hyder 的事情吧。"

texts.en:
"Interesting," he says, then leans forward. "Don't disappoint me, captain. I think you're too smart to think I'm stupid."

He leans back again, and flicks his fingers. "Have the prisoner. I don't care. They'll end up dead one way or another. We like to tidy up loose ends around here. Now, about Hyder."
texts.zh:
"有趣。" 他说，然后向前倾身，"不要让我失望，舰长。我可觉得你那么聪明，不至于当我傻来着。"

他再次向后靠，轻轻挥动手指。"你就留着囚犯吧，我不在乎。无论如何，天有绝人之路，我们喜欢处理这种细枝末节。现在，说说 Hyder 的事情吧。"

texts.en:
"You're giving up so easily." he says, looking hurt. Then he leans forward. "Do as you will, captain, but do not disappoint me. You're too smart for that, aren't you?"

He leans back again, and flicks his fingers. "Well, do transfer the prisoner. We like to tidy up loose ends around here. Now, about Hyder."
texts.zh:
"你就这么轻易放弃了。" 他说着说着，看来有点伤心。然后他向前倾身，"那就把囚犯交给我吧，舰长，但别再让我失望了。你这么聪明，肯定不会再做蠢事了，对吧？"

他再次向后靠，轻轻挥动手指。"行，这回一定要把那货交给我，我们喜欢处理这种细枝末节。现在，说说 Hyder 的事情吧。"

texts.en: "Yes yes, very sad, accidents and so forth," he says impatiently. "Tell me about Hyder."
texts.zh: "对对对，非常遗憾，意外事故之类的。" 他不耐烦地说道，"还是跟我讲讲 Hyder 的事吧。"

texts.en:
After a short wait, Macario's image appears.

"Captain, captain, captain," he smirks. "I eagerly await the results of your discussion with my good friend the Guard High Deputy Executor."

"Until then?" He says this like it's a question, but it isn't. He's already killed the link.
texts.zh:
短暂等待之后，Macario 的形象出现在了通讯界面上。

"舰长，舰长，舰长哟。" 他满脸堆笑，"我可是很期待你和我那位担任卫队最高副首长的朋友谈出结果呢。"

"到时候见咯？" 听起来他在问你，但其实他自己已有定论，因为刚说完他就关掉了通讯链接。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: Prepare a raid to extract Caden's agent
options.zh: 准备一场劫掠以营救 Caden 的特工

texts.en:
Macario's file is highly detailed. It's clear that Sindrian Diktat intelligence has had sources embedded in both the Umbran ARC/ANTI-affiliated insurrectionists as well as the Lion's Guard for quite some time.

The double-agent's key locations are clearly described, though their schedule is erratic. A clean capture will involve multiple simultaneous strikes at insurrectionist bunkers, at which point the op will definitely go hot.

Sometimes a job simply requires making a bit of a mess.
texts.zh:
Macario 的档案非常详细。很明显，辛达强权 的情报人员在 Umbra 的革命者委员会和狮心卫队内部都有信息来源，而且时日不短。

虽然其日程安排并不规律，但这个双面特工出没的关键地点却有着非常清晰的描述。要想干净利落地将其抓获，势必要涉及对多个叛乱者堡垒的同步打击，届时，抓捕行动会十分激烈。

有时候动静闹得大一点，也是职责所在，不得不为。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: I need to find an agent working for the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我要找一个替辛达强权卖命的特工。

texts.en: "An agent?" $HeOrShe looks suspicious, "If you know anything about a Sindie spy on Umbra, tell me now and I'll have 'em before a revolutionary tribunal before the day is out."
texts.zh: "一名特工？" $HeOrShe看起来充满怀疑，"如果你知道在 Umbra 上有个当间谍的辛达佬的话，立刻告知我，我会在今天结束之前将那人送上革命法庭。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe is taken aback. "An agent? Here? I... I don't know what you're talking about. I mostly handle logistics."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe大吃一惊。"一个特工？就在这儿？我...我不知道你在说些什么。我主要负责后勤工作。"

texts.en:
"An agent. Here?"

A look of concern grows on her face.

"I can't say I'm surprised. If you have definitive intel about a Diktat spy on Umbra, then tell me. We'll assemble a revolutionary tribunal to sort this out."
texts.zh:
"一个间谍？在这里？" 她脸上浮现出担忧的神情。

"我对此并不感到意外。如果你掌握关于辛达强权间谍潜伏在 Umbra 的明确情报，那就告诉我。我们会组织革命法庭来彻查此事。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe is taken aback, then does a double take at a secondary display.

"Wait, aren't you working for the Sindies? You've got some real jets coming and talking to me direct and admitting it." $HeOrShe turns aside, "Gonna have a real talk with traffic control... "

Then $heOrShe furiously taps something into a comm-interface. Self-satisfied, $heOrShe says "I've put out an alert. Might want to go running back to hide behind daddy Andrada."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe大吃一惊，盯向另外某个显示屏，才反应过来。

"等等，你丫不是在给辛达佬做事吗？直接赶来和我说话，还如此大言不惭，好大的胆子。" $HeOrShe转了下身，"那我得跟交通管理那边好好说道说道了... "

然后，$heOrShe对着某个通讯界面愤怒的敲了几下子。干完之后，$heOrShe似乎得意起来了："我发了份警告，你丫最好滚回去，到你那 Andrada 老爹身后藏好咯。"

options.en: Explain the true situation
options.zh: 说明真实情况

options.en: Explain as if they were a triple-agent (lie)
options.zh: 把那人说成是三面特工 (说谎)

options.en: Um, never mind actually.
options.zh: 呃，其实还是算了吧。

texts.en:
You explain that to get into Dolos Macario's trust, such as it is, you need to 'capture' an agent who Horacio Caden thinks is working for the Lion's Guard but has actually been working for the resistance.

As an asset, they're already useless because Macario knows about their betrayal of the Sindrian Diktat. Their last act as an operative can be to help you 'prove' your dedication to the Spider's schemes.

It will be risky, but it should be possible for this agent to slip out of a death sentence by taking advantage of inter-service rivalry in the Sindrian Diktat.

Imoinu is silent as you explain, her expression grim.
texts.zh:
你解释道，为了取得 Dolos Macario 的信任 —— 尽管这份信任相当微薄 —— 你需要 '抓获' 一名 Horacio Caden 认为是在狮心卫队工作，但实际上一直在为抵抗组织效力的特工。

作为资产，这名特工已经毫无用处，因为 Macario 早已知道那人对 辛达强权 的背叛。而这人作为特工的最后一搏，就是帮你 '证明' 你对蜘蛛阴谋网的忠诚。

这固然有风险，但通过利用 辛达强权 的部门间矛盾，这名特工仍有可能从死刑判决中逃脱。

在你解释时，Imoinu 一直沉默不语，脸上写满了深切的忧虑。

options.en: They're burned, Imoinu. This way still gets a win for the ARC and the United Front.
options.zh: 那个人暴露了，Imoinu。这种方式依然能为 Askonia 革命者委员会和统一战线带来胜利。

texts.en:
She looks down, and sighs. Taking a moment to process.

Then looks back up. Her expression is resolute.

"You're right. We can make this work."
texts.zh:
她低下头，叹了口气，需要一点时间来消化这一切。

随后她重新抬起头，表情也变得坚定。

"你说得对，我们能办成这件事。"

options.en: I'll ensure they come to no harm.
options.zh: 而且他不会受到伤害。

options.en: And they'll definitely come to no harm. (lie)
options.zh: 而且他绝对不会受到伤害。 (说谎)

texts.en:
Arrangements are made, the agent - the strong-jawed image of the perfect Lion's Guard recruit - is briefed, then quietly transferred to your $shipOrFleet in a volatiles tank modified for smuggling human passengers.

"I hope you know what you're doing," Imoinu says.
texts.zh:
一切安排就绪。那名特工 —— 他有着棱角分明的下颌，堪称狮心卫队模范新兵的典型形象 —— 接到了任务简报，随后被悄然转移至你的$shipOrFleet上，藏身于一个经过改装、用于偷运人员的挥发物储藏罐中。

"希望你清楚自己在做什么。" Imoinu 说道。

texts.en:
You explain that an agent who Horacio Caden thinks is working for the Lion's Guard, and who the resistance thinks is working for them, is in fact working for a separate branch of Sindrian Diktat intelligence entirely - under Dolos Macario's command.

A triple agent, in other words. How else would you have such detailed inside information 'stolen' directly from Macario's INTSEC database?

It's a complex story, but you begin to see your suggested truth sink in to $personName.

"You mean to tell me they've been working against the uprising the whole time," she says, her outrage growing. "How do you have this information?"
texts.zh:
你解释道，有这样一名特工，Horacio Caden 以为这人在为狮心卫队办事，反抗军以为这人在为反抗军效力，但其实这人完完全全只听命于 辛达强权 的另一套情报系统，也就是 Dolos Macario 治下的那一套。

换句话说，这人其实是个三面特工。但你又是如何从 Macario 那个 INTSEC 的数据库里直接 "偷" 出这么多数据的呢？

这就说来话长了，但你已经看得出，$personName 已经开始相信你说的那套所谓真相了。

"你的意思是，那货一直以来都在暗中破坏起义？" 她说道，语气中的怒气逐渐升腾，"你是从哪里得知这些信息的？"

texts.en:
You explain that an agent who Horacio Caden thinks is working for the Lion's Guard, and who the resistance thinks is working for them, is in fact working for a separate branch of Sindrian Diktat intelligence entirely - under Dolos Macario's command.

A triple agent, in other words. How else would you have such detailed inside information 'stolen' directly from Macario's INTSEC database?

It's a complex story, but you begin to see your suggested truth sink in to $personName.

"You mean to tell me they've been working against the uprising the whole time," she says, her outrage growing. "You've helped us before, captain... and now this."
texts.zh:
你解释道，有这样一名特工，Horacio Caden 以为这人在为狮心卫队办事，反抗军以为这人在为反抗军效力，但其实这人完完全全只听命于 辛达强权 的另一套情报系统，也就是 Dolos Macario 治下的那一套。

换句话说，这人其实是个三面特工。但你又是如何从 Macario 那个 INTSEC 的数据库里直接 "偷" 出这么多数据的呢？

这就说来话长了，但你已经看得出，$personName 已经开始相信你说的那套所谓真相了。

"你的意思是，那货一直以来都在暗中破坏起义？" 她说道，语气中的怒气逐渐升腾，"你之前就一直在支持我们，舰长...如今又做了这些。"

texts.en:
You explain that an agent who Horacio Caden thinks is working for the Lion's Guard, and who the resistance thinks is working for them, is in fact working for a separate branch of Sindrian Diktat intelligence entirely - under Dolos Macario's command.

A triple agent, in other words. How else would you have such detailed inside information 'stolen' directly from Macario's INTSEC database?

It's a complex story. And $personName is not buying it.
texts.zh:
你解释道，有这样一名特工，Horacio Caden 以为这人在为狮心卫队办事，反抗军以为这人在为反抗军效力，但其实这人完完全全只听命于 辛达强权 的另一套情报系统，也就是 Dolos Macario 治下的那一套。

换句话说，这人其实是个三面特工。但你又是如何从 Macario 那个 INTSEC 的数据库里直接 "偷" 出这么多数据的呢？

这就说来话长了，而 $personName 显然并不买账。

texts.en:
You explain that an agent who Horacio Caden thinks is working for the Lion's Guard, and who the resistance thinks is working for them, is in fact working for a separate branch of Sindrian Diktat intelligence entirely - under Dolos Macario's command.

A triple agent, in other words. How else would you have such detailed inside information 'stolen' directly from Macario's INTSEC database?

It's a complex story, but you begin to see your suggested truth sink in to $personName.

"So... they've been working for the Sindies that whole time," $heOrShe says, shocked. "But how did you get this information? Who do you work for?"
texts.zh:
你解释道，有这样一名特工，Horacio Caden 以为这人在为狮心卫队办事，反抗军以为这人在为反抗军效力，但其实这人完完全全只听命于 辛达强权 的另一套情报系统，也就是 Dolos Macario 治下的那一套。

换句话说，这人其实是个三面特工。但你又是如何从 Macario 那个 INTSEC 的数据库里直接 "偷" 出这么多数据的呢？

这就说来话长了，但你已经看得出，$personName 已经开始相信你说的那套所谓真相了。

"所以说，那货其实一直在为辛达佬效力..." $heOrShe惊叹道，"但你又是从哪知道这些消息的？你又为谁做事？"

options.en: And I need this agent. To get into Macario's favor, infiltrate his schemes.
options.zh: 而我需要这名特工。这是为了赢得 Macario 的青睐，并渗透进他的阴谋之中。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
She doesn't look pleased with the idea.

"We usually deal with traitors internally," she says. "And quickly."

"But considering your past contributions to the uprising, I think the revolutionary tribunal could be persuaded of the efficacy of giving you custody of the traitor."

Her chin raises, "For the United Front."
texts.zh:
她对这个主意似乎并不满意。

"我们通常在内部处理叛徒，" 她说道，"并且很迅速。"

"但考虑到你过去对起义的贡献，我想革命法庭或许能被说服，相信将叛徒交由你监管是有效的。"

她抬起下巴，"为了联合阵线。"

options.en: For the United Front!
options.zh: 为了联合阵线！

texts.en: Arrangements are made, and the agent - the strong-jawed image of the perfect Lion's Guard recruit - is bound, gagged and quietly transferred to your $shipOrFleet in a volatiles tank modified for smuggling human passengers.
texts.zh: 一切安排就绪。那名特工 —— 他有着棱角分明的下颌，堪称狮心卫队模范新兵的典型形象 —— 被五花大绑并塞住嘴巴，随后被悄然转移至你的$shipOrFleet上，藏身于一个经过改装、用于偷运人员的挥发物储藏罐中。

texts.en:
"You're a liar." $HeOrShe looks at you suspiciously.

"Imoinu warned me about you. And your lies. I don't know who you're working for, or who you think you're working for, but I'm thinking this conversation is done."

$HeOrShe hits the cut-off.
texts.zh:
"你是个骗子。" $HeOrShe怀疑地注视你。

"关于你还有你的谎言，Imoinu 已经警告过我了。我不知道你是谁的人，或者你自以为替谁效命，但这次谈话到此为止。"

$HeOrShe切断了通讯。

options.en: Trust me. I've helped the ARC before, just ask Imoinu.
options.zh: 相信我。我以前帮助过 Askonia 革命者委员会，不信可以去问 Imoinu。

options.en: I'm secretly a Hegemony agent working to undermine the Diktat. (lie)
options.zh: 我其实是 霸主 的秘密特工，致力于暗中妨害 辛达强权。 (说谎)

options.en: Myself. And I hate the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 只为我自己做事，而且，我讨厌 辛达强权。

options.en: Myself. And I hate the Sindrian Diktat. (lie)
options.zh: 只为我自己做事，而且，我讨厌 辛达强权。 (说谎)

options.en: A deep-cover ARC cell you've never heard of. (lie)
options.zh: 我来自某个你未曾听闻的 Askonia 革命者委员会秘密支部。 (说谎)

options.en: I am of the Luddic faith and I fight our common enemy. (lie)
options.zh: 我信仰卢德教，我会与我们共同的敌人战斗。 (说谎)

options.en: I am of the Luddic faith and I fight our common enemy.
options.zh: 我信仰卢德教，我会与我们共同的敌人战斗。

options.en: Persean League fleet intelligence. My real name is 'Siyavong'. (lie)
options.zh: 我来自 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部，我的真名是 'Siyavong'。 (说谎)

texts.en:
"I will," $heOrShe says, then mutes the feed for a moment, turning to a secondary display.

You watch one side of a short conversation play out, and $heOrShe turns back to you, $hisOrHer expression much friendlier.

"I'm sorry for that, captain. Imoinu swears you're a friend of the United Front of the Askonian Resistance who has made valuable material contributions to the cause." $HeOrShe nods respectfully, "Then let me say that I'm proud to call you a comrade."
texts.zh:
"明白。" $heOrShe说道，随后将通讯静音了片刻，一边转向了一个副显示屏。

你看着一段简短的对话单方面进行着。之后，$heOrShe转回来面向你，$hisOrHer的表情也友善了许多。

"刚才很抱歉，舰长。Imoinu 发誓说你是 Askonian 联合抵抗阵线的朋友，并为事业做出了宝贵的物质贡献。" $HeOrShe尊敬地点了点头，"那么，请允许我自豪地称你为同志。"

options.en: Glad to hear it. Now about this agent...
options.zh: 很高兴听到这些。那么，这个特工的事...

texts.en:
"Of course. I appreciate your dedication to the cause. I'll have the traitor turned over to you, but... they really should properly be ours to subject to revolutionary justice."

$HeOrShe puts on a generous tone, "But we're for building bridges. For the United Front, right? So will come the day we will ask you for a favor, and we will expect it to be returned. For the Front."

"Can I trust," $heOrShe says darkly, "that you will see them to an appropriate end?"
texts.zh:
"当然了。我们不会忘记你的贡献。我会把叛徒交给你，但是... 原则上本应该让此等叛徒接受我们的革命审判才是。"

$HeOrShe说到此处，摆出一副大方的神态："不过，我们的目的是建立友谊。一切为了联合战线，是吧？所以当有一天我们向你寻求帮助的时候，希望你能将心比心。总而言之，一切为了联合战线。"

"我相信..." $heOrShe严肃地说，"你会让那叛徒罪有应得的，对吧？"

options.en: Naturally.
options.zh: 必须的。

texts.en:
"A Heggie," $heOrShe scowls. "Of course! I knew it from the start."

"But we are a practical movement, $heOrShe adds thoughtfully, "and we will work with a hostile authoritarian power if it serves the Revolution."
texts.zh:
"原来你丫是 霸主崽子 呀。" $heOrShe皱了皱眉，"当然是啦！我一开始可就看出来了。"

"但我们的革命运动相当务实。" $heOrShe若有所思，补充道，"只要对我们的革命有利，我们也能接受和某个敌对的威权势力暂时合作。"

options.en: Very open-minded of you. So about this agent...
options.zh: 你真的很开明呢。既然如此，那个特工...

texts.en: "Well," $heOrShe says. "Let me welcome you to the United Front of the Askonian Resistance. All of us anti-Diktat factions don't always get along, that's for sure. But at least we know who our enemy is."
texts.zh: "好吧。" $heOrShe致意道，"那就由我欢迎你来到 Askonia 反抗军统一战线吧。我们这些反 辛达强权 的小势力也不总是合得来，这是当然，但至少我们都清楚我们真正的敌人是谁。"

options.en: Thank you. So about this agent...
options.zh: 谢谢你。既然如此，那个特工...

texts.en: "Well," $heOrShe says. "Let me welcome you to the United Front of the Askonian Resistance. All of us anti-Diktat factions don't always get along, that's for sure. But at least we know who our enemy is."
texts.zh: "好吧。" $heOrShe致意道，"那就由我欢迎你来到 Askonia 反抗军统一战线吧。我们这些反 辛达强权 的小势力也不总是合得来，这是当然，但至少我们都清楚我们真正的敌人是谁。"

options.en: Thank you. So about this agent...
options.zh: 谢谢你。既然如此，那个特工...

texts.en: "That... makes sense, yes," $heOrShe slowly nods. "Well, I am glad to meet you, comrade. We shall further the Revolution together!"
texts.zh: "那...没错，也说得通。" $heOrShe说着说着，慢慢点了几下头，"好吧，同志，很高兴能见到你。让我们齐心协力，将革命进行到底！"

texts.en:
"Huh. I guess you're not from a cell I've heard of. But that's good OPSEC." $HeOrShe slowly nods.

"Well, I am glad to meet you, comrade. We shall further the Revolution together!"
texts.zh:
"嗯，看来你不是我听说过的任何一个小组的人。不过这保密工作做得不错。" $HeOrShe说着说着，慢慢点了几下头。

"好吧，同志，很高兴能见到你。让我们齐心协力，将革命进行到底！"

options.en: So, about this triple-agent serving the forces of reaction...
options.zh: 那么，对于这个为反抗组织服务的三面特工...

options.en: So, about this triple-agent serving the forces of reaction...
options.zh: 那么，对于这个为反抗组织服务的三面特工...

texts.en:
"Oh, you're from the Self Defense Covenant? We may not see eye-to-eye on all matters, but we welcome your part in the resistance against the common enemy."

"And um, blessings upon you?" $HeOrShe says awkwardly.
texts.zh:
"哦，你是自卫盟约的人？我们两边不可能在所有问题上都达成共识，但欢迎你加入抵抗共同敌人的行列。"

"还有，呃...愿卢德赐福于你？" $HeOrShe略带尴尬地补充道。

options.en: And upon you. Now about this agent...
options.zh: 也赐福于你。那么，这个特工的事...

texts.en:
"Ah, the League." $HeOrShe raises $hisOrHer chin. "A militaristic federation of exploiters."

"But less odious than the Diktat by far. We shall accept your assistance, Citizen Siyavong" $heOrShe says magnanimously."
texts.zh: "啊，你从联盟来的呀。" $HeOrShe抬了抬$hisOrHer的下巴，"英仙座联盟 是一伙信奉军国主义的压迫者同盟，但和 辛达强权 相比，还不算那么可憎。Siyavong 公民，我方将接受贵方的援助。" $heOrShe说道，语气颇显大方。

texts.en:
"Finlay Siyavong? Ha!"

You can hear the aristocrat in her laugh. It is bitter, and a skill for pointed cruelty lurks there.

"I've met him, you fool. You're not Siyavong. You're a liar. Who sent you, Macario?"
texts.zh:
"Finlay Siyavong？哈！"

她的笑声里透着贵族式的刻薄，显得十分苦涩，其间潜藏着一种尖锐刻薄的本事。

"我见过他，你这蠢货。你不是 Finlay Siyavong，你就是个骗子。谁把你派过来的，是 Macario？"

options.en: Your broad-mindedness is a virtue. Now about this agent...
options.zh: 您的宽宏大量是一种美德。那么这个特工...

options.en: Funny you should ask...
options.zh: 你问得可真巧...

texts.en:
"I don't care, liar. Die in vacuum."

She slams the cut-off.

If you're going to pull off this trick on one of the ARC leaders, you'd better do it quick, before Imoinu warns them.
texts.zh:
"我不在乎，骗子。死在真空里吧。"

她猛力切断了通讯。

如果你想对 Askonia 革命者委员会的某位头目施展这个骗局，最好赶在 Imoinu 警告他们之前尽快行动。

texts.en:
"Wait, what? You just said..."

$HeOrShe gives you a funny look.
texts.zh:
"等等，什么？你刚才明明说..."

$HeOrShe向你投来一个古怪的眼神。

options.en: Pretend to be capturing a triple-agent to assist the Resistance
options.zh: 假装抓捕一名三重间谍，以此协助抵抗组织

texts.en:
A pause as she takes in your image. "You again? Get lost."

She slams the cut-off.
texts.zh:
她顿了顿，打量着你。"又是你？赶快滚蛋。"

她猛力切断了通讯。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
After a short wait and a burst of static the makeshift comms network of Umbra finally relays you through.

"Death to Andrada," she says as a greeting. "What do you want?"
texts.zh:
稍等片刻，一阵静电杂音过后，Umbra 那套东拼西凑的通讯网络总算把你的信号接了进去。

"打倒 Andrada，\" 她拿这话当招呼。\"有什么事？"

texts.en:
After a short wait and a burst of static the makeshift comms network of Umbra finally relays you through.

"Death to Andrada," she says as a greeting. "Captain $playerName, it's good to see you."
texts.zh:
稍等片刻，一阵静电杂音过后，Umbra 那套东拼西凑的通讯网络总算把你的信号接了进去。

"打倒 Andrada，\" 她拿这话当招呼。\"$playerName 舰长，见到你真好。"

texts.en:
"$playerName the liar." She scowls. "Didn't I tell you to go suck vacuum?"
OR
"The liar returns." She sniffs, and somehow looks down at you through the comms.

"Back to waste my time?"
texts.zh:
"$playerName，那个骗子。\" 她沉下脸。\"我不是叫你去吸真空吗？"
OR
"骗子又回来了。" 她哼了一声，隔着通讯竟也能摆出俯视你的样子。

"又来浪费我的时间？"

texts.en:
"Back again." She gives you a look. "Did you forget something?"
OR
"Didn't you just comms?" She looks annoyed. "Out with it."
texts.zh:
"又来了。\" 她瞥了你一眼。\"落下什么东西了？"
OR
"不是刚通过话吗？\" 她一脸不耐。\"有话快说。"

texts.en:
"Back again." She gives you a look. "Can I help you with something?"
OR
"Didn't you just comms?" She raises an eyebrow.

"Well, out with it."
texts.zh:
"又来了。\" 她瞥了你一眼。\"有什么要我帮忙的？"
OR
"不是刚通过话吗？" 她挑了挑眉。

"那就说吧。"

texts.en:
After a short wait and a burst of static the makeshift comms network of Umbra finally relays you through.

"Death to all Andradas," she says as a greeting. "What do you want?"
texts.zh:
稍等片刻，一阵静电杂音过后，Umbra 那套东拼西凑的通讯网络总算把你的信号接了进去。

"打倒所有 Andrada 家的人，\" 她拿这话当招呼。\"有什么事？"

texts.en: "Yeah, what is it?
texts.zh: "是啊，什么事？"

texts.en: "Oh. $PlayerName." She looks tired. "What are you here for?"
texts.zh: "哦。是$PlayerName。\" 她一脸倦意。\"你来做什么？"

texts.en: "Captain," she says in greeting, defiant as ever. "Welcome to Askonia."
texts.zh: "舰长，\" 她照例招呼一声，还是那副不服输的劲头。\"欢迎来到 Askonia。"

texts.en: "$PlayerName," she says, defiant as ever.
texts.zh: "$PlayerName，" 她说道，还是那副不服输的劲头。

texts.en:
After a short wait and a burst of static the makeshift comms network of Umbra finally relays you through.

"Death to Andrada," she says as a greeting. Her eyes narrow as she takes you in.

"Aren't you... you're $playerName!"

She doesn't sound pleased to see you.
texts.zh:
经过短暂的等待后，随着一阵静电杂音，Umbra 上临时的通讯网络终于接通。

"Andrada 必死，" 她以此作为问候语。看清你后，她眯起了眼睛。

"你不是...你是 $playerName！"

她的语气听起来并不乐意见到你。

options.en: Yes, that's me.
options.zh: 不错，正是本人。

options.en: Ah, so you've heard of me. Very good.
options.zh: 啊，看来你听说过我。很好。

options.en: Perhaps you've mistaken me for someone else. (lie)
options.zh: 或许你认错人了。 (说谎)

texts.en:
"You're a bloody-booted minion of the Diktat and I'll have you spaced for your crimes the moment I get the chance."

Her dismissal is backed by the arrogance of a gens-heir.

And is made complete as she slams the comms shut-off.
texts.zh:
"你不过是辛达强权血靴下的走狗，等我找到机会，我一定会把你扔进太空，让你为自己的罪行付出代价。"

她那句轻蔑的斥责带着贵族后裔特有的傲慢。

随着通讯器被狠狠摔上，这番谈话彻底落幕。

texts.en: "No," she says deadpan. "Not good."
texts.zh: "不，" 她面无表情地说道，"一点都不好。"

texts.en: "No," she says deadpan. "I have not."
texts.zh: "不，" 她面无表情地说道，"我没认错。"

options.en: Aren't you Gens Kato? What are you doing on Umbra?
options.zh: 你不是 Kato 氏族的吗？你在 Umbra 上做什么？

texts.en:
"Yeah, what of it?"

She sticks her chin up, striking what is intended to be a defiant expression.

"I'm here to fight the brutal oppressions and liberate the Askonian System!"
texts.zh:
"是又怎样？"

她扬起下巴，摆出挑衅的姿态。

"我来此是为反抗暴虐的压迫，解放 Askonian 星系！"

texts.en:
"Yeah, what of it? Got another blatant lie to sell?"

She sticks her chin up, striking what is intended to be a defiant expression.

"I'm here to fight the brutal oppressions and liberate the Askonian System!"
texts.zh:
"是啊，那又怎样？又编好了什么瞎话来兜售？"

她扬起下巴，努力摆出一副不肯服软的表情。

"我来这儿，就是要反抗残暴的压迫，解放 Askonia 星系！"

options.en: Doesn't your family, your gens, object?
options.zh: 你的家族，你的氏族，难道不反对吗？

options.en: I met Dardan. Is he your brother?
options.zh: 我见过 Dardan 了，他是你的兄弟吗？

options.en: I salute your dedication. It is a just cause.
options.zh: 我向你的奉献精神致敬，这是正义的事业。

options.en: It seems a doomed cause. Don't you want to go home?
options.zh: 这似乎是注定失败的事业，你难道不想回家吗？

options.en: That's very... uh, noble of you.
options.zh: 你可真是...呃，很高尚。

options.en: That's rich talk coming from a Gens baby.
options.zh: 这都是纨绔子弟才会发出的天真言论。

options.en: I mean to say you're in a difficult position, but I do support your cause.
options.zh: 我是说虽然你的处境艰难，但我确实支持你的事业。

options.en: Look, you're gens Kato. You're throwing yourself away on Umbra.
options.zh: 听着，你是 Kato 氏族的人。你呆在 Umbra 上简直是自暴自弃。

options.en: You do what you like. Forget I brought it up, it's not my business.
options.zh: 你爱怎样便怎样。就当我没提过，这不关我事。

texts.en:
"Of course they object," she says. "They're part of an aristocratic elite whose position is predicated on the extractive exploitation of the masses."

 A hint of a smile appears. "And I've chosen to fight everything they stand for."
texts.zh:
"他们当然反对，" 她说道，"这群贵族精英的地位本就建立在剥削大众的基础上。"

她的脸上浮现出一丝笑意，"而我选择反抗他们代表的一切。"

texts.en:
"He is." She looks taken aback, but quickly recovers her composure.

"You met him? He's still on Mazalot suppressing the Luddics for the gens, I suppose."
texts.zh:
"确实如此。" 她略显错愕，但迅速恢复镇定。

"你见过他？我猜他还在 Mazalot 为氏族镇压卢德分子吧。"

options.en: He is. He became... rather angry at me.
options.zh: 是的。他变得...对我相当愤怒。

options.en: He is. He was helpful.
options.zh: 是的。他相当乐于助人。

options.en: He is. He seems unhappy in his current post.
options.zh: 是的。他似乎对当前的职位并不满意。

texts.en:
"You don't say!"

She laughs. You can hear the echo of long-running sibling conflict.

"Of course he's angry. He's there on behalf of the gens to hammer the Luddic faithful into compliant citizens of the League! The only tools he can imagine are force and fear because he thinks the Luddics are irrational sub-humans. Like stupid, simple animals."

She shakes her head, "He can't help but fail."
texts.zh:
"可不是嘛！"

她大笑起来，你能听出其中绵延多年的兄妹矛盾。

"他当然愤怒。他代表氏族在那里用铁腕将虔诚的卢德信徒 '锤炼' 成联盟的顺民！他所能想到的工具唯有暴力与恐惧，因为他视卢德分子为非理性的次等人，就像愚昧低等的动物。"

她摇头叹道，"他注定失败。"

texts.en:
"Dardan, helpful?" She scoffs. "Doesn't sound like him."

"He's there on behalf of the gens to hammer the Luddic faithful into compliant citizens of the League! The only tools he can imagine are force and fear because he thinks the Luddics are irrational sub-humans. Like stupid, simple animals."

She shakes her head, "He can't help but fail."
texts.zh:
"Dardan，乐于助人？" 她嗤之以鼻，"这可不像他。"

"他代表氏族在那里用铁腕将虔诚的卢德信徒 '锤炼' 成联盟的顺民！他所能想到的工具唯有暴力与恐惧，因为他视卢德分子为非理性的次等人，就像愚昧低等的动物。"

她摇头叹道，"他注定失败。"

texts.en:
"You don't say!"

She laughs. You can hear the echo of long-running sibling conflict.

"Of course he's unhappy. He's there on behalf of the gens to hammer the Luddic faithful into compliant citizens of the League! The only tools he can imagine are force and fear because he thinks the Luddics are irrational sub-humans. Like stupid, simple animals."

She shakes her head, "He can't help but fail."
texts.zh:
"可不是嘛！"

她大笑起来，你能听出其中绵延多年的兄妹矛盾。

"他当然不满意。他代表氏族在那里用铁腕将虔诚的卢德信徒 '锤炼' 成联盟的顺民！他所能想到的工具唯有暴力与恐惧，因为他视卢德分子为非理性的次等人，就像愚昧低等的动物。"

她摇头叹道，"他注定失败。"

texts.en:
"A pathetic attempt to ingratiate yourself after your previous blunder. Your ruse wouldn't work on a child." Her eyes narrow.

"Tell me, are you another freelancer hired by my grandmother to come admonish me? Tell her she's wasted her credits."
texts.zh:
"在搞砸了之后，现在又想讨好我，真是可悲的尝试。你这套把戏连小孩子都骗不了。" 她眯起了眼睛。

"告诉我，你也是我祖母雇来训诫我的自由佣兵吗？转告她，她的星币白花了。"

texts.en:
"A pathetic attempt to ingratiate yourself after your previous blunder. Your ruse wouldn't work on a child." Her eyes narrow.

"Tell me, are you another freelancer hired by my grandmother to come admonish me? Tell her she's wasted her credits."
texts.zh:
"上回出了丑，这会儿又来讨好，可真够可怜的。这点把戏连小孩都骗不过。" 她眯起了眼睛。

"说吧，你又是我祖母花钱雇来教训我的自由从业者？回去告诉她，星币算是白花了。"

texts.en: "It is," she nods. "And I'm glad you can see that, despite the... difficulties."
texts.zh: "正是如此，" 她点头道，"我很高兴你能理解这一点，尽管存在...困难。"

options.en: I truly have no idea what you're talking about.
options.zh: 我真的不明白你在说什么。

options.en: Are you telling me I could have been paid for this?
options.zh: 你是说我本可以为此拿到报酬？

options.en: I truly have no idea what you're talking about.
options.zh: 我是真不知道你在说什么。

options.en: Are you telling me I could have been paid for this?
options.zh: 你是说，这事儿我本来还能拿钱？

options.en: Difficulties?
options.zh: 困难？

options.en: You mean, being stuck on a pirate-infested icecube with no fleet.
options.zh: 你是指，困在这个海盗横行的冰疙瘩上，手上一支舰队也没有。

texts.en:
She considers your reply.

"Huh. For once, I don't think you're lying." Imoinu looks away for a moment. Her resolve hardens again. "Whatever."

"And what are you really? A hired killer for execs and admirals? Profiteer from the organs harvested from the desperate masses? Go suck vacuum."

She slams the cut-off.
texts.zh:
她思忖着你的回答。"哼。"

"这是唯一一次，我觉得你没撒谎。" Imoinu 移开视线片刻，随即再度坚定起来。"随便吧。"

"那你究竟是什么人？为高管和将军卖命的雇佣杀手？从绝望大众身上收割器官牟利的奸商？还是滚去真空里哈气吧。"

她猛力切断了通讯。

texts.en:
She considers your reply. "Huh."

"So you're not working for her." Imoinu looks away for a moment.

"Yeah, she wants me back to be a good gens-heir. Says I'm shaming the family. And if I am? Good. They deserve it for what's been done in the name of Gens Kato."
texts.zh:
她思忖着你的回答。"哼。"

"所以你不是为她办事的。" Imoinu 移开视线片刻。

"对，她想让我回去当个合格的氏族继承人，又说我让氏族蒙羞。就算真是这样？好啊。就凭他们以 Kato 氏族之名做的那些事，这是应得的报应。"

texts.en:
"The ARC navy is... it's mostly opportunistic pirates. A few have good ideology, but most..." She sighs. "It's not easy."

"The United Front is united more by bickering and infighting than solidarity. The Charterists are eternally fundraising, keeping all the credits for running their tours and parties instead of fighting. The Volturnian Self Defense Covenant puts up a real fight, but they're held back from true revolutionary consciousness by the reactionary elements of Luddic ideology. So all they can do is bleed out into that ocean of theirs..."
texts.zh:
"Askonia 革命者委员会的海军...大多是投机海盗。虽然少数人有好的理念，但多数..." 她叹道，"这并不容易。"

"联合阵线的团结更多体现在争吵和内斗上，而非真正的团结。宪章派永远在筹款，把所有星币都花在巡演和派对上，而非战斗。Volturn 自卫盟约确实在奋战，但他们被卢德思想中的反动元素所束缚，无法形成真正的革命觉悟。所以他们只能在自己那片海洋里慢慢失血..."

options.en: Why not go back to Kazeron and find a way to support the fight from inside the League?
options.zh: 为什么不回到 Kazeron，在联盟内部寻找支持斗争的方法？

options.en: What if you go to Volturn. Help the, um, Volturn Covenant?
options.zh: 如果你前往 Volturn 呢？去帮助那个，呃，Volturn 盟约？

texts.en:
"No..." She shakes her head.

"On Kazeron, the gens are too dominant. The moment I stepped off the shuttle they'd have some doctor declare me insane and lock me up in an estate dome on the dark side of Draugr so I stop 'embarrassing our gens'."
texts.zh:
"不..." 她摇头道。

"在 Kazeron，氏族势力太过强大了。我一下穿梭机，他们就会让某个医生宣布我精神失常，把我关进 Draugr 暗面的庄园穹顶里，好让我停止 '给氏族蒙羞'。"

options.en: I know someone on Westernesse who might help you. Cavin Pharoh.
options.zh: 我认识 Westernesse 上的一个人，他或许能帮你。Cavin Pharoh。

options.en: If you need safe transport to an independent world, I can arrange it.
options.zh: 如果你需要前往独立世界的安保运输，我可以安排。

options.en: I did transport an old man and a kid to Volturn. I think they're part of your resistance...
options.zh: 我确实运送过一位老人和一个孩子去 Volturn。我觉得他们是你的抵抗组织的一员...

options.en: I did transport a kid and his robot to Volturn, I think they wanted to join your resistance...
options.zh: 我确实运送过一个孩子和他的机器人去 Volturn，我觉得他们是想加入你的抵抗组织...

options.en: Do you need armaments? Supplies? Credits?
options.zh: 你们需要军火吗？补给？还是星币？

options.en: That's all I can think of for now.
options.zh: 目前我只能想到这些了。

options.en: Then stay here and freeze! I can't solve all your problems for you.
options.zh: 那就留在这里喝西北风去吧！我没法替你解决所有问题。

texts.en:
"I haven't heard the name."

She leans forward, "Is he an organizer? An arms dealer? A mercenary, a terrorist?"
texts.zh:
"我没听过这个名字。"

她身体前倾，"他是组织者？军火商？佣兵，还是恐怖分子？"

options.en: I think he's maybe some kind of artist?
options.zh: 我觉得他可能是某种艺术家？

options.en: I'm not sure. I just visited a slum where he was probably squatting.
options.zh: 我不确定，我刚去过一个他可能曾暂居过的贫民区。

texts.en:
"Um."

Imoinu gives you a look of re-assessment, the sort that seems to ask if the subject has all of their reactor plating installed correctly, so to speak.

"Thanks," she manages. "I uh, I'll... look him up. If I need an artist."
texts.zh:
"呃。"

Imoinu 向你投来重新审视的目光，那是一种仿佛在确认对方的反应堆护板是否安装妥当的眼神，可以这么说。

"谢了，" 她勉强说道，"我，呃，会...查查他的资料。如果哪天需要艺术家的话。"

texts.en:
"Um." Imoinu gives you a look of re-assessment, the sort that asks, 'Is this person crazy?'

"Uh. Thanks. I'll... look him up if I need somewhere to stay on Westernesse."
texts.zh:
"呃。" Imoinu 向你投来重新审视的目光，那是一种仿佛在问 '这人是不是疯了？' 的眼神。

"呃。谢了。如果我哪天需要在 Westernesse 落脚的话...我会查查他的信息。"

texts.en:
A long pause, then she speaks.

"I'll keep that in mind."
texts.zh:
沉默许久后，她说道。

"我会记在心里的。"

texts.en:
"An old man and a kid?" She looks confused, mostly at your implied expectation that she would know what you're talking about.

"I haven't heard anything about that. I couldn't say if they were important, or..."
texts.zh:
"一个老人和一个孩子？" 她看上去很困惑，主要是对你暗示她应该明白你在说什么的期待而感到不解。

"我没听说这事，也无法判断他们是否重要，或者..."

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Look. I'm sure the local ARC cells will take them in if they have a contact."
texts.zh: "听着。如果他们有联络人，本地的 Askonia 革命者委员会分部肯定会收留他们的。"

texts.en: "A kid and a robot?" She makes a face. "I don't see how that's helpful."
texts.zh: "一个孩子和机器人？" 她做了个怪表情，"我看不出这有什么用。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "I mean." Realizing her dismissiveness, she attempts a more conciliatory tone. "I'm sure if this kid is dedicated to the cause, they'll figure out how to join the ARC."
texts.zh: "我是说。" 意识到自己的轻慢态度后，她试图转用更缓和的语气，"我相信如果这孩子真心投身于事业，那他总会找到加入 Askonia 革命者委员会的方法。"

texts.en:
"I thank you for your offer, captain, but I'm still arranging distribution of your previous contribution. It takes about a month to get everything where it needs to go."

She pauses, hesitant. Then explains, the frustration clear in her expression.

"The problem is if we stockpile too much materiel... it starts to 'get lost'. We work with a large number of individuals who are not... as ideologically committed to the ARC, and to the uprising, as I'd prefer."
texts.zh:
"感谢你的提议，舰长，但我仍在分发你之前的支援物资。将所有物资送达所需地点需要大约一个月的时间。"

她顿了顿，略显犹豫。随后解释道，神情明显带着沮丧。

"问题在于如果我们囤积过多物资、星币、补给...它们就会开始 '丢失'。我们合作的大量人员并非...像我们期望那样，对 Askonia 革命者委员会、对起义事业抱有坚定的意识形态认同。"

texts.en:
"I thank you for your offer, captain, but I'm still arranging distribution of your previous contribution. It'll take about two days to get everything where it needs to go."

She pauses, hesitant. Then explains, the frustration clear in her expression.

"The problem is if we stockpile too much materiel... it starts to 'get lost'. We work with a large number of individuals who are not... as ideologically committed to the ARC, and to the uprising, as I'd prefer."
texts.zh:
"多谢你的好意，舰长，可你上回捐的那批东西我还没分发完。要把一切都送到该去的地方，还得两天左右。"

她迟疑着顿了顿，这才解释起来，一脸的懊恼明明白白写在脸上。

"麻烦在于，物资一旦囤得太多... 就开始'不翼而飞'了。跟我们打交道的那么些人，对 ARC、对起义的信念，可没我希望的那么... 坚定。"

texts.en:
She perks up. "Yes!"

"We need all the help we can get! Fuel, supplies and no, not credits exactly..."

Imoinu looks at you, her eyes hard.

"If we're going to launch an uprising against the tyrant from every polity he's put under his boot, we're going to need weapons. Heavy weapons."
texts.zh:
她一下来了精神。"太好了！"

"我们缺人手缺得紧，什么支援都要！燃料、补给，还有，不，倒也不全是星币..."

Imoinu 盯着你，眼神硬了起来。

"要把那个把一个个政体都踩在脚下的暴君掀翻，我们就得有武器。重武器。"

texts.en:
"Yes!" She perks up. "We need all the help we can get! Fuel, supplies and no, not credits exactly..."

Imoinu looks at you, eyes hard.

"We're fighting against those tyrants in every polity they've stamped their boots over. We need weapons, heavy weapons. And fuel, and supplies."
texts.zh:
"太好了！\" 她一下来了精神。\"什么支援我们都缺！燃料、补给，还有，不，倒也不全是星币..."

Imoinu 盯着你，眼神硬了起来。

"那些暴君把一个个政体都踩在脚下，我们就是在跟他们打。我们要武器，重武器。还要燃料，要补给。"

texts.en:
She perks up. "Yes. Absolutely."
OR
"It would be much appreciated," she says.
texts.zh:
她眼睛一亮。"当然。绝对的。"
OR
"这真是帮了大忙了，" 她说道。

texts.en: "The fuel you've given is already bringing in more weapons and recruits. And we're running hit-and-run operations on Diktat convoys further out than ever!"
texts.zh: "你给的燃料已经换回更多武器和人手了。我们对辛达强权的运输队打起了游击，比以往伸得还远！"

texts.en: "I've managed to smuggle most of the weapons to cells on Volturn and Sindria," she grins. "When we rise, their bunkers and mechs will fall."
texts.zh: "大部分武器我都设法偷运给了 Volturn 和 Sindria 上的地下小组，" 她咧嘴一笑。"等我们起事，他们的地堡和机甲都得塌。"

texts.en: "I've managed to smuggle most of the weapons to cells on Volturn and Sindria," she grins. "The bootlickers in their bunkers and mechs are already discovering that they're not so invincible as they thought."
texts.zh: "大部分武器我都设法偷运给了 Volturn 和 Sindria 上的地下小组，" 她咧嘴一笑。"那些躲在地堡和机甲里的走狗，已经开始明白自己没那么不可战胜了。"

texts.en: "I got the supplies out - most of them - to comrades across the system." She looks quite earnest, as she speaks. "Thanks to you, they'll be ready for the uprising."
texts.zh: "补给我发出去了 —— 大部分吧 —— 送到了星系各处的同志手里。\" 她说得十分恳切。\"多亏了你，起事那天他们才备得齐。"

texts.en:
She looks at you suspiciously.

"Why? Aren't you just another bloody-handed mercenary for a choose-your-flavor imperialist?"

"为什么？你不又是个双手沾血、随便给哪路帝国主义者都能卖命的雇佣兵？"

texts.en:
"You've been an invaluable help to the resistance," she says, "but there's not much more you can do for us on Umbra."

"If you can use any of your influence, your abilities, to advance the cause through other contacts, organizations..."

"As for me, I've got work to do. She looks grimly determined, despite her youth. "The general uprising of the United Front isn't going to launch itself!"
texts.zh:
"你帮了抵抗组织天大的忙，\" 她说道，\"不过在 Umbra，你能替我们做的已经不多了。"

"要是你能拿自己的人脉、自己的本事，通过别的门路、别的组织，把事业往前推一推..."

"至于我，还有活要干。\" 她年纪虽轻，神情却决绝。\"联合阵线的总起义，可不会自己发动起来！"

texts.en:
"You're an invaluable help to the resistance," she says, "but there's not much more you can do for us on Umbra."

"If you can use any of your influence, your abilities, to fight for the uprising through other contacts, organizations..."

"As for me, I've got work to do. She looks grimly determined, despite her youth. "This war for liberation from the tyrrany of Andradas isn't going to fight itself."
texts.zh:
"你帮了抵抗组织天大的忙，\" 她说道，\"不过在 Umbra，你能替我们做的已经不多了。"

"要是你能拿自己的人脉、自己的本事，通过别的门路、别的组织，替起义再出一把力..."

"至于我，还有活要干。\" 她年纪虽轻，神情却决绝。\"这场挣脱 Andrada 家族暴政的解放战争，可不会自己打起来。"

texts.en:
"When the time is right," she grins, "You'll be able to see the fireworks from Kazeron."

Imoinu clears her throat.

"I'd... be proud to call you my comrade, captain," she says. "Thank you."
texts.zh:
"等时机一到，\" 她咧嘴一笑，\"你在 Kazeron 都能望见那场烟火。"

Imoinu 清了清嗓子。

"我会... 很自豪能叫你一声同志，舰长，\" 她说道。\"谢谢你。"

texts.en:
She looks appalled. And amused.

"Incredible. Our 'betters' are so petty. The lengths they'll go to sabotage within their own class!"

Imoinu shrugs while rolling her eyes.

"Well if it means you're willing to arm the uprising, I'll take it."
texts.zh:
她一脸震惊，又忍不住觉得好笑。

"真是开了眼。我们那些'上等人'竟这么小气，为了在同阶级里互相拆台，什么手段都使得出来！"

Imoinu 翻着白眼耸了耸肩。

"行吧，只要这意味着你肯给起义送军火，我就收下。"

options.en: Then we're agreed.
options.zh: 那就这么定了。

texts.en: "Agreed." She nods, allowing a smile to slip through her well-practiced expression of revolutionary stoicism. "I'll take your weapons."
texts.zh: "成交。\" 她点点头，那副练得炉火纯青的革命者坚毅神情里，漏出了一丝笑意。\"你的武器，我收下了。"

texts.en:
"Well," she's still reserved. "I suppose it doesn't matter if the ideological basis for your motivation is unsound... weapons are weapons. And if you're willing to arm the uprising, I'll accept them."

"Just don't," an accusing finger appears, "think I'll sell out the revolution for lucre."
texts.zh:
"好吧，\" 她仍旧有所保留。\"你那些动机的思想根基站不站得住脚，我看也不打紧... 武器就是武器。只要你肯给起义送军火，我就收。"

"只是别，\" 一根手指头指了过来，\"以为我会为了几个钱把革命卖了。"

options.en: Then we're agreed.
options.zh: 那就这么定了。

texts.en:
"Well," she's still reserved. "I suppose it doesn't matter if your motivations are a perverse sublimination of ownerist grievance psychology... weapons are weapons. And if you're willing to arm the uprising, I'll accept them."

"Just don't," an accusing finger appears, "think I'll sell out the revolution for lucre."
texts.zh:
"好吧，\" 她仍旧有所保留。\"就算你那点动机，不过是有产者怨愤心理的一番扭曲升华... 武器就是武器。只要你肯给起义送军火，我就收。"

"只是别，\" 一根手指头指了过来，\"以为我会为了几个钱把革命卖了。"

options.en: Then we're agreed.
options.zh: 那就这么定了。

texts.en:
She looks shocked by your words at first, but shock is quickly overcome by cynical amusement.

"I see. One of the aristocratic military caste employed by one faction of ownerist warmongers is seeking advantage over another."

"If it means you're going to arm the uprising," Imoinu says with a shrug, "I'll take it."
texts.zh:
她乍一听像是吃了一惊，可那点惊愕转眼就化成了带着嘲弄的玩味。

"我明白了。说到底，是一伙有产者好战势力雇来的军事贵族，想压过另一伙罢了。"

"只要这意味着你会给起义送军火，\" Imoinu 耸了耸肩，\"我就收下。"

options.en: Then we're agreed.
options.zh: 那就这么定了。

texts.en: She doesn't look terribly impressed.
texts.zh: 她看起来并不太感兴趣。
