"I'll throw the standard breakers at the decrypt job, but it's theoretically impossible it'll crack before the end of the universe. If you want to read these files, we're going to need another way in."

You have backups of the files made.

Whatever has Macario got his fingers into?
texts.zh:
你的技术军官点头认同了你的言外之意。

"我会用标准破解器去试一下解密，但理论上在宇宙终结之前它都不可能被破解。如果你想查阅这些文件的话，我们还需要另找些门路才行。"

你为所有文件做了备份。

Macario 到底把手伸进了什么地方？

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en: The comms go unanswered. The crest of the Sindrian Diktat internal security ministry slowly turns.
texts.zh: 通讯请求无人应答。辛达强权 内部安全部的徽标慢慢转动着。

texts.en:
The comms open with a soft chime.

"Independent $shipOrFleet," the merc says in a perfunctory monotone, "I have been contracted to destroy any ship or fleet," $heOrShe pauses politely so you may understand that you are just such a ship or fleet, "-which interferes with the debris field you just plundered. This communication is made not as a negotiation, but simply a matter of professional courtesy."

$HeOrShe produces a perfectly bland customer-service smile then hits the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
随着一声轻柔的提示音，通讯链接开启了。

"独立$shipOrFleet。" 佣兵单调地背着例行公事的词，"我方已签约摧毁任何舰船或是舰队。" $heOrShe礼貌地顿了顿，就是为了让你理解你就是这样的舰船或舰队。"只要有舰船或舰队与你方刚刚打捞的残骸区有过交集，即刻摧毁。该通讯并非协商，仅为体现我方专业素养。"

$HeOrShe露出客服行业特有的完美空洞笑容，之后切断了通讯链接。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
The comms open with a soft chime.

"Independent $shipOrFleet," the merc says in a perfunctory monotone, "I have been contracted to destroy any ship or fleet which interferes with the debris field you just salvaged. This communication is not a negotiation, but rather-"

The merc pauses, lifting a finger to $hisOrHer ear as if being told something on a private channel.

"You are $playerName," $heOrShe says, looking at you anew. "Commissioned auxiliary of the Hegemony."
texts.zh:
随着一声轻柔的提示音，通讯链接开启了。

"独立$shipOrFleet。" 佣兵单调地背着例行公事的词，"我方已签约摧毁任何舰船或是舰队。" $heOrShe礼貌地顿了顿，就是为了让你理解你就是这样的舰船或舰队。"只要有舰船或舰队与你方刚刚打捞的残骸区有过交集，即刻摧毁。该通讯并非协商，仅为 ——。"

佣兵突然停下了，伸出一根手指按在耳边，似乎有人在私人频道上向$hisOrHer讲了些什么。

"原来你是 $playerName。" $heOrShe继续说着，这下子换了副面孔，"你是受雇于 霸主 的辅助军。"

options.en: I am.
options.zh: 我确实是。

options.en: May I assume that this fact changes your disposition?
options.zh: 我是否可以认为，你之所以对我变了态度，就是因为我是辅助军？

texts.en:
"My apologies, captain. I have specific orders not to interfere with your activities, and," $heOrShe double-checks a datapad, "It seems I am to, um, render assistance insofar as it does not compromise my mission."

"You've put me in an awkward spot," the merc rubs $hisOrHer brow.  "But I suppose I must simply let you go. Bright burns?"
texts.zh:
"抱歉，舰长，我收到具体命令，不得干扰你方行动，而且..." $heOrShe看了眼数据平板，仔细确认了一下："看来我要，嗯，提供援助，只要不影响我的任务。"

"你这让我很难办了。" 佣兵揉了揉$hisOrHer的额头，"但我觉得我只能放你走了。祝航行无阻？"

texts.en:
"My apologies, captain. I have specific orders not to interfere with your activities, and," $heOrShe double-checks a datapad, "It seems I am to, um, render assistance insofar as it does not compromise my mission."

"Ah, there was one more thing," the merc rubs $hisOrHer brow. "Oh yes. You should visit the Ragnar Complex, in the Valhalla system. Great opportunities for someone like... you." $HeOrShe pauses, eyes fixed and unblinking to ensure that you got the message.

That accomplished, $heOrShe transitions to a thin smile, as if this business was concluded to everyone's satisfaction. "Bright burns," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh:
"抱歉，舰长，我收到具体命令，不得干扰你方行动，而且..." $heOrShe看了眼数据平板，仔细确认了一下："看来我要，嗯，提供援助，只要不影响我的任务。"

"啊，还有一件事。" 佣兵揉了揉$hisOrHer的额头，"对了，你该去 Ragnar 综合设施看看，就在 Valhalla 星系。那里有些好机会，很适合...你这种人。" $HeOrShe停嘴，双眼一眨不眨的盯着你，想确定你听懂了$HeOrShe的意思。

确定了之后，$heOrShe轻轻地假笑了一下，仿佛这件事的结果大家都满意。"航行无阻。" $heOrShe说道。

options.en: Burn bright.
options.zh: 祝你航行无阻。

options.en: Explain your meaning- why Ragnar Complex?
options.zh: 再解释一下 —— 为什么要去 Ragnar 综合设施？

options.en: Burn bright.
options.zh: 祝你航行无阻。

texts.en: As you begin to speak, the link has already been terminated.
texts.zh: 你刚想张嘴说话，对方便终止了链接。

texts.en: "You may," $heOrShe admits, almost embarrassed.
texts.zh: "的确可以。" $heOrShe面露难色，勉强承认道。

texts.en:
He wastes no time with greetings or posturing.

"I would not be so naive to ask you to delete your copy of this data," Macario says with inhuman calm. "I'm sure your people are quite capable of creating a thorough charade of compliance."
texts.zh:
他没有在问候和故作姿态上浪费一刻时间。

"我不会天真到让你删除这份信息的备份。" Macario 以超乎常人的冷静说到，"我相信你这类人即使糊弄我也会做到天衣无缝。"

options.en: What happened to Perseus?
options.zh: Perseus 怎么样了？

options.en: Who are these seven Andradas?
options.zh: 这七个 Andrada 都是谁？

options.en: Are these the heirs of Andrada? Only six left.
options.zh: 这些是 Andrada 的后裔吗？只剩六个了。

options.en: I appreciate you not wasting my time. So was Perseus your doing?
options.zh: 我感谢你不浪费我的时间。所以 Perseus 是你干的？

options.en: My silence is very much for sale.
options.zh: 我封口费可是很贵的。

texts.en: Macario stares unblinking. "Have I so underestimated you?"
texts.zh: Macario 眼睛一眨不眨地盯着你。"我还真是低估你了。"

texts.en:
"There will come a time soon when decisions must be made, dear captain," he takes a moment to tap at a datapad.

"I trust you have gained some appreciation for my... generous leadership style."
texts.zh:
"决断的一刻总会来临的，我亲爱的舰长。" 他按了下数据平板。

"我相信你应该能喜欢我...慷慨的领导方式。"

texts.en:
"There will come a time soon when decisions must be made, dear captain," he takes a moment to tap at a datapad.

"I trust you have gained some appreciation for my... generous leadership style."
texts.zh:
"很快就要到必须做决断的时候了，亲爱的舰长，" 他腾出片刻，在数据板上点了几下。

"想必你已经领教了我这... 宽厚的处事风范。"

options.en: What are you loyal to, Macario?
options.zh: 你到底效忠谁，Macario？

options.en: You mentioned 'advanced spacecraft hull' in a previous conversation...
options.zh: 上次谈话时你提到了一个 '实验舰体' ...

options.en: I serve the Sindrian Diktat. Glory to the Supreme Executor!
options.zh: 我为辛达强权效劳。荣耀归于最高元首！

options.en: What are you loyal to, Macario?
options.zh: 你到底效忠于什么，Macario？

options.en: You mentioned 'advanced spacecraft hull' in a previous conversation...
options.zh: 你上回聊天时提到过'advanced spacecraft hull'...

texts.en:
"Power, of course. I'm just like you."

 He slowly rubs his hands together, watching.

"Don't bother denying it."
texts.zh:
"权力，还用说吗。你我都是一路人。"

他慢慢地两手交叉，观察着。

"不用浪费时间去否定这一点了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
His eyes open wide, "Don't you see it, captain? I have no need to emblazon my face upon history. Merely... " he grows quiet, "Mm, to direct it. Correct it. Trim the loose ends which hold us back, tie us down."

"That is all captain," he says, re-asserting a mask of calm. "For now. I'm sure we shall speak again soon."

The comms cut to the crest of the Sindrian Diktat internal security ministry.
texts.zh:
他双眼睁大。"你还看不出来吗，舰长？我不需要在历史上刻下我这张脸！只要..." 他声音低了下来。"嗯，引导历史，修正历史。除掉拖累，限制我们的累赘。"

"目前就这样吧，舰长。" 他重新带上了冷静的面具。"我相信我们很快会再联络的。"

通讯画面转换为了 辛达强权 内部安全部的徽标。

options.en: Close the comm-link
options.zh: 关闭通讯链接

texts.en:
"Did I?" He chuckles. "Mercenary to the end eh? I'll have arrangements made."

"I am so pleased that you value what I can provide. This will be important, and soon."
texts.zh:
"我说过吗？\" 他轻笑一声。\"到头来还是个雇佣兵，嗯？我会安排好的。"

"你这么看重我拿得出手的东西，我真是欣慰。这事很快就要派上大用场了。"

texts.en:
"Did I?" He chuckles. "Mercenary to the end eh? I'll have arrangements made."

"I am so pleased that you value what I can provide. This will be important, and soon."
texts.zh:
"我提过？" 他笑道，"到最后都是个雇佣兵吗？我会做对应的安排。"

"我很高兴你能珍视我所能提供的利益。这点会很重要，很快就会。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Yes, glory to all of that. Of course," he says quickly.

"You are simply... the perfect specimen to serve the Supreme Executor."

A mix of expressions crosses his face as he continues to examine you, like something he found but did not expect. Then, like a phase-shift, he is suddenly calm.
texts.zh:
"是、是啊，荣耀归于那一切，自然，" 他说得很快。

"你简直... 是服侍最高元首的完美样本。"

他仍旧打量着你，脸上神色变换不定，像是捡到了件没料到的东西。紧接着，像切换了相位一般，他忽然平静下来。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Andrada, of course." Macario simply raises an eyebrow, "I thought that was obvious."
texts.zh: "当然是 Andrada。" Macario 挑了下眉毛，"我以为这很明显。"

texts.en: "On so few the future hangs, captain," Macario says hollowly, unblinking.
texts.zh: "可叹未来竟要寄托在寥寥数人身上，舰长。" Macario 空洞地说道，眼睛依旧一眨不眨。

texts.en: "You wound me with the accusation, captain," Macario says with a hint of cold amusement.
texts.zh: "你这指控可真是让我伤心，舰长。" Macario 话语中带着一丝冷酷的愉悦。

texts.en: "Naturally," Macario says, taking a moment to tap at a datapad.
texts.zh: "自然。" Macario 按了下数据平板。

texts.en:
Dolos Macario, the Spider of Sindria, appears before you. He looks bored.

"Captain, o captain," he greets you, his tone bored. "Not yet." He winks and hits the shut-off.

The crest of the Sindrian Diktat internal security ministry slowly turns.
texts.zh:
Dolos Macario，辛达瑞亚之蛛，出现在你面前。他看起来很无聊。

"舰长啊，舰长。" 他和你打了个招呼，语调透露着无聊，"还不到时候。" 他眨了眨眼，然后按下了切断键。

辛达强权 内部安全部的徽标慢慢地旋转着。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
The image of Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears. He is not even looking at the comms-feed.

"Independent fleet: maintain distance and you will not be fired upon. Hear and obey," Caden declares, taking a breath.

"Final victory to the Supreme Executor!" he shouts.
texts.zh:
卫队最高副首长 Caden 的形象出现了。他甚至脸都没有朝着通讯器。

"独立舰队，保持距离以防被我方攻击。倾听并服从！" Caden 宣告道，一边深吸了一口气。

"胜利终归最高元首！"他怒吼道。

texts.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat, captain!" he booms enthusiastically. "It stirs the heart to see another proud follower of the Supreme Executor's vision upholding the Great Cause."

He blinks, perhaps realizing that he doesn't actually have anything to say to you. "Stay strong and stay vigilant just as Supreme Executor Andrada taught us. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh:
卫队最高副首长 Caden 出现在你面前。

"荣耀归于辛达强权，舰长！" 他热情洪亮地喊道，"又见到一位拥护最高元首伟大愿景、共举伟业的忠实追随者，真叫人心里发热。"

他眨了眨眼，大概是发觉自己其实没话跟你说。"保持坚强，保持警惕，正如最高元首 Andrada 教导我们的那样。荣耀归于辛达强权！"

texts.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Ah, Captain $playerName. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" he booms enthusiastically. "It stirs the heart to see a loyal follower of the Supreme Executor's vision, and," he leans in, "One who will stand with me when the time comes, when strength and loyalty will be required to secure the future of the Persean Sector."

He leans back, satisfied. "Stay strong and vigilant - as Supreme Executor Andrada taught us. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh:
卫队最高副首长 Caden 出现在你面前的画面里。"啊，$playerName 舰长。荣耀归于 辛达强权！" 他热情地夸赞道："能看到另一位最高元首愿景的忠实追随者，真的令人感到振奋。而且..." 他凑近了些，"当需要力量和忠诚来护卫英仙座星域的未来之时，他将与我并肩作战。"

他向后靠了靠，表示满意。"保持坚强和谨慎 —— 正如最高元首 Andrada 教导我们的那样。荣耀归于 辛达强权！"

不等你的回答，通讯链接就被切断了。

texts.en:
"Independent fleet," she says, not acknowledging your previous contact, "Hear me: stay clear of our operational volume and you will not be fired upon."

"Hyder out."

She motions for an underling to cut the comms.
texts.zh:
"独立舰队，\" 她开口道，对此前的照面只字不提，\"听好了：与我们的行动区域保持距离，就不会遭到攻击。"

"Hyder 通话完毕。"

她抬手示意手下切断通讯。

texts.en:
"Captain," she says, unexpressive but with a carefully respectful tone. "Please stay clear of our operational volume."

And pause. "We have nothing further to discuss at this time.

She motions for an underling to cut the comms.

"Hyder out."
texts.zh:
"舰长，" 她面无表情，语气却刻意恭敬，"请与我们的行动区域保持距离。"

顿了一拍。"眼下我们没什么好谈的了。"

她抬手示意手下切断通讯。

"Hyder 通话完毕。"

texts.en:
"Commission-bearing fleet," she says, not acknowledging your previous contact, "Hear me: your are directed to stay clear of our operational volume as we perform official maneuvers."

"Hyder out."

She motions for an underling to cut the comms.
texts.zh:
"持委任状的舰队，\" 她开口道，对此前的照面只字不提，\"听好了：我方正在执行正式演习，请与我们的行动区域保持距离。"

"Hyder 通话完毕。"

她抬手示意手下切断通讯。

options.en: A merc on the Askonia fringe told me to visit Ragnar. I assume that means you.
options.zh: 在 Askonia 星系边缘的一名佣兵叫我去趟 Ragnar。我猜测那人的意思是让我来见你。

texts.en:
"Is that so," he says, nonchalant.

"I wonder why they would have said that."
texts.zh: "是吗，" 他漫不经心地说道，"我倒好奇那个人为何要这么说。"

options.en: I think they were working for you. And under orders not to say so.
options.zh: 我认为那个人曾为你效力。且被命令不准向他人透露。

texts.en:
He raises an eyebrow, his affect casual.

"If I had hired this mercenary, I imagine I'd be pretty upset at how easily they gave up the identity of their employer. It's a good thing the Hegemony has an official policy forbidding the employ of mercs."
texts.zh:
他扬起一侧眉毛，神情依然随意。

"如果是我雇佣了这个佣兵，想必会就对方如此轻易就供出了雇主的身份而感到十分恼火。幸好 霸主 有禁止雇佣佣兵的官方政策。"

options.en: What? The Hegemony regularly employs mercenaries.
options.zh: 什么？霸主 明明经常雇佣佣兵。

options.en: If it's a fight against the Diktat, I want to be a part of it.
options.zh: 如果是针对 辛达强权 的战斗，我想参与。

options.en: Looks like someone is losing their bonus. Anyway, I want in.
options.zh: 看来有人要拿不到奖金了。总之，我要加入。

options.en: Clearly you don't take this very seriously.
options.zh: 显然你并没有把这件事看得很重。

texts.en:
"Really?" Admiral Rao, leaning forward, puts on a look of concern.

He speaks officiously. "As a patriotic citizen, I'm sure you'll have reported all such lapses of policy so that official action may be taken."

The pose holds for a moment, then half a smile cracks through.
texts.zh:
"真的？" Rao 上将身体前倾，摆出关切的神色。

他用公事公办的语气说道："作为一位爱国公民，想必你已经上报了所有此类违规政策的行为，以便官方采取行动。"

他维持了这个姿态片刻，随即露出一丝笑意。

texts.en:
"Hmm." Rao looks you over. Is that twinkle in his eye - there are no other words for it - amusement?

"Why?"

He leaves the silence for you to fill.
texts.zh:
"嗯。" Rao 打量着你，他眼中闪烁的是玩味吗？

"为什么？"

他留出沉默，等待你进行填补。

options.en: Because you'll pay me well, and on time. You were a freelancer, you know the life.
options.zh: 因为你报酬优渥，且会按时支付。你也当过自由佣兵，知道这行的生存法则。

options.en: They're mutineers. They undermine the restoration of the Domain, the Hegemony's purpose.
options.zh: 他们是叛乱分子。他们破坏了 人之领 的重建，而那是 霸主 的核心使命。

options.en: They're brutal oppressors, enemies of freedom and life. It's a just cause.
options.zh: 他们是残暴的压迫者，是自由与生命的敌人。这是一项正义的事业。

options.en: They're systematically killing the Faithful, they closed the Shrine of Volturn. My duty is to resist.
options.zh: 他们正系统性地屠杀信众，并关闭了 Volturn 圣地。抵抗他们正是我职责所在。

options.en: Because they're falling apart. They're going to lose and I like being on the winning side.
options.zh: 因为他们正在分崩离析。他们必败无疑，而我喜欢站在胜利的一方。

texts.en: He nods, eyes closed. "I will, I was, and I do." His eyes open, and he says "That's not all, though."
texts.zh: 他闭目点头。"我将会如此，我一直如此，而我也正在如此。" 他睁开眼说道，"但也不止于此。"

texts.en:
"You have promise, captain, that's true. But," he takes on an avuncular tone, "I don't think you've got enough experience to handle what I've got in mind."

"Put yourself out there, take on some jobs. We may speak again on this later."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
texts.zh:
"你确实很有潜力，舰长。但是，" 他的语气转为长辈式的教诲，"我认为你尚且缺乏足够经验，不足以处理我所构思的事情。"

"去历练吧，承接些任务。我们或许可以日后再议此事。"

他的语气明确表示话题已经结束。暂且如此。

texts.en: "You've got promise, captain." He pauses. "And I believe you have the experience to handle what I've got in mind."
texts.zh: "你很有潜力，舰长。" 他停顿片刻，"而且我相信，以你的经验足以胜任我心中的计划。"

texts.en:
"You've got promise, captain. You know how to slip out of a trap. You know how to use any means available to win."

He pauses. "It speaks well for what I have in mind.""
texts.zh:
"你很有潜力，舰长。你懂得如何挣脱陷阱，懂得如何不择手段地取得胜利。"

他停顿片刻，"这正契合我心中的构想。"

texts.en:
"You have promise, captain. Especially if your captaining is anything like your swordplay. You spilled blood for honor in personal combat. That is more than most can say."

He pauses. "It speaks well for you, for what I have in mind."
texts.zh:
"你很有潜力，舰长，尤其是你那与自身剑术造诣相当益彰的指挥才能。你曾为荣誉在个人决斗中血溅三尺，这已胜过多数人所能言。"

他停顿片刻，"这为你增光添彩，也契合我心中的构想。"

texts.en:
"You have promise, captain. You were brave enough to take up the sword with full knowledge of the art, fight... and lose. Your blood was spilled for honor in personal combat. That is more than most can say."

He pauses. "It speaks well for you, for what I have in mind."
texts.zh:
"你很有潜力，舰长。你足够勇敢，在通晓剑艺的情况下执剑应战...并败北。你曾为荣誉在个人决斗中血溅三尺，这已胜过多数人所能言。"

他停顿片刻，"这为你增光添彩，也契合我心中的构想。"

texts.en:
"You've found lucrative employment of a sort with the Tri-Tachyon corporation, however."

He leans back. "We could discuss this matter again if that situation were to change."
texts.zh:
"然而，你已经在 速子科技 找到某种利润丰厚的差事了。"

他向后靠去，"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

texts.en:
"Huh." He chews on his lip.

"Why not ask your boss, Dolos Macario, for a job? I'm sure he's got some dissidents to space."
texts.zh:
"呵。" 他咬着嘴唇说道。

"为什么不向你老板 Dolos Macario 讨个差事？我很确信他总有些异见分子需要处理。"

texts.en: "You're already signed up with the Hegemony. Good. That saves me a lot of bureaucratic nonsense."
texts.zh: "你已经登记加入 霸主 了，很好，这省去我不少官僚程序的麻烦。"

texts.en:
"As you bear the commission of the Persean League..." He makes a half-shrug. "I can't have you in a position of divided loyalty."

"Let us speak again on the matter if your situation changes."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
texts.zh:
"既然你已经持有 英仙座联盟 的雇佣协议了..." 他半耸着肩膀，"我不能让你处于忠诚分裂的立场。"

"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

他的语气明确表示话题已经结束。暂且如此。

texts.en:
"Seeing as you're a full, albeit junior, member of the Persean League we can't have you in a position of divided loyalty, can we."

He produces a little shrug. "Let us speak again on the matter if your situation changes."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
texts.zh:
"鉴于你已经是 英仙座联盟 的正式成员 —— 尽管资历尚浅，因此我们无法让你处于忠诚分裂的立场。"

"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

他的语气明确表示话题已经结束。暂且如此。

texts.en:
"Seeing as you're a full, albeit junior, member of the Persean League... well, we can't very well divide your loyalties."

"Besides," a fleeting smile appears. "I see you've fallen into Reynard Hannan's orbit. An ego of that size produces a gravity well which is very difficult to escape."
texts.zh:
"鉴于你已经是 英仙座联盟 的正式成员 —— 尽管资历尚浅...但我们很难要求你分割忠诚。"

"况且，" 他的脸上浮现出一抹转瞬即逝的微笑，"我看你已经坠入 Reynard Hannan 的引力范围了。如此庞大的自我意识所产生的重力井，想必是极难挣脱的。"

texts.en:
"Seeing as you're a full, albeit junior, member of the Persean League... we can't have you in a position of divided loyalty, can we."

He produces a little shrug.

"But perhaps," he looks aside. "We might have a mutual friend on Kazeron?"
texts.zh:
"鉴于你已经是 英仙座联盟 的正式成员 —— 尽管资历尚浅，因此我们无法让你处于忠诚分裂的立场。"

他微微耸肩。

"不过或许，" 他侧目看去，"我们在 Kazeron 有共同的朋友？"

texts.en:
"Although the Hegemony is no stranger to making common cause with the Church of Galactic Redemption..."

He makes a half-shrug.

"You've chosen your path. I couldn't possibly distract you from your god-bothering."
texts.zh:
"虽然 霸主 与 银河救赎教会 的合作也不是什么新鲜事了..."

他半耸着肩膀。

"但你已经选择了自己的道路，我哪敢打扰你那些烦人的信仰事务。"

texts.en:
"The Hegemony is no stranger to making common cause with the Church of Galactic Redemption..." He makes a half-shrug.

"I suppose," he says slowly, "If you can put up with me, I can deal with your god-bothering."
texts.zh:
"霸主 与 银河救赎教会 的合作也不是什么新鲜事了..." 他半耸着肩膀。

"我想，" 他缓缓说道，"如果你能忍受我，那么我也可以接受你那些烦人的信仰议题。"

texts.en:
"The Hegemony is no stranger to making common cause with the Church of Galactic Redemption..." He makes a half-shrug, then pauses to look right at you.

"It's the guns you've given Standfast," his words are precise, "that convince me of your dedication."

He looks away, casual again. "If you can put up with me, I can deal with your god-bothering."
texts.zh:
"霸主 与 银河救赎教会 的合作也不是什么新鲜事了..." 他半耸肩膀。

"是你提供给 Standfast 的那些军火，" 他字句精准，"让我确信了你的诚意。"

他移开视线，恢复了随意的姿态，"如果你能忍受我，那么我也可以接受你那些烦人的信仰议题。"

options.en: And what do you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: And what do you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: And what do you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: And what do you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: My membership in the Persean League is my business.
options.zh: 加入 英仙座联盟 是我的个人事务。

options.en: Reynard is insufferable, but I could not get a better deal.
options.zh: Reynard 令人难以忍受，但我找不到更优的选择了。

options.en: Reynard is a great man. I follow him gladly.
options.zh: Reynard 是个伟大的人，我十分乐意追随他。

options.en: I'm sure I couldn't say.
options.zh: 我恐怕无可奉告。

options.en: Horus Yaribay, you mean. And his desire for unification with the Hegemony.
options.zh: 你是指 Horus Yaribay，以及他渴望与 霸主 合并的意愿。

options.en: I'm not sure I want to get involved in such a scheme just now.
options.zh: 我目前不确定是否要卷入这样的计划。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: What'd you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now.
options.zh: 感谢你的提议，但眼下或许不便。

options.en: You disrespect the Faith with such comments.
options.zh: 你这样的言论是对信仰的亵渎。

options.en: What'd you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now.
options.zh: 感谢你的提议，但眼下或许不便。

options.en: You disrespect the Faith with such comments.
options.zh: 你这样的言论是对信仰的亵渎。

texts.en:
"I'd like to offer you work. You don't have to salute me, and I'll make sure you're paid promptly."

He leans forward, his hands together. "What do you think? Could be fun. Play your cards right, and you'll be a legend."
texts.zh:
"我想给你提供工作。你不必向我敬礼，而我也会确保报酬能够及时支付。"

他倾身向前，双手交握，"你意下如何？这或许会很有趣。如果你打得一手好牌的话，就将会成为传奇。"

options.en: What sort of work do you need done?
options.zh: 你需要完成什么样的工作？

options.en: You show little respect for your fellow officers of the Hegemony.
options.zh: 你对 霸主 的同僚军官显得缺乏敬意。

options.en: What are these 'unique circumstances'? What is your goal?
options.zh: 这些 '特殊情况' 具体指什么？你的目标是什么？

options.en: Is this about taking down the Sindrian Diktat?
options.zh: 这是为了推翻 辛达强权 吗？

options.en: Why is it personal with Andrada?
options.zh: 你为什么和 Andrada 有私人恩怨？

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: I'm not so sure about this.
options.zh: 我不太确定。

texts.en:
"A proper officer of the Hegemony is taught to leap toward the enemy, blazing guns. Once the noise quiets down, they'll wait, slack-jawed, for the medals to be pinned to their uniforms."

"Such is the way of the Domain, which we must uphold."

He half-raises a finger, a quirk on his lips. "Officially," he concludes.
texts.zh:
"正统的 霸主 军官被教导要随着枪口的火光冲向敌阵。待硝烟散去，他们便张着嘴等待勋章别上军装。"

"此乃 人之领 之道，我等必须恪守。"

他微抬手指，嘴角轻扬，"官方说法如此，" 他总结道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Baikal was kind enough to find me a place where I could get important work done. I deal with... let us call them 'unique circumstances'. And for this I find it necessary to associate with energetic freelancers."

"I'll ensure you're paid promptly for a roster of small merc jobs."

"Then, perhaps something big will come up. When it does, I want to know I can count on you."
texts.zh:
"Baikal 好意为我寻得一处能处理重要事务的地方。我要处理的是...不妨让我们称之为 '特殊情况'。为此，我需要有活力的自由职业者。"

"我会确保你接手的小型雇佣任务都能及时获得报酬。"

"届时，或许会有重大机遇降临。当那一刻来临时，我希望能与你建立信任。"

texts.en:
"The truth makes few friends." Rao produces a wry smile.

"I never could stand a fool, especially when that fool is an honorable member of the Strategic Assembly. So," he holds his hand out to indicate his surroundings, Ragnar Complex.

"It's not so bad."
texts.zh:
"真相鲜少赢得朋友。" Rao 露出讥诮的微笑。

"我向来无法容忍蠢材，尤其当他们是战略指挥部的成员时。所以，" 他伸手示意周围的环境 —— Ragnar 综合设施。

"这里还不算太糟。"

texts.en:
"I'm offering you the chance to be the grit that throws history off its axis."

He lets his sly smile fade. "There are many bodies of power turning just now. Grinding away, warships and bombings and riots and resources."

"The Persean Sector needs change, or it will grind what's left of us to dust."
texts.zh:
"我正在给予你成为历史转折点的机会。"

他慢慢收起他那狡黠的微笑，"此刻正有许多权力机构正在运转。缓慢地碾磨着 —— 战舰、轰炸、暴动、资源。"

"英仙座星域需要变革，否则它将把我们仅存的一切碾作尘埃。"

texts.en:
A cold, quick expression passes over his face.

"Let us say that I'd be as satisfied as any Hegemony officer to cut down that pompous traitor. Setting aside even the matter of honor, I have a personal dislike of the man."
texts.zh:
一抹冰冷而迅疾的神色掠过他的脸庞。

"可以说，与任何 霸主 军官一样，能除掉那个自负的叛徒会令我深感快意。即便撇开荣誉问题不谈，我个人也极度厌恶此人。"

texts.en:
Rao lets out a slow breath. "That's talk for old comrades, over drink."

He leans back, not quite committing to a frown.

"Patience, captain."
texts.zh:
Rao 缓缓呼出一口气，"那是老战友间把酒言欢时的谈资。"

他向后靠去，眉间并未完全皱起。

"耐心些，舰长。"

texts.en: "Good," his approval comes with his sly smile. "Have your people set up secure comms. We'll show the Strategic Assembly how it's done."
texts.zh: "很好，" 他的赞许伴随着狡黠的笑容，"让你的人建立安全通讯，我们将向战略指挥部展示该如何行事。"

texts.en:
"Let us speak again on the matter if your situation changes."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
texts.zh:
"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

他的语气明确表示谈话到此为止。

texts.en:
"Of course."

He sits back, face falling into shadow.
texts.zh:
"当然。"

他向后靠去，面容隐入阴影之中。

texts.en:
"Nothing more need be said."

His tone makes it clear that the conversation is over.
texts.zh:
"无需多言了。"

他的语气明确表示谈话到此为止。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: "But you made the deal," Rao says impishly. "You didn't have to."
texts.zh: "但交易是你自己达成的，"Rao 狡黠地说道，"你本可拒绝。"

options.en: I don't need to explain myself to you.
options.zh: 我没必要向你解释。

options.en: I have a plan to get out of it. You'll see.
options.zh: 我有脱身的计划，你很快就会看到的。

options.en: Is the Hegemony offering its protection against the League?
options.zh: 霸主 这是要提供针对联盟的庇护吗？

texts.en:
"Then nothing more need be said."

His tone makes it clear that the conversation is over.
texts.zh:
"那便无需多言了。"

他的语气明确表示谈话到此为止。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
Rao holds a finger to his cheek for a moment, thinking.

"It could be earned," he says. "But that's up to you."
texts.zh:
Rao 将手指轻抵脸颊片刻，一边陷入了沉思。

"或许可以争取，" 他说道，"但这取决于你。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"What admirable loyalty! How Reynard earns it, I've never understood. I must study his leadership closely, for I obviously have much to learn." The sarcasm runs thick.

Rao sits back, face falling into shadow.
texts.zh:
"多么可敬的忠诚！我始终不明白 Reynard 是如何赢得这份忠诚的。我必须仔细研究他的领导艺术，显然我还有很多需要学习。" 话语中夹杂着明显的讽刺意味。

Rao 向后靠去，面容隐入阴影之中。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "I understand. Keeping with his trust is more important than serving that goal." He leans back, "It's interesting."
texts.zh: "我理解。维护他的信任可比服务那个目标更重要。" 他向后靠去，"这很有趣。"

options.en: Speculate if you like, I have nothing to say.
options.zh: 你尽管猜测，而我就无可奉告了。

options.en: Hypothetically, I would require the consent of the third party before discussing anything.
options.zh: 在假设的情况下，我在讨论任何事情之前都需要获得第三方的同意。

options.en: I'm not sure I want to get involved in such a scheme just now.
options.zh: 我目前还不确定是否要卷入这样的计划。

texts.en: Rao raises an eyebrow, his expression amused.
texts.zh: Rao 扬起一侧眉毛，神色玩味。

texts.en:
He smiles coyly, leaving your statement deliberately unanswered.

"It is possible our work together would serve certain common goals."
texts.zh:
他狡黠地微笑着，刻意不回应你的陈述。

"我们的合作或许能服务于某些共同的目标。"

options.en: What'd you have in mind?
options.zh: 你打算怎么做？

options.en: Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now.
options.zh: 感谢你的提议，但眼下或许不便。

texts.en:
"Ludd, I think, doesn't need self-appointed curates to shield the Faith from my little comments," he says, his eyes suddenly sharp. "Pray on the matter. I insist."

He leans back, and his face falls into shadow.
texts.zh:
"我认为卢德并不需要自封的祭司来替信仰挡下我的几句闲言碎语，" 他说道，眼神也突然锐利起来，"为此祈祷吧，我坚持如此。"

他向后靠去，面容隐入阴影之中。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Who is Dolos?
options.zh: Dolos 是谁？

options.en: Look, I just take Diktat money. I'm a merc. Like you were.
options.zh: 听着，我只是拿辛达强权的钱办事而已。我是个佣兵，就和你当年一样。

options.en: I take it that's a 'no', then.
options.zh: 那么，我就认为这是 '拒绝' 的意思了。

options.en: I just take Diktat money. I'm a mercenary. Like you were.
options.zh: 听着，我只是拿辛达强权的钱办事而已。我是个佣兵，就和你当年一样。

options.en: You're a worm compared to the genius of Dolos Macario!
options.zh: 和 Dolos Macario 的才智相比，你不过是条蛆虫！

options.en: I take it that's a 'no'.
options.zh: 我就认为这是 '拒绝' 的意思了。

texts.en:
"He calls himself the 'The Spider of Sindria', but that's not right," Rao says. "He's a self-satisfied little worm that's chewed his way into the rotten heart of the Sindrian Diktat. You should meet him."

Rao's smile is cold.

"Go. Meet him. Go on, now." He makes a shoo motion, then slaps the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"虽然他自称 '辛达瑞亚之蛛'，但其实这并不恰当，" Rao说道，"他不过就是条自鸣得意的蛆虫，啃噬着 辛达强权 那腐烂的心脏，你该去见见他。"

Rao 的笑容十分冰冷。

"去啊，去见他，现在就去。" 他做了个驱赶的手势，随即切断了通讯。

texts.en:
"You're not like me," he says. "I was a mercenary, yes. But that was not all I was. And it is not all I am."

"I am a Rao," his voice is full and strong. "I am an officer of the Hegemony Navy despite the best efforts of a few among us who love rules and uniforms more than they love the service and the cause."

He sits back down, a piercing and newly earnest look fixed on you.
texts.zh:
"你可和我不一样，" 他说道，"我确实曾是佣兵。但那并非是我的全部过去，也并非是我的全部现在。"

"我是 Rao 家族的一员，" 他的声音饱满有力，"尽管某些将规章与制服盖过效忠与事业的同僚百般阻挠，我仍是 霸主 海军的军官。"

他重新落座，用锐利而真挚的目光锁定着你。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You are what you do, not the lies you tell yourself."

He reaches for an interface, pauses, then speaks.

"Now go away."
texts.zh:
"你的所作所为造就了你，而非自我欺骗的谎言。"

他伸手触向操作界面，在停顿片刻后，方才开口道。

"现在离开吧。"

texts.en:
"Correct," he says icily.

He makes a shoo motion. "Off with you."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"没错，" 他冷冰冰地说道。

他做了个驱赶的手势，"滚吧。"

通讯随即被切断了。

texts.en:
"Hah," Orcus Rao says, rolling his eyes. "We got another one."

He makes a shoo motion. "Off with you."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"哈，" Orcus Rao 翻了个白眼，"又来了个这样的。"

他做了个驱赶的手势，"滚吧。"

通讯随即被切断了。

texts.en: He stares at you, a puzzled look on his face. "You're a believer, then. Huh." Rao rubs his chin.
texts.zh: 他凝视着你，面露困惑。"这么说你是个忠诚派。嗯。" Rao 摩挲着下巴。

texts.en: He nods, watching you. "Got the fire, I see. Good."
texts.zh: 他点点头，一边注视着你。"有血性，我看得出来。很好。"

texts.en: "Huh. Met Standfast, did you? I like her."
texts.zh: "呵。见过 Standfast 了吧？我欣赏她。"

texts.en:
"Huh," he looks aside. "Met Standfast, did you? I like her."

Rao makes a sly smile. "It's you who's been giving her some big guns, hasn't it."
texts.zh:
"呵，"他侧目望去，"见过 Standfast 了吧？我欣赏她。"

Rao 露出狡黠的笑容。"给她那些大家伙的人是你，对吧。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Is your loyalty so contingent? I suppose that is true for many, perhaps most- and almost all are loathe to admit it. How brave, then, to admit it." His tone is rhetorical, and rather more sardonic than earnest.

Rao looks to you again. "Nonetheless, I agree with your assessment of the enemy."
texts.zh:
"原来你的忠诚这么动摇吗？我想许多人 —— 或许大多数人 —— 都是如此，只是几乎无人愿承认。那么，敢于承认倒是勇气可嘉。" 他的语气带着反问的色彩，更多是讥讽而非诚恳。

Rao 再次看向你，"不过，我赞同你对敌人的评价。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: He shrugs, holding his ironic half-smile in place. Behind it his eyes are cold, very cold.
texts.zh: 他耸耸肩，保持着那抹讽刺的似笑非笑，而那笑容后是他冰冷的眼神，极为冰冷。

options.en: If it's a fight against the Diktat, I want to be a part of it.
options.zh: 如果是针对 辛达强权 的战斗，我想参与。

options.en: Looks like someone is losing their bonus. Anyway, I want in.
options.zh: 看来有人要拿不到奖金了。总之，我要加入。

options.en: Right. I don't have time for this.
options.zh: 行吧，我没时间。

texts.en:
"Then I bid you a good day, captain."

Rao flicks the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"那么祝你今日愉快，舰长。"

Rao 轻点切断了通讯。

options.en: Could Siyavong decrypt Macario's files?
options.zh: Siyavong 能破解 Macario 的文件吗？

texts.en: Perhaps he could. But the real question is if he would. And given that Tri-Tachyon is in constant and fierce competition with itself... perhaps.
texts.zh: 也许他能。但真正的问题是，他愿不愿意。考虑到速子科技向来斗得你死我活... 也许吧。

texts.en:
Your mind wanders from the open comms channel, to what you did - and what you found - brewing, rotting, in the Askonia System.

You think of Philip Andrada, the Lion of Sindria. The proud conqueror - the fading villain of the Hegemony's pride, and soon, perhaps, a wasting corpse.

You think to yourself...
texts.zh:
你的思绪从仍然开着的通讯频道飘开，飘向你在 Askonia 星系做过的事、找到的东西——那些正在发酵、正在腐烂的东西。

你想起了 Philip Andrada，辛达瑞亚之狮。那个骄傲的征服者——霸主自尊心里那个正在褪色的恶人，也许很快就是一具枯朽的尸体。

你暗自思忖...

options.en: Who, or what, are the seven Andradas on Macario's list?
options.zh: Macario 名单上那七个 Andrada，究竟是谁，又或者是什么？

options.en: Are the seven Andradas on Macario's list truly Philip's heirs?
options.zh: Macario 名单上那七个 Andrada，真是 Philip 的继承人吗？

options.en: Are the seven Andradas on Macario's list... Andrada?
options.zh: Macario 名单上那七个 Andrada... 都是 Andrada 本人吗？

options.en: What game is Macario playing by revealing the list to me?
options.zh: Macario 把这份名单透露给我，究竟在下什么棋？

options.en: Andrada's dictatorship could be felled with one push... in the right place
options.zh: Andrada 的独裁政权一推就倒... 只要推对地方

options.en: Philip Andrada's grand experiment might be felled with one push... in the wrong place
options.zh: Philip Andrada 的宏大实验或许一推就倒... 只要推错地方

options.en: The Sindrian Diktat must be protected from Macario's scheming
options.zh: 必须护住辛达强权，不让 Macario 的阴谋得逞

options.en: I don't have time for this right now
options.zh: 我现在没时间处理这个

texts.en:
Seven names, seven Andradas. One file's updates halted.

Deceased perhaps? Escaped from Macario's machinations, anyway. And Andrada's, perhaps.

There are too many unknowns. Too many "perhaps". You need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next manipulation.
texts.zh:
七个名字，七个 Andrada。其中一份档案的更新停在某处。

也许人已经死了？总之，是逃出了 Macario 的算计。或许，也逃出了 Andrada 的。

未知太多，"也许"也太多。你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一次操纵。

texts.en:
Seven names, seven Andradas. One file's updates halted.

Deceased, perhaps. Escaped from Macario's machinations, anyway. What was Supreme Executor Philip Andrada's plan for these files, these names?

There are too many unknowns. Too many "perhaps". You need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next move.
texts.zh:
七个名字，七个 Andrada。其中一份档案的更新停在某处。

也许人已经死了。总之，是逃出了 Macario 的算计。最高元首 Philip Andrada 对这些文件、这些名字，原本是打的什么算盘？

未知太多，"也许"也太多。你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一步。

options.en: I need to find out what's in the ANDRADA files
options.zh: 我得弄清楚 ANDRADA 档案里到底写了什么

texts.en: You can visualize the list without checking your TriPad. Seven names lead by the surname of the Lion of Sindria, the Supreme Executor.
texts.zh: 不用翻 TriPad，那份名单就在你眼前浮着。七个名字，打头的是辛达瑞亚之狮、最高元首的姓氏。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The best hackers or perhaps the least AI core - or a team made of the two working together - could crack the files, given time.

Any major faction's intelligence service must have this capacity.

Except the Luddic Church. (Nor the Path, for that matter... unless some truly heretical sect has invited a rogue AI to its flock. You set aside that disturbing thought.)
texts.zh:
最好的黑客，或者最次一等的 AI 核心，又或者两者搭伙组成的团队——只要给足时间，都能破开这些文件。

任何一个大势力的情报机构，都必然具备这种能力。

银河救赎教会除外。(卢德左径其实也一样... 除非真有哪个彻底离经叛道的教派，把一头失控的 AI 请进了自己的羊群。你把这个令人不安的念头搁到一边。)

options.en: Return to the practical question
options.zh: 回到那个实际问题

texts.en: You return to your initial thought: could Orcus Rao decrypt the files?
texts.zh: 你回到最初那个念头：Orcus Rao 能解密这些文件吗？

texts.en:
Who could you approach for assistance?
Who would crack the encryption for you?
texts.zh:
你能找谁帮忙？
谁会替你破开这层加密？

texts.en: It would take some kind of super-hacker. If only you knew one...
texts.zh: 这得是何等厉害的黑客才行。可惜你不认识这样的人...

texts.en: If you had your own colonial infrastructure with an alpha-level AI core at its head, it might be possible to keep the job entirely internal.
texts.zh: 如果你有自己的殖民地设施，再有一颗 Alpha 级 AI 核心坐镇，或许整件事都能在内部消化。

options.en: Gargoyle could do it
options.zh: Gargoyle 或许能做到

options.en: You could use the alpha-level core installed as administrator of $sd7s_aiColonyName
options.zh: 你可以动用那颗装在 $sd7s_aiColonyName、担任管理者的 Alpha 级核心

options.en: Surely someone in the Sindrian Diktat is loyal to Andrada?
options.zh: 辛达强权里总该有人忠于 Andrada 吧？

options.en: The Hegemony could, if it so chose
options.zh: 霸主若愿意下场，也能做到

options.en: If the Persean League could be persuaded of its utility...
options.zh: 若能说服英仙座联盟相信此事的用处...

options.en: Tri-Tachyon expertise could crack it... for a price
options.zh: 速子科技的技术能破开它... 只要出得起价

options.en: Perhaps you need more time to develop allies and contacts
options.zh: 也许你还需要更多时间去经营盟友与人脉

texts.en:
The hacker is mercurial, but Gargoyle's curiosity can be counted on - to say nothing of the opportunity to disgrace and annoy one or more powerful factions by revealing their secrets.

It is clear, then, that you must take the ANDRADA files to Gargoyle.
texts.zh:
这名黑客性情无常，但 Gargoyle 的好奇心绝对可靠——更别提揭开秘密能让一两个强大势力丢脸恼火。

那么路只有一条：你只能把 ANDRADA 文件带去给 Gargoyle。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Captain?" $PersonName looks almost concerned.

"Captain $playerLastName, is this signal good? I'm getting received-confirm but... can you hear me now?"
texts.zh:
"舰长？" $PersonName 的神情近乎关切。

"$playerLastName 舰长，这信号行吗？我这边收到确认了，可... 你现在能听见我吗？"

texts.en:
"Captain?" Inesis looks perfectly patient.

"Captain $playerLastName. Checking signal." His eye twitches. "Got received-confirm... can you hear me now?"
texts.zh:
"舰长？" Inesis 看上去极有耐心。

"$playerLastName 舰长。正在检查信号。\" 他的眼角抽了一下。\"收到确认了... 你现在能听见我吗？"

texts.en:
"Captain?" Arroyo looks annoyed.

"Captain $playerLastName, is this signal good? I got a received-confirm from this stupid thing... can you hear me now?"
texts.zh:
"舰长？" Arroyo 一脸烦躁。

"$playerLastName 舰长，这信号行吗？这破玩意儿给我弹了个确认... 你现在能听见我吗？"

texts.en:
"Captain?" Siyavong looks concerned.

"Captain $playerLastName, is this signal good? I got a received-confirm. Can you hear me now?"
texts.zh:
"舰长？" Siyavong 面露忧色。

"$playerLastName 舰长，信号好吗？我收到确认了。你现在能听见我吗？"

texts.en:
"Captain?" Rao looks annoyed.

"Captain $playerLastName. Is this signal good? Got received-confirm... can you hear me now?"
texts.zh:
"舰长？" Rao 面露不悦。

"$playerLastName 舰长。信号好吗？收到确认了... 你现在能听见我吗？"

texts.en:
Your colony of $sd7s_aiColonyName, in the $sd7s_aiColonySystemName, has an Alpha Core safely and securely optimizing many key functions.

The 'executive consultant team' that oversees interfacing between the core and colonial operations could insert the task of analyzing the ANDRADA files into the AI's usual work queue.

Perhaps it would even 'enjoy' solving this unique problem.
texts.zh:
你在 $sd7s_aiColonySystemName 的殖民地 $sd7s_aiColonyName，有一枚 Alpha 核心正稳妥无虞地优化着许多关键机能。

负责衔接核心与殖民地运作的【执行顾问团队】，可以把分析 ANDRADA 文件的任务塞进这台 AI 的日常作业队列。

说不定它甚至会【享受】解开这个独一无二的问题。

texts.en:
You bear a commission of the Sindrian Diktat and are pledged to uphold the vision of Philip Andrada, the Lion of Sindria, the Supreme Executor from which all legitimate authority flows!

But, clearly, not all is well in the Sindrian Diktat.

Dolos Macario schemes, Hyder scrapes for supplies, Caden rants and parades his fleet in circles. Underlings plot treason, loyal officers are purged without reason.
texts.zh:
你持有辛达强权的委任状，宣誓维护 Philip Andrada 的愿景——辛达瑞亚之狮、最高元首，一切合法权力皆从他那里流出！

但显然，辛达强权里并非一切都好。

Dolos Macario 在背后算计，Hyder 四处搜刮补给，Caden 只会咆哮着把舰队拉出去绕圈游行。底下的人谋划叛变，忠诚的军官被毫无理由地清洗。

options.en: I must find an outsider to decrypt the files
options.zh: 我必须找个外人来解密这些文件

texts.en:
So it must be.

The corruption and confusion runs deep, and only an outsider can help you - yourself an outsider - save the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh:
看来只能如此。

腐败与混乱已经渗得太深。只有外人能帮你——而你自己就是个外人——救下辛达强权。

texts.en: The Hegemony is touchy about the subject of AI cores due to the living memory of the AI Wars as well as the need to secure support from the Faithful of the Luddic Church.
texts.zh: 霸主对 AI 核心这个话题格外敏感：一来 AI 战争的记忆还活着，二来他们需要稳住银河救赎教会的信众。

texts.en: You bear a commission with the Hegemony and would expect to be taken seriously if you were to bring in intel of such supreme importance concerning the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh: 你持有霸主的委任状。若你带着关乎辛达强权、如此重要的情报上门，应当会被认真对待。

texts.en: You do not bear a commission with the Hegemony. Considering the sensitive nature of the intel, and what would be required to decrypt it, you will need an advocate inside their organization.
texts.zh: 你不持霸主的委任状。考虑到这份情报的敏感程度，以及解密它需要付出的代价，你得在他们内部找个替你说话的人。

texts.en:
In any event, you bear a commission of the Sindrian Diktat and are considered an adherent to Philip Andrada, reviled as arch-traitor in the Hegemony's telling of history.
They would never help you.
texts.zh:
况且，你持有辛达强权的委任状，被视为 Philip Andrada 的追随者——而在霸主的史书里，那人是头号叛徒。
他们绝不会帮你。

texts.en: You've heard implications that one Admiral Orcus Rao is involved in the Hegemony's response to the Sindrian Diktat. Perhaps it's time to pay a visit to Ragnar Station and see if it's true.
texts.zh: 你听过一些暗示：Orcus Rao 上将参与了霸主对辛达强权的应对。也许是时候去 Ragnar Station 走一趟，看看是否属实。

texts.en: You've heard that one Admiral Orcus Rao is involved in the Hegemony's response to the Sindrian Diktat. Perhaps it's time to pay a visit to Ragnar Station and see if you can help out.
texts.zh: 你听说 Orcus Rao 上将参与了霸主对辛达强权的应对。也许是时候去 Ragnar Station 走一趟，看看能不能帮上忙。

texts.en: Orcus Rao is ideally placed to act upon this intel. He has the authority to circumvent regulations and a burning desire to strike at the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh: Orcus Rao 所处的位置，最适宜就此情报采取行动。他有权绕过那些条条框框，也一心要对辛达强权动手。

texts.en: You've personally met the High Hegemon, Baikal Daud. He is a practical man, though you have no way of knowing if he trusts you - or could ever trust someone in your position.
texts.zh: 你曾亲自见过至高霸主 Baikal Daud。他是个务实的人，不过你无从知道他是否信得过你——或者他是否可能信任一个处在你这位置上的人。

options.en: Take the files to Orcus Rao
options.zh: 把文件交给 Orcus Rao

options.zh: 把文件交给 Baikal Daud

options.zh: 把文件交给你的霸主联系人

options.zh: 把文件交给一位霸主高层军官

options.zh: 考虑你的其他选择

texts.en: If this intel is legitimate and as important as Dolos Macario acts like it is, it should prove to be an invaluable weapon to Admiral Rao.
texts.zh: 若这份情报确属真货，又真如 Dolos Macario 表现出的那般要紧，那它对 Rao 上将就是一件无价利器。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: High Hegemon Daud must recognize the value of what you'll bring him. Key intel from the heart of the Sindrian Diktat can only help his position.
texts.zh: 至高霸主 Daud 一定看得出你送去的东西值多少。来自辛达强权心脏的关键情报，只会让他的位置更稳。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Your contact will know what to do with such important intel.
texts.zh: 你的联系人知道该拿这么重要的情报怎么办。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: A high-level officer or administrator will know what to do with such important intel.
texts.zh: 一位高层军官或行政官知道该拿这么重要的情报怎么办。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Who could you approach for assistance?
Who would crack the encryption for you?
texts.zh:
你能找谁帮忙？
谁会替你破开这层加密？

texts.en: You are a demarchon of the Persean League in good standing. You have the right to bring matters essential to League security directly to the top executive and you can expect to be taken seriously. Reynard Hannan may be arrogant, but he did not get to his position by being stupid.
texts.zh: 你是英仙座联盟一名声誉无亏的民选统领。你有权把关乎联盟安全要务的事项直接呈给最高行政官，而且可以指望被认真对待。Reynard Hannan 也许傲慢，但能爬到那个位置，绝不是靠愚蠢。

texts.en:
You bear a commission for the Persean League. Despite your dedication, some will consider you little more than an opportunistic mercenary. The only possible way you can be taken - and treated - seriously is through the influence of a leader of one of the Kazeronian gens.

...Or a trusted contact who could, presumably, leverage such a relationship.
texts.zh:
你持有英仙座联盟的委任状。可无论你多尽心，总有人只当你是个见风使舵的雇佣兵。唯一可能被当回事、被认真对待的门路，是借 Kazeron 某个氏族领袖的影响力。

...或者一个信得过的联系人，他能替你把这条关系用起来。

texts.en: You are not a member of the Persean League, nor do you bear their commission. The only way you would be treated seriously is through the influence of an important contact... or the leader of a major Gens. Even then, you will not be trusted with such sensitive information without proving yourself.
texts.zh: 你既不是英仙座联盟的成员，也不持他们的委任状。想被认真对待，只能靠某位要员的引荐... 或者某个大氏族领袖的影响力。可即便到了那一步，不先证明自己，他们也不会把这么敏感的情报交到你手上。

texts.en: You are a Demarchon of the Persean League and can expect to hold audience with Reynard Hannan. He must have the resources required to crack the ANDRADA files.
texts.zh: 你是英仙座联盟的民选统领，可以指望得到 Reynard Hannan 的接见。他手上必定有破解 ANDRADA 档案所需的资源。

texts.en: As a Demarchon of the League with an expensive 'arrangement', you can expect to hold audience with Reynard Hannan to discuss what you've found. And he must have the resources to crack the ANDRADA files.
texts.zh: 作为联盟的民选统领，又付着一笔昂贵的"安排"，你可以指望得到 Reynard Hannan 的接见，与他谈谈你的发现。而他手上必定有破解 ANDRADA 档案的资源。

texts.en: You have earned the trust of Horus Yaribay. Surely he has access to the resources to crack the ANDRADA files.
texts.zh: 你已经赢得了 Horus Yaribay 的信任。他总该有门路弄到破解 ANDRADA 档案的资源。

texts.en: You do have a contact in the League that could provide a means to engage with Fleet Intelligence.
texts.zh: 你在联盟里确实有个联系人，能替你搭上舰队情报部的门路。

options.en: Take the files to Reynard Hannan
options.zh: 把文件交给 Reynard Hannan

options.en: Take the files to Horus Yaribay
options.zh: 把文件交给 Horus Yaribay

options.en: Take the files to Finlay Siyavong
options.zh: 把文件交给 Finlay Siyavong

options.en: Take the files to your contact
options.zh: 把文件交给你的联系人

options.en: Consider your other options
options.zh: 考虑你的其他选择

texts.en: You will place your trust in the ambitions of Reynard Hannan. If he knows what's good for him he'll recognize your value.
texts.zh: 你决定把信任押在 Reynard Hannan 的野心之上。他若识得利害，就该认出你的价值。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: You will take these files to Horus Yaribay and place your trust in him as he placed his trust in you.
texts.zh: 你决定把这些文件交给 Horus Yaribay，并像他曾信任你那样信任他。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: You will take these files to Finlay Siyavong and place your trust in him to do the best thing for the Persean League.
texts.zh: 你决定把这些文件交给 Finlay Siyavong，相信他会为英仙座联盟做出最有利的选择。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Your contact will know what to do with such important intel.
texts.zh: 你的联系人知道该拿这么重要的情报怎么办。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Is there anyone in Tri-Tachyon you could trust? They're almost certain to use the information for their own game. Perhaps it is worth the risk.
texts.zh: 速子科技里有你信得过的人吗？他们几乎肯定会拿这份情报去做自己的局。也许，这风险值得一冒。

texts.en: You bear a commission of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. This should provide an 'in' to corporate officers of influence, perhaps with access to unique black-site resources.
texts.zh: 你持有速子科技公司的委任状。这应该能替你敲开有分量的公司高管的门——他们或许能动用某些独特的机密设施资源。

texts.en: You do not bear a commission with the Tri-Tachyon Corporation, though this is no great barrier - credits and loyalty are generally considered fungible to Tri-Tachyon executives. You would need to leverage a relationship with a well-connected contact on the 'inside' to have any hope of gaining access to the Company's black-site capabilities.
texts.zh: 你并未在速子科技持有委任状，不过这也算不上什么大障碍——在速子科技的高管眼里，星币与忠诚向来可以互换。你得靠着公司【内部】一位人脉通达的关系人，才有望触及这家企业的黑站能力。

texts.en: You have a contact in The Company who may be able to help. Anyone with ambition in Tri-Tachyon - and that ought to be everyone - will leap at an opportunity to get an edge on the competition, whether inside the company or out.
texts.zh: 你在公司里有位联系人，或许能帮上忙。速子科技中但凡有点野心的人——而那本该是所有人——都会扑向任何一个压过对手的机会，不论对手在公司内外。

texts.en: This matter could be of interest to Director Zunya Glamor-Rotanev. She has credits to throw around, after all, and this might be an opportunity to earn a few more.
texts.zh: 这件事也许能让 Zunya Glamor-Rotanev 总监感兴趣。毕竟她有大把星币可撒，而这或许也是个多赚几笔的机会。

texts.en: Faro Inesis is a consummate spymaster. He might be just the man for a job involving decryption and exploitation.
texts.zh: Faro Inesis 是位炉火纯青的谍报头子。解密与利用情报这类活儿，他也许正是合适的人选。

texts.en: Rayan Arroyo might be persuaded of the financial benefits of decrypting key intel concerning what appears to be an increasing unstable Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh: Rayan Arroyo 或许能被说动——解出一批关键情报能换来实打实的收益，而情报关乎一个看上去正愈发不稳的辛达强权。

options.en: Take the files to your Tri-Tachyon contact
options.zh: 把文件交给你的速子科技联系人

options.en: Take the files to a senior Tri-Tachyon executive
options.zh: 把文件交给一位速子科技高层主管

options.en: Take the files to Director Glamor-Rotanev
options.zh: 把文件交给 Glamor-Rotanev 总监

options.en: Take the files to Faro Inesis
options.zh: 把文件交给 Faro Inesis

options.en: Take the files to Rayan Arroyo
options.zh: 把文件交给 Rayan Arroyo

options.en: Consider your other options
options.zh: 考虑你的其他选择

texts.en: Your contact will know what to do with such important intel.
texts.zh: 你的联系人知道该拿这么重要的情报怎么办。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: A high-level executive or administrator will know how to access the resources required to decrypt such important intel.
texts.zh: 一位高层主管或行政官，自然知道该去哪里调取解密这种重要情报所需的资源。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Director Glamor-Rotanev seems to have set her sights higher than factional politics, but perhaps the opportunity to exploit knowledge about Macario's scheming could pique her interest.
texts.zh: Glamor-Rotanev 总监的目光似乎早已越过派系政治，但能拿 Macario 的算计做文章，这个由头也许仍能勾起她的兴趣。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Besides, Inesis' operations must be very well-funded by Director Glamor-Rotanev - and well-protected from the Company itself. If anyone can do this, Inesis can.
texts.zh: 再说，Inesis 的行动必有 Glamor-Rotanev 总监的雄厚资助，也必然防着公司本身。这事若有人办得成，那就是 Inesis。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Rayan Arroyo would know how to exploit an intelligence breakthrough concerning the Sindrian Diktat. Shorting volatiles futures, stockpiling fuel; one way or another he'll take his cut without getting caught up in any mess.

The trick will be convincing him to pull the strings necessary to access Tri-Tachyon's AI assets. They must exist, though the Company keeps them very, very quiet in the aftermath of the two AI Wars.
texts.zh:
Rayan Arroyo 懂得怎么把一份关于辛达强权的情报突破变成钱。做空挥发物期货，囤积燃料；无论走哪条路，他都会捞到自己那一份，还不会沾上一身麻烦。

难处在于说服他去动用那些关系，才够得着速子科技的 AI 资产。这些东西一定存在——只是两场 AI 战争之后，公司把它们藏得极深。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You tag a new workspace in your TriPad and fill it with the relevant files and notes.

When you feel prepared you can open it to review your options.
texts.zh:
你在 TriPad 里标出一个新的工作区，把相关文件和笔记都放了进去。

等你觉得准备妥当了，可以打开它，重新梳理自己的选择。

texts.en: When you feel prepared you can simply open the workspace to review your options.
texts.zh: 等你觉得准备妥当了，直接打开这个工作区，就能梳理自己的选择。

options.zh: 关闭工作区

options.en: Close the workspace
options.zh: 关闭工作区

texts.en: You've heard implications that one Admiral Orcus Rao is involved in the Hegemony's response to the Sindrian Diktat. Perhaps it's time to pay a visit to Ragnar Station and see if it's true.
texts.zh: 你听过一些暗示：Orcus Rao 上将参与了霸主对辛达强权的应对。也许是时候去 Ragnar Station 走一趟，看看是否属实。

texts.en: Orcus Rao is ideally placed to act upon this intel. He has the authority to circumvent regulations - and you know if his desire to strike at the heart of the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh: Orcus Rao 所处的位置，最适宜就此情报采取行动。他有权绕过那些条条框框——而你也清楚，他有多想直插辛达强权的心脏。

texts.en: Besides, you bear a commission of the Hegemony. It is only correct that you take intel of strategic importance to an appropriate senior officer, and Orcus Rao is ideally placed to put such intel to appropriate use.
texts.zh: 再说，你持有霸主的委任状。把具有战略价值的情报交给一位合适的高级军官，本就天经地义；而 Orcus Rao 的位置，最便于让这份情报派上该有的用场。

options.en: Take the files to Orcus Rao
options.zh: 把文件交给 Orcus Rao

options.zh: 考虑其他选择

options.zh: 把文件交给 Orcus Rao

options.zh: 考虑其他选择

options.zh: 把文件交给 Orcus Rao

options.zh: 考虑其他选择

texts.en:
It appears to be too important a piece of intel to simply allow into your hands - and more dangerously, your databanks. Macario of all people should know that post-Collapse encryption is not a sure science.

The best hackers, perhaps the least AI core, or a team made up of the two working together for any given major intelligence service might be able to crack it, given time. Any are capable of it but the Luddic Church (and Path, for that matter, unless some truly heretical sect has invited a rogue AI to its flock.)

You set aside that disturbing thought.

What is clear is you need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next manipulation.
texts.zh:
这份情报太重要了，不可能就这么落进你手里——更危险的是，落进你的数据库。别人或许不懂，Macario 总该知道，大崩塌之后的加密术从来不是什么稳妥的科学。

顶尖黑客，或者最次一等的 AI 核心，又或者两者搭伙组成的团队——任何一家大情报机构，只要给足时间，或许都能把它破开。除了银河救赎教会，谁都有这个能力 (卢德左径其实也一样，除非真有哪个彻底离经叛道的教派，把一头失控的 AI 请进了自己的羊群)。

你把这个令人不安的念头搁到一边。

清楚的是：你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一次操纵。

texts.en:
Macario is playing a complicated game, and he will be at his weakest during the moment of crisis he so clearly wishes to engineer. It will be his opportunity to push Caden into the office of Supreme Executor - bound by a puppet-master's strings. That will be your chance.

You need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next move.
texts.zh:
Macario 在下很大的一盘棋，而在他一心要制造的那场危机爆发之时，他也最虚弱。那是他把 Caden 推上最高元首之位的机会——用提线拴住的傀儡。那也是你的机会。

你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一步。

texts.en:
Macario is playing a complicated game, and he will be at his weakest during the moment of crisis he so clearly wishes to engineer. Does he mean to push Caden into the office of Supreme Executor while bound by a puppet-master's strings?

Is this the bold future that Philip Andrada decreed? It is difficult to imagine it is so.

You need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next move.
texts.zh:
Macario 在下很大的一盘棋，而在他一心要制造的那场危机爆发之时，他也最虚弱。他是打算把 Caden 推上最高元首之位，再用提线拴住他吗？

这就是 Philip Andrada 所钦定的那幅壮阔未来吗？很难想象会是如此。

你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一步。

texts.en:
Philip Andrada carved a stellar empire from the heart of the Persean Sector and then, it seems, his body - though not his immortal will - faltered, allowing parasites and traitors to bring corruption and ruin to his vision.

Foremost among them: Dolos Macario.

You don't know exactly what these files represent but they can't be the product of Macario. He builds nothing of his own, only manipulating what others created. He is nothing like Philip Andrada, who conceived a perfect polity from force and will alone.

It may be that only you can save the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh:
Philip Andrada 从英仙座星域的心脏地带凿出了一个星际帝国；而后，垮下去的似乎是他的身体——而非他不朽的意志，寄生虫与叛徒这才得以把他的愿景拖进腐败与毁灭。

其中最要紧的一个：Dolos Macario。

你说不准这些文件究竟意味着什么，但它们不可能是 Macario 的产物。他从不自己建造什么，只会摆弄别人造出来的东西。他与 Philip Andrada 全然不同——那个人仅凭武力与意志，就构想出一个完美的政体。

也许只有你，才救得下辛达强权。

options.en: Inesis is Tri-Tachyon - could he decrypt Macario's files?
options.zh: Inesis 是速子科技的人 —— 他能破解 Macario 的文件吗？

texts.en: Perhaps he could. But the real question is if he would. And given that Tri-Tachyon is in constant and fierce competition with itself... perhaps.
texts.zh: 也许他能。但真正的问题是，他愿不愿意。考虑到速子科技向来斗得你死我活... 也许吧。

options.en: Could Orcus Rao decrypt Macario's files?
options.zh: Orcus Rao 能破解 Macario 的文件吗？

texts.en: Perhaps he could. Certainly Orcus Rao seems dedicated to the destruction of Philip Andrada, and if Macario's files are the opening he needs...
texts.zh: 也许他能。Orcus Rao 显然一心要毁掉 Philip Andrada，如果 Macario 的这些文件正是他等的那个缺口...

options.en: Could Orcus Rao decrypt Macario's files?
options.zh: Orcus Rao 能破解 Macario 的文件吗？

options.en: Arroyo is Tri-Tachyon - could he decrypt Macario's files?
options.zh: Arroyo 是速子科技的人 —— 他能破解 Macario 的文件吗？

texts.en: Perhaps he could. But the real question is if he would. And given that Tri-Tachyon is in constant and fierce competition with itself... perhaps.
texts.zh: 也许他能。但真正的问题是，他愿不愿意。考虑到速子科技向来斗得你死我活... 也许吧。

options.en: Hyder. She hates Macario. She hates 'dishonorable' acts, but maybe she can help.
options.zh: Hyder。她恨 Macario。她痛恨'不光彩'的勾当，不过也许她能帮上忙。

options.en: Hyder is known to be... in conflict with Macario.
options.zh: 据说 Hyder 与 Macario...有冲突。

options.en: Caden. I told him Macario wanted to control him, which angered him.
options.zh: Caden。我告诉他 Macario 想控制他，这让他很恼火。

options.en: I wasn't exactly focused on 'networking' with the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我可没心思跟辛达强权'搞人脉'。

options.en: Caden. He is a fervent Andradaist.
options.zh: Caden。他是狂热的 Andrada 主义者。

options.en: Caden. He is a loyal Andradaist.
options.zh: Caden。他是忠诚的 Andrada 主义者。

options.en: I shall worry about such matters as I see fit.
options.zh: 这类事我自有分寸。

texts.en:
"Good. I am familiar with Deputy Star Marshal Hyder's inflexibility."

He sounds amused.

"Nonetheless, opening a line of contact with an insider will be useful... so long as she believes her sense of honor will survive untarnished."
texts.zh:
"很好。副星际元帅 Hyder 的不知变通，我是知道的。"

他听起来颇为玩味。

"不过，与内部人士建立联系总会有用...只要她相信自己那份荣誉感不会受损。"

texts.en:
He smiles, and this time it seems like he might truly be enjoying himself. Just a little.

"I have just two more items to review with you."
texts.zh:
他笑了，这一次他似乎真的有点乐在其中。只有一点点。

"我还有两件事要与你过一遍。"

options.en: Yes?
options.zh: 什么事？

texts.en:
"The first: you have a public-relations problem. Mr. Macario did some nasty work... and I'd be pleased to contract, on your behalf, a firm which specializes in reputation recovery of just this sort."

"60,000 credits and they'll undo the damage. Well, most of it, and we can only promise that outside of the Sindrian Diktat. I'll handle the details - my fee is built into the price. What do you say?"
texts.zh:
"第一件：你的公关出了问题。Macario 先生干的那些事可不干净...而我很乐意代你签下一家公司，专做这一类声誉修复。"

"60,000 星币，他们就能把损害抹平。嗯，大部分吧，而且我们只能保证在辛达强权境外有效。细节由我打理——我的抽成算在价里了。你说呢？"

options.en: I accept. (transfer credits)
options.zh: 我接受。 (转账星币)

options.en: I can handle my own reputation.
options.zh: 我自己的名声，我自己处理。

texts.en:
"A wise choice," he makes a small nod, as if you've taught him a subtle lesson. "I'll put in a request immediately."

"Just remember that these things take time. I think you'll be impressed by what my contact's firm can accomplish."
texts.zh:
"明智的选择，\"他微微颔首，仿佛你给他上了一堂不动声色的课，\"我这就去提申请。"

"只要记住，这种事需要时间。我想，我那位联系人手下公司的本事会让你满意的。"

options.en: Thanks, I think.
options.zh: 谢了...大概吧。

options.en: What's the other item?
options.zh: 另一件是什么？

texts.en:
"A word of warning," he says cheerfully. "In Tri-Tachyon we have... how would you put it - 'zones of interest'?"

"Official job descriptions are, of course, a statement of minimum expectation. Tri-Tachyon expects all of its employees - and contractors - to exceed expectations by showing ambition and initiative above and beyond the strict definitions of their role whenever possible. This naturally results in a certain amount of conflict, a 'jostling for position', if you like."
texts.zh:
"提醒一句，\"他语气轻快，\"在速子科技，我们有...怎么说呢——'利益区'？"

"正式的职位说明，当然只写明最低的期望。速子科技要求所有雇员——以及承包商——只要有可能，就要拿出超越职责严格界定的野心与主动性，去超过期望。这自然会造成一定程度的摩擦，或者说'抢位置'，随你怎么说。"

options.en: What are you getting at?
options.zh: 你到底想说什么？

texts.en:
"Your participation in the Sindrian Diktat situation has drawn attention from certain fellow executives who have profited greatly from the status quo - that is, the development, sale, and production of advanced technologies in the field of weapons, starship hulls, surveillance, and public relations."

"Willing or not, you've threatened their profits, which has led to a certain resentment." He pauses a moment, "Which I do not share, of course."

The smile re-appears.

He picks up his TriPad, as if concluding the conversation - though you know full well his implants can access any information he requires.
texts.zh:
"你在辛达强权那摊事里的作为，已经引来了几位同僚执行官的注意——那些人从现状里获利极丰，所谓现状，即武器、舰体、监控与公关领域先进技术的研发、销售与生产。"

"不管你有意无意，你威胁到了他们的利润，这就招来了一些怨气。\"他顿了顿，\"当然，我没有这种怨气。"

笑容又浮了上来。

他拿起 TriPad，像是要给这场谈话收尾——尽管你很清楚，他的植入体随时能调取他需要的任何信息。

texts.en:
"Your participation in the Sindrian Diktat situation has drawn attention from fellow executives who have profited greatly from the status quo - that is, the development, sale, and production of advanced technologies in the field of weapons, starship hulls, surveillance, and public relations."

"Willing or not, you appear to threaten their profits and position of favor, and this has led to a certain amount of resentment." He pauses a moment, "Which I do not share, of course."

The smile re-appears.

He picks up his TriPad, as if concluding the conversation - though you know full well his implants can access any information he requires.
texts.zh:
"你在辛达强权那摊事里的作为，已经引来了同僚执行官的注意——那些人从现状里获利极丰，所谓现状，即武器、舰体、监控与公关领域先进技术的研发、销售与生产。"

"不管你有意无意，你似乎威胁到了他们的利润与受宠的地位，这就招来了不少怨气。\"他顿了顿，\"当然，我没有这种怨气。"

笑容又浮了上来。

他拿起 TriPad，像是要给这场谈话收尾——尽管你很清楚，他的植入体随时能调取他需要的任何信息。

options.en: And?
options.zh: 然后呢？

options.en: That's absurd. I support Hector, the rightful heir!
options.zh: 荒谬。我支持的是 Hector，合法继承人！

options.en: And?
options.zh: 然后呢？

texts.en:
He glances at you one last time.

"You will be attacked by a very well-outfitted war fleet. Could be mercenary, could be private. You didn't hear this from me, of course."

"Profit in all your ventures, captain," he says cheerfully.
texts.zh:
他最后看了你一眼。

"你会遭到一支装备极精良的舰队袭击。可能是雇佣兵，也可能是私人武装。当然，这话你没从我这儿听过。"

"愿你每一桩生意都盈利，舰长，"他语气轻快地说。

texts.en:
He glances at you one last time.

"You'll be attacked by a well-equipped war fleet. Could be mercenary, could be private. You didn't hear this from me, of course."

"Profit in all your ventures, captain," he says cheerfully.
texts.zh:
他最后看了你一眼。

"你会遭到一支装备精良的舰队袭击。可能是雇佣兵，也可能是私人武装。当然，这话你没从我这儿听过。"

"愿你每一桩生意都盈利，舰长，"他语气轻快地说。

options.en: Yeah, you too.
options.zh: 嗯，也祝你自己。

options.en: Yeah, you too.
options.zh: 嗯，也祝你自己。

texts.en: "Alas," Inesis says with an apologetic shrug. "They view Hector's cause as a secondary objective - one contingent upon their continued profits."
texts.zh: "唉，\"Inesis 歉意地耸了耸肩，\"他们只把 Hector 的事业当作次要目标——一个得看他们利润能否延续的目标。"

texts.en: "Of course," he makes a small nod, as if you've taught him something.
texts.zh: "当然，"他微微颔首，仿佛你刚教会了他什么。

options.en: What's the other item?
options.zh: 另一件是什么？

options.en: Thanks, I think.
options.zh: 谢了...大概吧。

texts.en:
"Good. "I am familiar with Guard High Deputy Executor Caden's ambition, which is sure to be... frustrated by Hector's claim - and Macario's backing."

"Opening a line of contact with an insider will be useful, provided he believes he is giving the orders."
texts.zh:
"很好。卫队高级副执政官 Caden 的野心，我是知道的，那野心注定会被...Hector 的继承主张——以及 Macario 的支持——所挫。"

"与内部人士建立联系总会有用，只要他相信自己才是下命令的人。"

texts.en: "Oh, well," he says, not in the least disappointed. "The software attack will have to be our opening move, then. We'll track his moves, find his safehouses..."
texts.zh: "哦，好吧，\"他说，一点也不失望。\"那就只能拿软件攻击当开场棋了。我们会追踪他的动作，找出他的安全屋..."

summary.en: Meet Yannick Ram at his safehouse on Volturn. He has a plan to save the Sindrian Diktat from itself.
summary.zh: 在 Volturn 的安全屋会见 Yannick Ram。他有一个让辛达强权免于自我毁灭的计划。
